Your first task is to:
1. Understand the architecture and how the different components interact.
2. Identify the main entry points and important files.
3. Explain how the app currently works, including its download and media-conversion pipeline.
4. Point out any obvious technical debt or potential issues.

**Important:** Do not modify, delete, or create any files yet. I want you to understand the project first and report back with your findings.

Treat this as an existing project, not a blank-slate coding exercise.

    import { getMediaBlob, recordMediaPlay, recordListeningTime } from "./library.js";
    import { initializeDownloader } from "./downloader.js";
    import { initializePlaylistLibrary } from "./playlist-library.js";
    import { initializeSettings } from "./settings.js";
    import { initializeEdit } from "./edit.js";
    import { initializeHome } from "./home.js";
    import { initializeStats } from "./stats.js";
    
    const tabButtons = document.querySelectorAll("[data-tab]");
    const panels = document.querySelectorAll("[data-panel]");
    
    tabButtons.forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const selectedTab = button.dataset.tab;
    
        tabButtons.forEach((tab) => {
          if (tab === button) tab.setAttribute("aria-current", "page");
          else tab.removeAttribute("aria-current");
        });
    
        panels.forEach((panel) => {
          panel.hidden = panel.dataset.panel !== selectedTab;
        });
    
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("puffin:tab-changed", { detail: selectedTab }));
      });
    });
    
    const themeToggle = document.querySelector("#theme-toggle");
    themeToggle.addEventListener("click", () => {
      const isDark = document.body.classList.toggle("dark");
      themeToggle.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(isDark));
    });
    
    const libraryStatus = document.querySelector("#library-status");
    const playerRevealZone = document.querySelector("#player-reveal-zone");
    const playerRevealZoneHome = playerRevealZone.parentElement;
    const playerDock = document.querySelector("#player-dock");
    const playerDockHome = playerDock.parentElement;
    const mediaPlayer = document.querySelector("#media-player");
    const playerReveal = document.querySelector("#player-reveal");
    const currentMediaTitle = document.querySelector("#current-media-title");
    const audioPlayer = document.querySelector("#audio-player");
    const videoPlayer = document.querySelector("#video-player");
    const playerArtwork = document.querySelector("#player-artwork");
    const playerSubtitle = document.querySelector("#player-subtitle");
    const playerToggle = document.querySelector("#player-toggle");
    const playerSeek = document.querySelector("#player-seek");
    const playerCurrentTime = document.querySelector("#player-current-time");
    const playerDuration = document.querySelector("#player-duration");
    const playerVolume = document.querySelector("#player-volume");
    const playerSpeed = document.querySelector("#player-speed");
    const playerClose = document.querySelector("#player-close");
    const videoTheater = document.querySelector("#video-theater");
    const videoTheaterStage = document.querySelector("#video-theater-stage");
    const playerTrack = document.querySelector(".player-track");
    playerArtwork.addEventListener("error", () => { playerArtwork.src = "/favicon.svg"; }, { once: true });
    
    let activeMediaId = null;
    let activeObjectUrl = null;
    let activePlayer = null;
    let isSeeking = false;
    let playerPinnedOpen = false;
    let playerCollapseRequested = false;
    let playerPinnedOpenBeforeTheater = false;
    let playbackSample = null;
    let pendingListeningMs = 0;
    
    function setDockRevealed(revealed) {
      playerDock.classList.toggle("is-revealed", revealed);
    }
    
    function formatTime(seconds) {
      if (!Number.isFinite(seconds) || seconds < 0) return "0:00";
      const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
      const remainder = Math.floor(seconds % 60).toString().padStart(2, "0");
      return `${minutes}:${remainder}`;
    }
    
    function getPlaybackErrorMessage(player, error) {
      const mediaErrorCode = player.error?.code;
      if (error?.name === "NotAllowedError") {
        return "The browser blocked playback. Tap Play again to allow it.";
      }
      if (error?.name === "NotSupportedError" || mediaErrorCode === 3 || mediaErrorCode === 4) {
        return "This file uses a video or audio codec the browser cannot play. Try an H.264/AAC MP4.";
      }
      if (mediaErrorCode === 2) {
        return "The browser could not load this media file from local storage.";
      }
      return `Playback failed${error?.name ? ` (${error.name})` : ""}.`;
    }
    
    function updatePlayerControls() {
      const duration = activePlayer && Number.isFinite(activePlayer.duration) ? activePlayer.duration : 0;
      const currentTime = activePlayer && Number.isFinite(activePlayer.currentTime) ? activePlayer.currentTime : 0;
      playerSeek.max = String(duration);
      playerSeek.disabled = !activePlayer || duration <= 0;
      if (!isSeeking) playerSeek.value = String(Math.min(currentTime, duration));
      playerCurrentTime.textContent = formatTime(currentTime);
      playerDuration.textContent = formatTime(duration);
    
      const playing = Boolean(activePlayer && !activePlayer.paused && !activePlayer.ended);
      playerToggle.textContent = playing ? "Ⅱ" : "▶";
      playerToggle.setAttribute("aria-label", playing ? "Pause" : "Play");
      playerToggle.title = playing ? "Pause" : "Play";
    }
    
    function sampleListeningTime(player, allowStopped = false) {
      if (player !== activePlayer || player !== audioPlayer || (!allowStopped && (player.paused || player.ended))) {
        playbackSample = null;
        return;
      }
      const now = performance.now();
      const position = player.currentTime;
      if (playbackSample) {
        const elapsed = now - playbackSample.wallTime;
        const mediaElapsed = position - playbackSample.position;
        if (elapsed > 0 && elapsed <= 7000 && mediaElapsed > 0 && mediaElapsed <= (elapsed / 1000) * 2.5 + 0.75) {
          pendingListeningMs += elapsed;
        }
      }
      playbackSample = { wallTime: now, position };
      if (pendingListeningMs >= 15000) flushListeningTime();
    }
    
    async function flushListeningTime() {
      const milliseconds = pendingListeningMs;
      pendingListeningMs = 0;
      if (milliseconds > 0) {
        try { await recordListeningTime(milliseconds); }
        catch (error) { console.warn("Could not save listening time:", error); }
      }
    }
    
    async function startPlayback(record) {
      try {
        sampleListeningTime(activePlayer);
        await flushListeningTime();
        const blob = await getMediaBlob(record.id);
        if (!blob) throw new Error("The media file is missing from local storage.");
    
        audioPlayer.pause();
        videoPlayer.pause();
        audioPlayer.removeAttribute("src");
        videoPlayer.removeAttribute("src");
        audioPlayer.load();
        videoPlayer.load();
        if (activeObjectUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(activeObjectUrl);
    
        const playableBlob = blob.type === record.type
          ? blob
          : blob.slice(0, blob.size, record.type);
        activeObjectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(playableBlob);
        activeMediaId = record.id;
        playerCollapseRequested = false;
        playerPinnedOpen = true;
        playerReveal.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
        playerReveal.setAttribute("aria-label", "Hide player controls");
        playerReveal.title = "Hide player controls";
        currentMediaTitle.textContent = record.title || record.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, "");
        playerSubtitle.textContent = record.artist || "Puffin Library";
        if (record.artwork) playerArtwork.src = record.artwork;
        else playerArtwork.src = "/favicon.svg";
        playerDock.hidden = false;
        mediaPlayer.hidden = false;
    
        const player = record.kind === "video" ? videoPlayer : audioPlayer;
        const otherPlayer = player === videoPlayer ? audioPlayer : videoPlayer;
        otherPlayer.hidden = true;
        player.hidden = false;
        player.src = activeObjectUrl;
        player.volume = Number(playerVolume.value);
        player.playbackRate = 1;
        player.defaultPlaybackRate = 1;
        playerSpeed.value = "1";
        activePlayer = player;
        playerArtwork.hidden = record.kind === "video";
        setDockRevealed(true);
        playerSubtitle.textContent = record.kind === "video" ? "Video · Puffin Library" : "Puffin Library";
        document.body.classList.add("has-player");
        updatePlayerControls();
    
        try {
          await player.play();
          recordMediaPlay(record.id).catch((error) => console.warn("Could not update recent plays:", error));
          updatePlayerControls();
          setLibraryStatus(`Playing ${record.name}`);
        } catch (error) {
          updatePlayerControls();
          setLibraryStatus(`${getPlaybackErrorMessage(player, error)} Track: ${record.name}.`);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        setLibraryStatus(`Could not open this file: ${error.message}`);
      }
    }
    
    function stopPlayback() {
      sampleListeningTime(activePlayer);
      flushListeningTime();
      if (videoTheater.open) videoTheater.close();
      audioPlayer.pause();
      videoPlayer.pause();
      audioPlayer.removeAttribute("src");
      videoPlayer.removeAttribute("src");
      audioPlayer.load();
      videoPlayer.load();
      if (activeObjectUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(activeObjectUrl);
      activeObjectUrl = null;
      activeMediaId = null;
      activePlayer = null;
      isSeeking = false;
      mediaPlayer.hidden = true;
      playerDock.hidden = true;
      playerPinnedOpen = false;
      playerCollapseRequested = false;
      setDockRevealed(false);
      playerReveal.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
      playerReveal.setAttribute("aria-label", "Show player controls");
      playerReveal.title = "Show player controls";
      playerArtwork.hidden = false;
      playerSubtitle.textContent = "Puffin Library";
      document.body.classList.remove("has-player");
      updatePlayerControls();
    }
    
    initializePlaylistLibrary({
      onPlay: startPlayback,
      onDeleted: (record) => {
        if (activeMediaId === record.id) stopPlayback();
      },
    });
    
    window.addEventListener("puffin:metadata-updated", (event) => {
      const record = event.detail;
      if (!record || record.id !== activeMediaId) return;
      currentMediaTitle.textContent = record.title || record.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, "");
      playerSubtitle.textContent = record.kind === "video" ? `Video · ${record.artist || "Puffin Library"}` : (record.artist || "Puffin Library");
      playerArtwork.src = record.artwork || "/favicon.svg";
    });
    
    for (const player of [audioPlayer, videoPlayer]) {
      for (const eventName of ["loadedmetadata", "durationchange", "timeupdate", "play", "pause", "ended"]) {
        player.addEventListener(eventName, updatePlayerControls);
      }
      player.addEventListener("play", () => {
        if (player === activePlayer && player === audioPlayer) playbackSample = { wallTime: performance.now(), position: player.currentTime };
      });
      player.addEventListener("timeupdate", () => sampleListeningTime(player));
      for (const eventName of ["pause", "ended"]) {
        player.addEventListener(eventName, () => {
          sampleListeningTime(player, true);
          flushListeningTime();
        });
      }
      player.addEventListener("seeking", () => {
        if (player === activePlayer) playbackSample = { wallTime: performance.now(), position: player.currentTime };
      });
      player.addEventListener("error", () => {
        setLibraryStatus(getPlaybackErrorMessage(player));
      });
    }
    
    playerToggle.addEventListener("click", async () => {
      if (!activePlayer) return;
      if (activePlayer.paused) {
        try {
          await activePlayer.play();
        } catch (error) {
          setLibraryStatus(getPlaybackErrorMessage(activePlayer, error));
        }
      } else {
        activePlayer.pause();
      }
      updatePlayerControls();
    });
    
    function commitSeek() {
      if (!activePlayer || !Number.isFinite(activePlayer.duration)) {
        isSeeking = false;
        return;
      }
      activePlayer.currentTime = Number(playerSeek.value);
      isSeeking = false;
      updatePlayerControls();
    }
    
    window.addEventListener("pagehide", () => { sampleListeningTime(activePlayer); flushListeningTime(); });
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
      if (document.hidden) { sampleListeningTime(activePlayer); flushListeningTime(); }
      else if (activePlayer && !activePlayer.paused) playbackSample = { wallTime: performance.now(), position: activePlayer.currentTime };
    });
    
    playerSeek.addEventListener("pointerdown", () => {
      isSeeking = true;
    });
    
    playerSeek.addEventListener("pointerup", commitSeek);
    playerSeek.addEventListener("pointercancel", commitSeek);
    playerSeek.addEventListener("change", commitSeek);

    # Puffin
    
    Puffin is a music and video app for macOS and iOS. It is designed as a static Progressive Web App (PWA), hosted on Vercel, with an interface that adapts to desktop and mobile screens. Its main features are downloading, editing, playing, and tracking music and video.
    
    ## Download
    
    Users can paste a YouTube link or search YouTube within Puffin. Search results show video thumbnails, titles, channels, and durations; users can preview a result in YouTube or select it for download. Audio downloads preserve the source audio format when the browser supports it, with AAC in M4A as a compatibility fallback. Video downloads use H.264 video and AAC audio in MP4 for browser compatibility.
    
    Downloads are intended for public-domain videos or users' own videos. Users are trusted to download only content they are authorized to download.
    
    ### Download workflow
    
    The PWA sends a download request to a private service running on a Raspberry Pi. The Pi runs `yt-dlp`, temporarily stores the downloaded file, and streams it to the device that requested it. Puffin saves the file in that device's browser storage for offline playback. After Puffin confirms that the local save succeeded, the Pi deletes its temporary copy. The Pi has approximately 18 GB of available storage for temporary files.
    
    The Raspberry Pi service is intended to be reachable only over a private network. Tailscale must be installed and connected on the Pi and on each Mac or iPhone that will request downloads. If the Pi or private connection is unavailable, new downloads cannot be requested; files already saved on a device remain available offline.
    
    The Pi service setup, including Raspberry Pi OS commands, Tailscale Serve, and an optional systemd service for automatic startup, is documented in [pi-service/README.md](pi-service/README.md). Set `PUFFIN_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` there to the exact Vercel deployment origin and any local development origin you use. The Pi stores downloads only temporarily; Puffin stores each completed file in the requesting device's browser storage.
    
    ## Edit
    
    The Edit tab is a music tag editor with the following features:
    
    - **Batch editing:** Modify multiple files at once to standardize capitalization, genres, album titles, and other tags.
    - **Filename and tag conversion:** Convert between filenames and tags using custom naming masks.
    - **Metadata lookup:** Look up metadata from online sources such as MusicBrainz.
    
    ## Play
    
    The Play tab plays downloaded audio and video from the local library. Pi downloads preserve a browser-supported source audio format where possible, with AAC in M4A as a compatibility fallback; videos use H.264 with AAC audio in MP4. Files imported from the device are kept in their original format; browser playback depends on the codecs the browser supports. Users can create, rename, and delete playlists, add or remove local media, and pin playlists to the top. Playlist data and media files are stored on the device. It includes an equalizer with:
    
    - **Multiple bands:** Support five to ten or more bands, covering core hearing ranges from sub-bass (20–60 Hz) to treble and air (8–16+ kHz). A 10-band graphic equalizer offers a balance between control and simplicity.
    - **Preset profiles:** Quick-start modes such as Rock, Pop, Classical, Vocal Boost, and Flat.
    - **Preamp / gain control:** Lower overall volume when boosting frequencies to help prevent digital clipping and distortion.
    - **Custom presets:** Save, name, and recall frequency curves for different headphones or speakers.
    
    The player also includes an audio visualizer with dancing bars, play and pause, shuffle, repeat, queue controls (add to queue and edit queue), and a smooth scrub bar.
    
    ## Stats
    
    The Stats tab displays separate tables ranking the most frequently played artists, albums, and songs. It also shows total listening time and the storage space used by media files. Users can reset their statistics.
    
    ## Interface
    
    The home page should have a navigation menu for Download, Edit, Play, and Stats; a dark-mode button; and a settings gear icon. The main area should display:
    
    > **Puffin: A Music Player**
    > Click an option to get started
    
    The PWA should provide a more compact mobile layout while keeping all features available.
    
    --- PI SERVICE README ---
    # Raspberry Pi downloader setup
    
    The Pi service runs `yt-dlp` as a private, job-based API. Puffin requests an audio or video download, polls for progress, receives the result, saves it in the device's IndexedDB library, and then confirms the save so the Pi can delete its temporary file.
    
    The service accepts HTTPS YouTube URLs and `ytsearch:` search queries. Audio downloads preserve yt-dlp's audio-only source format when the requesting browser supports it; Puffin sends its supported audio formats with the request. If necessary, the Pi remuxes AAC into M4A without re-encoding, or converts incompatible audio to AAC/M4A at 192 kb/s. Puffin can search YouTube through the Pi's `GET /api/search?q=...` endpoint; this uses yt-dlp's flat search to return up to 10 video titles, channels, durations, URLs, and thumbnails without downloading media. CSV batches can submit a `ytsearch:` query for each `Track Name`, `Artist Name`, and `Album` row. Video downloads require the source to offer H.264 and AAC streams; the service reports an error when those formats are unavailable rather than returning a less-compatible codec. It permits one active download or file transfer at a time. A new request replaces an older completed file that Puffin did not confirm. The default temporary file limit is 2 GiB, and the default free-space reserve is 1 GiB. An unconfirmed file is removed after one hour. Job state is held in memory, so a Pi restart cancels active jobs and clears abandoned Puffin job folders.
    
    ## Install on Raspberry Pi OS
    
    Clone the repository onto the Pi, then install the system dependencies and Python environment. These commands assume Raspberry Pi OS and that you will clone the repo into `~/Puffin`:
    
    ```sh
    git clone https://github.com/carsrock60/Puffin.git ~/Puffin
    sudo apt update
    sudo apt install -y python3-venv ffmpeg
    cd ~/Puffin/pi-service
    python3 -m venv .venv
    .venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip
    .venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
    ```
    
    Set the allowed browser origins. Include the Vercel site origin and the local Vite origin used during development. Origins have no trailing slash. For example, if your deployed app is `https://puffin.vercel.app`, include that exact origin:
    
    ```sh
    export PUFFIN_ALLOWED_ORIGINS="https://your-puffin-site.vercel.app,http://localhost:5173"
    export PUFFIN_DOWNLOAD_DIR="$HOME/puffin-downloads"
    ```
    
    Start the service for an initial check:
    
    ```sh
    .venv/bin/python app.py
    ```
    
    It listens on `127.0.0.1:8765`, so it is not directly exposed to the local network. Leave this process running while testing. Stop it with Ctrl+C.
    
    ## Make the service privately reachable
    
    Install and sign in to Tailscale on the Pi, Mac, and iPhone. With the Pi service running, publish it only inside your tailnet:
    
    ```sh
    tailscale serve --bg 8765
    ```
    
    Tailscale Serve will show an HTTPS URL such as `https://pi-name.example-tailnet.ts.net`. Enter that URL into Puffin's Pi address field. Keep Tailscale connected on devices that need to start downloads. Do not expose this service with port forwarding or Tailscale Funnel. [Tailscale Serve documentation](https://tailscale.com/docs/features/tailscale-serve)
    
    On each Mac or iPhone, install Tailscale and sign in to the same tailnet as the Pi. The device does not join your home Wi-Fi automatically; Tailscale creates the private connection over whatever internet connection the device is using. The Vercel-hosted Puffin page can then reach the Pi while Tailscale is connected.
    
    ## Keep it running after reboot
    
    Copy `puffin-downloader.service.example` to `/etc/systemd/system/puffin-downloader.service`. Replace `/home/REPLACE_ME` in the unit with the Pi user's home directory, and replace `REPLACE_ME` with that user's account name. Create `/etc/puffin-downloader.env` with:
    
    ```ini
    PUFFIN_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=https://your-puffin-site.vercel.app,http://localhost:5173
    PUFFIN_DOWNLOAD_DIR=/home/REPLACE_ME/puffin-downloads
    PUFFIN_MAX_DOWNLOAD_BYTES=2147483648
    PUFFIN_MIN_FREE_BYTES=1073741824
    ```
    
    Replace the placeholder values, then enable the service:
    
    ```sh
    sudo chmod 600 /etc/puffin-downloader.env
    sudo systemctl daemon-reload
    sudo systemctl enable --now puffin-downloader
    sudo systemctl status puffin-downloader
    ```
    
    Run `tailscale serve --bg 8765` once for the Pi's Tailscale service. To inspect downloader logs later, use:
    
    ```sh
    sudo journalctl -u puffin-downloader -f
    ```
    
    The origin allowlist is a browser CORS rule, not authentication. Keep access private with Tailscale Serve and only add origins you control.

    """Private, job-based downloader API for Puffin."""
    
    from __future__ import annotations
    
    import json
    import logging
    import mimetypes
    import os
    import re
    import shutil
    import subprocess
    import threading
    import time
    import uuid
    from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
    from pathlib import Path
    from urllib.parse import parse_qs, quote, unquote, urlsplit
    
    
    HOST = "127.0.0.1"
    PORT = int(os.environ.get("PUFFIN_PORT", "8765"))
    DOWNLOAD_DIR = Path(os.environ.get("PUFFIN_DOWNLOAD_DIR", "~/puffin-downloads")).expanduser()
    MAX_DOWNLOAD_BYTES = int(os.environ.get("PUFFIN_MAX_DOWNLOAD_BYTES", str(2 * 1024**3)))
    MIN_FREE_BYTES = int(os.environ.get("PUFFIN_MIN_FREE_BYTES", str(1024**3)))
    JOB_RETENTION_SECONDS = int(os.environ.get("PUFFIN_JOB_RETENTION_SECONDS", "3600"))
    ALLOWED_ORIGINS = {
        origin.strip().rstrip("/")
        for origin in os.environ.get("PUFFIN_ALLOWED_ORIGINS", "http://localhost:5173").split(",")
        if origin.strip()
    }
    
    JOBS: dict[str, dict] = {}
    JOBS_LOCK = threading.RLock()
    PROGRESS_PATTERN = re.compile(r"\[download\]\s+(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%")
    SPEED_PATTERN = re.compile(r"\bat\s+([0-9.]+\s*[KMG]?i?B/s)")
    ETA_PATTERN = re.compile(r"\bETA\s+(\d{2}:\d{2}(?::\d{2})?)")
    
    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(message)s")
    LOGGER = logging.getLogger("puffin-downloader")
    AUDIO_MIME_TYPES = {
        "aac": "audio/aac",
        "aiff": "audio/aiff",
        "flac": "audio/flac",
        "m4a": "audio/mp4",
        "mp3": "audio/mpeg",
        "oga": "audio/ogg",
        "ogg": "audio/ogg",
        "opus": "audio/ogg",
        "wav": "audio/wav",
        "webm": "audio/webm",
    }
    SUPPORTED_AUDIO_EXTENSIONS = set(AUDIO_MIME_TYPES)
    
    
    def _is_allowed_media_url(value: object) -> bool:
        if not isinstance(value, str) or len(value) > 4096:
            return False
        if value.startswith(("ytsearch:", "ytsearch1:")):
            query = value.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
            return bool(query) and len(query) <= 1000 and not any(ord(character) < 32 for character in query)
        try:
            parsed = urlsplit(value)
            hostname = (parsed.hostname or "").lower().rstrip(".")
            port = parsed.port
        except ValueError:
            return False
    
        youtube_host = hostname == "youtu.be" or hostname == "youtube.com" or hostname.endswith(".youtube.com")
        return parsed.scheme == "https" and port in {None, 443} and not parsed.username and not parsed.password and youtube_host
    
    
    def _safe_filename(path: Path) -> str:
        name = path.name.replace("\r", "").replace("\n", "").replace('"', "'")
        return name or "puffin-media"
    
    
    def _ensure_supported_audio(path: Path, supported_formats: list[str], job: dict) -> Path:
        extension = path.suffix.lower().lstrip(".")
        if extension in supported_formats and extension in SUPPORTED_AUDIO_EXTENSIONS:
            return path
    
        output_path = path.with_suffix(".m4a")
        with JOBS_LOCK:
            job["status"] = "converting"
            job["progress"] = 99
            job["updated_at"] = time.time()
    
        common_args = ["ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-y", "-i", str(path), "-vn"]
        copied = subprocess.run(
            [*common_args, "-c:a", "copy", "-movflags", "+faststart", str(output_path)],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
        )
        if copied.returncode != 0:
            encoded = subprocess.run(
                [*common_args, "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "192k", "-movflags", "+faststart", str(output_path)],
                capture_output=True,
                text=True,
            )
            if encoded.returncode != 0:
                raise RuntimeError("Could not convert this audio to a Puffin-compatible M4A file")
    
        path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        return output_path
    
    
    def _public_job(job: dict) -> dict:
        return {
            "id": job["id"],
            "status": job["status"],
            "progress": job["progress"],
            "speed": job.get("speed"),
            "eta": job.get("eta"),
            "kind": job["kind"],
            "filename": job.get("filename"),
            "size": job.get("size"),
            "mime_type": job.get("mime_type"),
            "error": job.get("error"),
        }
    
    
    def _search_youtube(query: str) -> list[dict]:
        command = [
            "yt-dlp",
            "--dump-single-json",
            "--flat-playlist",
            "--skip-download",
            "--quiet",
            "--no-warnings",
            f"ytsearch10:{query}",
        ]
        result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30, check=True)
        payload = json.loads(result.stdout)
        videos = []
        for entry in payload.get("entries") or []:
            video_id = entry.get("id")
            if not video_id:
                continue
            thumbnails = entry.get("thumbnails") or []
            thumbnail = entry.get("thumbnail") or (thumbnails[-1].get("url") if thumbnails else None)
            videos.append({
                "id": video_id,
                "url": f"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={quote(str(video_id), safe='')}",
                "title": entry.get("title") or "Untitled video",
                "channel": entry.get("uploader") or entry.get("channel") or "Unknown channel",
                "duration": entry.get("duration"),
                "thumbnail": thumbnail,
            })
            if len(videos) == 10:
                break
        return videos
    
    
    def _remove_work_directory(job: dict) -> None:
        work_dir = job.get("work_dir")
        if work_dir:
            shutil.rmtree(work_dir, ignore_errors=True)
    
    
    def _run_download(job_id: str) -> None:
        with JOBS_LOCK:
            job = JOBS.get(job_id)
            if not job:
                return
            if job["cancel_requested"]:
                job["status"] = "cancelled"
                job["updated_at"] = time.time()
                return
            job["status"] = "downloading"
            job["updated_at"] = time.time()
    
        work_dir = Path(job["work_dir"])
        output_template = str(work_dir / "%(title).160s [%(id)s].%(ext)s")
        command = [
            "yt-dlp",
            "--no-playlist",
            "--newline",
            "--progress",
            "--no-write-info-json",
            "--no-write-thumbnail",
            "--no-write-subs",
            "--no-overwrites",
            "--max-filesize",
            str(MAX_DOWNLOAD_BYTES),
            "--output",
            output_template,
        ]
    
        if job["kind"] == "audio":
            command.extend([
                "--format",
                "bestaudio",
            ])
        else:
            command.extend([
                "--format",
                "bv[vcodec~='^(avc|h264)']+ba[acodec~='^(mp4a|aac)']/b[vcodec~='^(avc|h264)'][acodec~='^(mp4a|aac)']",
                "--merge-output-format",
                "mp4",
            ])
        command.append(job["url"])
    
        process = None
        compatible_format_missing = False
        try:
            process = subprocess.Popen(
                command,
                stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                text=True,
                errors="replace",
                bufsize=1,
            )
            with JOBS_LOCK:
                current_job = JOBS.get(job_id)
                if not current_job:
                    process.terminate()
                    return
                current_job["process"] = process
                if current_job["cancel_requested"]:
                    process.terminate()
    
            for line in process.stdout or []:
                if "Requested format is not available" in line:
                    compatible_format_missing = True
                with JOBS_LOCK:
                    current_job = JOBS.get(job_id)
                    if not current_job:
                        process.terminate()
                        break
                    if current_job["cancel_requested"]:

    class PuffinHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        server_version = "PuffinDownloader/1.0"
    
        def log_message(self, format_string: str, *args) -> None:
            # Avoid logging full request paths, which may contain private video URLs.
            LOGGER.info("%s %s", self.command, self.path.split("?", 1)[0])
    
        def _origin(self) -> str | None:
            origin = self.headers.get("Origin")
            if origin is None:
                return None
            return origin.rstrip("/")
    
        def _origin_allowed(self) -> bool:
            origin = self._origin()
            return origin is None or origin in ALLOWED_ORIGINS
    
        def _cors_headers(self) -> None:
            origin = self._origin()
            if origin and origin in ALLOWED_ORIGINS:
                self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", origin)
                self.send_header("Vary", "Origin")
                self.send_header("Access-Control-Expose-Headers", "Content-Length, X-Download-Name")
    
        def _json(self, status: int, payload: dict) -> None:
            body = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
            self.send_response(status)
            self._cors_headers()
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
            self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(body)
    
        def _no_content(self, status: int = 204) -> None:
            self.send_response(status)
            self._cors_headers()
            self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
            self.end_headers()
    
        def _reject_origin(self) -> bool:
            if self._origin_allowed():
                return False
            self._json(403, {"error": "This Puffin website origin is not allowed by the Pi service."})
            return True
    
        def _read_json(self) -> dict:
            try:
                length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", "0"))
            except ValueError as error:
                raise ValueError("Invalid Content-Length header.") from error
            if length <= 0 or length > 16_384:
                raise ValueError("Request body must be between 1 byte and 16 KB.")
            try:
                value = json.loads(self.rfile.read(length))
            except json.JSONDecodeError as error:
                raise ValueError("Request body must be valid JSON.") from error
            if not isinstance(value, dict):
                raise ValueError("Request body must be a JSON object.")
            return value
    
        def do_OPTIONS(self) -> None:
            if self._reject_origin():
                return
            self.send_response(204)
            self._cors_headers()
            self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET, POST, DELETE, OPTIONS")
            self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type")
            self.send_header("Access-Control-Max-Age", "86400")
            self.end_headers()
    
        def do_GET(self) -> None:
            if self._reject_origin():
                return
            parsed_path = urlsplit(self.path)
            path_parts = [unquote(part) for part in parsed_path.path.strip("/").split("/")]
    
            if path_parts == ["api", "health"]:
                self._json(200, {"ok": True, "service": "puffin-downloader"})
                return
    
            if path_parts == ["api", "search"]:
                query = parse_qs(parsed_path.query).get("q", [""])[0].strip()
                if not query or len(query) > 200:
                    self._json(400, {"error": "Enter a YouTube search between 1 and 200 characters."})
                    return
                try:
                    videos = _search_youtube(query)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    self._json(504, {"error": "YouTube search timed out. Try again in a moment."})
                    return
                except Exception as error:
                    LOGGER.warning("YouTube search failed: %s", type(error).__name__)
                    self._json(502, {"error": "YouTube search failed. Check the Pi connection and try again."})
                    return
                self._json(200, {"videos": videos})
                return
    
            if len(path_parts) == 3 and path_parts[:2] == ["api", "downloads"]:
                with JOBS_LOCK:
                    job = JOBS.get(path_parts[2])
                    response = _public_job(job) if job else None
                if response is None:
                    self._json(404, {"error": "Download job not found or expired."})
                else:
                    self._json(200, response)
                return
    
            if len(path_parts) == 4 and path_parts[:2] == ["api", "downloads"] and path_parts[3] == "file":
                self._send_job_file(path_parts[2])
                return
    
            self._json(404, {"error": "Endpoint not found."})
    
        def _send_job_file(self, job_id: str) -> None:
            with JOBS_LOCK:
                job = JOBS.get(job_id)
                if not job or job["status"] != "ready":
                    self._json(409, {"error": "The download is not ready."})
                    return
                file_path = Path(job["file_path"])
                filename = job["filename"]
                mime_type = job["mime_type"]
                size = job["size"]
                job["transfers"] += 1
    
            try:
                media_file = file_path.open("rb")
                self.send_response(200)
                self._cors_headers()
                self.send_header("Content-Type", mime_type)
                self.send_header("Content-Length", str(size))
                self.send_header("Content-Disposition", f"attachment; filename*=UTF-8''{quote(filename)}")
                self.send_header("X-Download-Name", quote(filename, safe=""))
                self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-store")
                self.end_headers()
    
                with media_file:
                    while True:
                        chunk = media_file.read(256 * 1024)
                        if not chunk:
                            break
                        self.wfile.write(chunk)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                self._json(410, {"error": "The temporary download file has expired."})
            except (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionResetError):
                LOGGER.info("File transfer for job %s was interrupted; keeping the temporary file for retry.", job_id)
            finally:
                with JOBS_LOCK:
                    current_job = JOBS.get(job_id)
                    if current_job:
                        current_job["transfers"] = max(0, current_job["transfers"] - 1)
    
        def do_POST(self) -> None:
            if self._reject_origin():

            path_parts = [unquote(part) for part in urlsplit(self.path).path.strip("/").split("/")]
    
            if path_parts == ["api", "downloads"]:

                return
    
            if len(path_parts) == 4 and path_parts[:2] == ["api", "downloads"] and path_parts[3] == "complete":
                self._complete_download(path_parts[2])
                return
    
            self._json(404, {"error": "Endpoint not found."})
    
        def _create_download(self) -> None:
            try:
                request = self._read_json()
            except ValueError as error:
                self._json(400, {"error": str(error)})
                return
    
            url = request.get("url")
            kind = request.get("kind")
            if not _is_allowed_media_url(url):
                self._json(400, {"error": "Enter an HTTPS YouTube video URL or a valid YouTube search query."})
                return
            if not isinstance(kind, str) or kind not in {"audio", "video"}:
                self._json(400, {"error": "Choose audio (M4A) or video (MP4)."})
                return
            requested_audio_formats = request.get("supported_audio_formats", [])
            if not isinstance(requested_audio_formats, list):
                requested_audio_formats = []
            supported_audio_formats = [
                extension.lower()
                for extension in requested_audio_formats
                if isinstance(extension, str) and extension.lower() in SUPPORTED_AUDIO_EXTENSIONS
            ]
    
            DOWNLOAD_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            with JOBS_LOCK:
                existing_job = next((
                    job for job in JOBS.values()
                    if job["status"] in {"queued", "downloading", "converting"}
                    or (job["status"] == "ready" and job["transfers"])
                ), None)
                if existing_job:
                    self._json(409, {"error": "Finish or cancel the current Pi download before starting another."})
                    return
    
                # A completed but unconfirmed file is replaceable when another
                # download is requested; the original client's local save failed
                # or it never returned to confirm receipt.
                for old_job_id, old_job in list(JOBS.items()):
                    if old_job["status"] == "ready" and not old_job["transfers"]:
                        _remove_work_directory(old_job)
                        del JOBS[old_job_id]
    
                free_bytes = shutil.disk_usage(DOWNLOAD_DIR).free
                if free_bytes < MIN_FREE_BYTES:
                    self._json(507, {"error": "The Pi is low on free storage. Clear space before downloading."})
                    return
    
                job_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
                work_dir = DOWNLOAD_DIR / job_id
                work_dir.mkdir(mode=0o700)
                job = {
                    "id": job_id,
                    "url": url,
                    "kind": kind,
                    "supported_audio_formats": supported_audio_formats,
                    "status": "queued",
                    "progress": 0,
                    "speed": None,
                    "eta": None,
                    "error": None,
                    "filename": None,
                    "file_path": None,
                    "size": None,
                    "mime_type": None,
                    "work_dir": str(work_dir),
                    "created_at": time.time(),
                    "updated_at": time.time(),
                    "ready_at": None,
                    "process": None,
                    "cancel_requested": False,
                    "transfers": 0,
                }
                JOBS[job_id] = job
    
            threading.Thread(target=_run_download, args=(job_id,), daemon=True).start()

    function formatBytes(bytes) {

        unit += 1;
      }
      return `${value.toFixed(value >= 100 ? 0 : 1)} ${units[unit]}`;

    export function getMediaCapacityState(usedBytes, limitBytes) {
      const safeUsed = Number.isFinite(usedBytes) && usedBytes >= 0 ? usedBytes : 0;
      const safeLimit = Number.isFinite(limitBytes) && limitBytes > 0 ? limitBytes : 0;
      const usagePercent = safeLimit ? (safeUsed / safeLimit) * 100 : 100;
    
      return {
        usedBytes: safeUsed,
        limitBytes: safeLimit,
        remainingBytes: Math.max(0, safeLimit - safeUsed),
        usagePercent,
        isOverLimit: safeUsed > safeLimit,
        isAtLimit: safeUsed >= safeLimit,
      };
    }
    
    export class MediaCapacityError extends Error {
      constructor(message) {
        super(message);
        this.name = "MediaCapacityError";
      }
    }
    
    export function assertMediaFits(usedBytes, limitBytes, incomingBytes) {
      if (!Number.isFinite(incomingBytes) || incomingBytes < 0) {
        throw new Error("The media file size is unavailable, so Puffin could not confirm storage capacity.");
      }
      const capacity = getMediaCapacityState(usedBytes, limitBytes);
      if (capacity.isOverLimit || incomingBytes > capacity.remainingBytes) {
        const available = capacity.isOverLimit ? 0 : capacity.remainingBytes;
        throw new MediaCapacityError(`Not enough Puffin media storage. ${formatBytes(available)} is available, but this file needs ${formatBytes(incomingBytes)}. Delete files or raise the limit.`);
      }
      return capacity;
    }
    
    export async function guardReadyPiDownload({ fileSize, assertCapacity, cancelDownload }) {
      try {
        await assertCapacity(fileSize);
      } catch (capacityError) {
        try {
          await cancelDownload();
        } catch {
          capacityError.message = `${capacityError.message} The Pi could not confirm cleanup; its temporary copy will expire automatically.`;
        }
        throw capacityError;
      }
    }
    
    export function formatBytes(bytes) {
      if (!Number.isFinite(bytes) || bytes < 0) return "Unavailable";
      if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`;
      const units = ["KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"];
      let value = bytes / 1024;
      let unit = 0;
      while (value >= 1024 && unit < units.length - 1) {
        value /= 1024;
        unit += 1;
      }
      return `${value.toFixed(value >= 100 ? 0 : 1)} ${units[unit]}`;
    }

    const stripExtension = (name) => name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, "");

        if (!response.ok) return "";
        const data = await response.json();
        const artwork = data.results?.[0]?.artworkUrl100?.replace("100x100bb", "600x600bb") || "";

      } catch {
        return "";
      }
    }
    
    export function initializeHome({ onPlay }) {

      const previous = document.querySelector("#recent-scroll-left");
      const next = document.querySelector("#recent-scroll-right");
      const picksSection = document.querySelector("#music-picks-section");

      function updateScrollButtons() {
        const canScroll = !recentList.hidden && recentList.scrollWidth > recentList.clientWidth + 2;

        next.disabled = !canScroll || recentList.scrollLeft + recentList.clientWidth >= recentList.scrollWidth - 2;
      }
    
      function renderRecentlyPlayed(records) {
        recentRecords = records;
        recentList.replaceChildren();
        records.forEach((record) => {
          const title = record.title || stripExtension(record.name);
          const item = document.createElement("li");
          item.className = "recently-played-item";
          const button = document.createElement("button");
          button.type = "button";
          button.className = "recent-song-button";
          button.setAttribute("aria-label", `Play ${title}`);
          const artwork = document.createElement("img");
          artwork.className = "recent-song-artwork";
          artwork.src = record.artwork || "/favicon.svg";
          artwork.alt = "";
          artwork.loading = "lazy";
          artwork.addEventListener("error", () => {
            if (!artwork.src.endsWith("/favicon.svg")) artwork.src = "/favicon.svg";

          const titleElement = document.createElement("span");
          titleElement.className = "recent-song-title";
          titleElement.textContent = title;
          button.append(artwork, titleElement);
          button.addEventListener("click", () => onPlay(record));
          item.append(button);
          recentList.append(item);
        });
        const hasRecords = records.length > 0;
        recentList.hidden = !hasRecords;
        recentEmpty.hidden = hasRecords;
        recentEmpty.textContent = "Your recently played music will appear here.";
        recentList.scrollLeft = 0;
        requestAnimationFrame(updateScrollButtons);
      }
    
      function renderRecommendations() {
        const sorted = [...recommendations].sort((a, b) => picksSort.value === "asc" ? a.score - b.score : b.score - a.score);
        picksList.replaceChildren();
        sorted.forEach((track) => {
          const row = document.createElement("li");
          row.className = "music-pick-row";
          const artwork = document.createElement("img");
          artwork.className = "music-pick-artwork";
          artwork.src = track.artwork || "/favicon.svg";
          artwork.alt = "";
          artwork.loading = "lazy";

          const details = document.createElement("div");
          details.className = "music-pick-details";
          const title = document.createElement("strong");
          title.textContent = track.title;

          artist.textContent = track.artist;
          details.append(title, artist);

          download.className = "secondary-button music-pick-download";

          });
          row.append(artwork, details, download);
          picksList.append(row);
        });
        const hasTracks = recommendations.length > 0;
        picksList.hidden = !hasTracks;
        picksStatus.hidden = hasTracks;
        attribution.hidden = !hasTracks;
      }
    
      function applyPreferences(preferences = getHomePreferences()) {
        recentSection.hidden = !preferences.showRecentlyPlayed;
        picksSection.hidden = !preferences.showMusicPicks;
        if (preferences.showMusicPicks) loadRecommendations(preferences);
        else picksRequestId += 1;
      }
    
      async function getSimilarTracks(apiKey, seed, force = false) {
        const key = `${apiKey}:${recommendationKey(seed.artist, seed.title)}`;
        const cached = recommendationCache.get(key);
        if (!force && cached && Date.now() < cached.expiresAt) return cached.data;
        const response = await fetch("https://musicatlas.ai/api/similar_tracks", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", Authorization: `Bearer ${apiKey}` },
          body: JSON.stringify({ artist: seed.artist, track: seed.title }),

    const DEFAULT_PREFERENCES = {
      showRecentlyPlayed: true,
      showMusicPicks: true,
      musicAtlasApiKey: "",
    };
    
    export function getHomePreferences() {
      try {
        const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(PREFERENCES_KEY) || "{}");
        return {
          showRecentlyPlayed: saved.showRecentlyPlayed !== false,
          showMusicPicks: saved.showMusicPicks !== false,
          musicAtlasApiKey: typeof saved.musicAtlasApiKey === "string" ? saved.musicAtlasApiKey : "",
        };
      } catch {
        return { ...DEFAULT_PREFERENCES };
      }
    }
    
    export function saveHomePreferences(preferences) {
      const next = {
        showRecentlyPlayed: Boolean(preferences.showRecentlyPlayed),
        showMusicPicks: Boolean(preferences.showMusicPicks),
        musicAtlasApiKey: String(preferences.musicAtlasApiKey || "").trim(),
      };
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(PREFERENCES_KEY, JSON.stringify(next));
      } catch {
        throw new Error("Puffin couldn’t save Home preferences on this device.");
      }

    const CACHE_NAME = "puffin-shell-v16";
    const APP_SHELL = [
      "/",
      "/index.html",
      "/manifest.webmanifest",
      "/favicon.svg",
      "/icons/puffin-app-180.png",
      "/icons/puffin-app-192.png",
      "/icons/puffin-app-512.png",
    ];
    
    async function cacheModuleGraph(cache, moduleUrl, visited = new Set()) {
      if (visited.has(moduleUrl)) return;
      visited.add(moduleUrl);
    
      const response = await fetch(moduleUrl);
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Could not cache app module: ${moduleUrl}`);
    
      const source = await response.clone().text();
      await cache.put(moduleUrl, response);
    
      const importPaths = Array.from(
        source.matchAll(/\b(?:import|export)\s+(?:[^'";]*?\s+from\s+)?["']([^"']+)["']/g),
        (match) => match[1],
      );
    
      await Promise.all(importPaths.map((importPath) => {
        const importUrl = new URL(importPath, moduleUrl);
        if (importUrl.origin !== self.location.origin) return Promise.resolve();
        return cacheModuleGraph(cache, importUrl.href, visited);
      }));
    }
    
    self.addEventListener("install", (event) => {
      event.waitUntil((async () => {
        const cache = await caches.open(CACHE_NAME);
        await cache.addAll(APP_SHELL);
    
        const indexResponse = await fetch("/index.html");
        const indexHtml = await indexResponse.text();
        const assetUrls = [];
        const moduleUrls = [];
    
        for (const match of indexHtml.matchAll(/<(?:script|link)\b[^>]*>/gi)) {
          const tag = match[0];
          const isModuleScript = /<script\b/i.test(tag) && /\btype=["']module["']/i.test(tag);
          const isStylesheet = /<link\b/i.test(tag)
            && (/\brel=["']stylesheet["']/i.test(tag) || /\brel=["']modulepreload["']/i.test(tag));
          if (!isModuleScript && !isStylesheet) continue;
    
          const assetPath = tag.match(/\b(?:src|href)=["']([^"']+)["']/i)?.[1];
          if (!assetPath) continue;
    
          const assetUrl = new URL(assetPath, self.location.origin);
          if (assetUrl.origin !== self.location.origin) continue;
          if (isModuleScript) moduleUrls.push(assetUrl.href);
          else assetUrls.push(assetUrl.href);
        }
    
        await cache.addAll([...new Set(assetUrls)]);
        const visitedModules = new Set();
        await Promise.all(moduleUrls.map((moduleUrl) => cacheModuleGraph(cache, moduleUrl, visitedModules)));
        await self.skipWaiting();
      })());
    });
    
    self.addEventListener("activate", (event) => {
      event.waitUntil(
        caches.keys()
          .then((cacheNames) => Promise.all(
            cacheNames
              .filter((cacheName) => cacheName.startsWith("puffin-shell-") && cacheName !== CACHE_NAME)
              .map((cacheName) => caches.delete(cacheName)),
          ))
          .then(() => self.clients.claim()),
      );
    });
    
    self.addEventListener("fetch", (event) => {
      const { request } = event;
      const requestUrl = new URL(request.url);
    
      if (request.method !== "GET" || requestUrl.origin !== self.location.origin) return;
    
      const isNavigation = request.mode === "navigate";
      const isAppShellAsset = APP_SHELL.includes(requestUrl.pathname)
        || request.destination === "script"
        || request.destination === "style";
      if (!isNavigation && !isAppShellAsset) return;
    
      event.respondWith(
        fetch(request)
          .then(async (response) => {
            if (response.ok) {
              await caches.open(CACHE_NAME).then((cache) => cache.put(request, response.clone()));
            }
            return response;
          })
          .catch(async () => {
            const cachedResponse = await caches.match(request);
            if (cachedResponse) return cachedResponse;
    
            if (isNavigation) {
              const cachedApp = await caches.match("/index.html");
              if (cachedApp) return cachedApp;
            }
    
            return new Response("Puffin is offline and this item is not cached yet.", {
              status: 503,
              headers: { "Content-Type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8" },
            });
          }),
      );
    });

    import assert from "node:assert/strict";
    import test from "node:test";
    import { assertMediaFits, getMediaCapacityState, guardReadyPiDownload } from "../src/media-capacity.js";
    
    test("imports may use the last byte of the configured media limit", () => {
      const state = assertMediaFits(900, 1000, 100);
    
      assert.equal(state.remainingBytes, 100);
      assert.equal(getMediaCapacityState(1000, 1000).isAtLimit, true);
    });
    
    test("an import is rejected before it can exceed the configured limit", () => {
      assert.throws(
        () => assertMediaFits(900, 1000, 101),
        /Not enough Puffin media storage/,
      );
    });
    
    test("an over-limit existing library rejects additional imports", () => {
      const state = getMediaCapacityState(1200, 1000);
    
      assert.equal(state.isOverLimit, true);
      assert.throws(() => assertMediaFits(state.usedBytes, state.limitBytes, 1), /Not enough Puffin media storage/);
    });
    
    test("a Pi download that will not fit is cancelled before transfer", async () => {
      let cancelled = false;
      await assert.rejects(
        guardReadyPiDownload({
          fileSize: 101,
          assertCapacity: async () => { throw new Error("Media limit reached"); },
          cancelDownload: async () => { cancelled = true; },
        }),
        /Media limit reached/,
      );
    
      assert.equal(cancelled, true);
    });
    
    test("a Pi download that fits is allowed and is not cancelled", async () => {
      let cancelled = false;
      await guardReadyPiDownload({
        fileSize: 100,
        assertCapacity: async () => ({ remainingBytes: 100 }),
        cancelDownload: async () => { cancelled = true; },
      });
    
      assert.equal(cancelled, false);
    });
    
    test("Pi cleanup problems are included in the capacity error", async () => {
      await assert.rejects(
        guardReadyPiDownload({
          fileSize: 101,
          assertCapacity: async () => { throw new Error("Media limit reached"); },
          cancelDownload: async () => { throw new Error("Network unavailable"); },
        }),
        /temporary copy will expire automatically/,
      );
    });

        def _send_job_file(self, job_id: str) -> None:
            with JOBS_LOCK:
                job = JOBS.get(job_id)
                if not job or job["status"] != "ready":
                    self._json(409, {"error": "The download is not ready."})
                    return

    let databasePromise;
    
    export function getMediaStorageLimit() {
      try {
        const savedLimit = Number(localStorage.getItem(MEDIA_STORAGE_LIMIT_KEY));
        if (Number.isFinite(savedLimit) && savedLimit > 0) return savedLimit;
      } catch {
        // Use Puffin's default when local preferences are unavailable.
      }
      return DEFAULT_MEDIA_STORAGE_LIMIT_BYTES;
    }
    
    export function setMediaStorageLimit(bytes) {
      if (!Number.isFinite(bytes) || bytes < 100 * 1024 ** 2 || bytes > 1000 * 1024 ** 3) {
        throw new Error("Choose a media storage limit between 0.1 and 1000 GB.");
      }

        localStorage.setItem(MEDIA_STORAGE_LIMIT_KEY, String(bytes));

      m4a: "audio/mp4",
      mp3: "audio/mpeg",
      oga: "audio/ogg",

      ogv: "video/ogg",
      webm: "video/webm",
    };
    
    function openDatabase() {
      if (databasePromise) return databasePromise;
    
      databasePromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const request = indexedDB.open(DATABASE_NAME, DATABASE_VERSION);
    
        request.onupgradeneeded = () => {
          const database = request.result;
          if (!database.objectStoreNames.contains(TRACKS_STORE)) {
            database.createObjectStore(TRACKS_STORE, { keyPath: "id" });
          }
          if (!database.objectStoreNames.contains(FILES_STORE)) {
            database.createObjectStore(FILES_STORE);
          }
          if (!database.objectStoreNames.contains(PLAYLISTS_STORE)) {
            database.createObjectStore(PLAYLISTS_STORE, { keyPath: "id" });
          }
          if (!database.objectStoreNames.contains(HISTORY_STORE)) {
            database.createObjectStore(HISTORY_STORE, { keyPath: "id" });
          }
          if (!database.objectStoreNames.contains(STATS_STORE)) {
            database.createObjectStore(STATS_STORE, { keyPath: "key" });
          }
        };
    
        request.onsuccess = () => {
          const database = request.result;
          database.onversionchange = () => database.close();
          resolve(database);
        };
    
        request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
        request.onblocked = () => reject(new Error("Puffin's library database is blocked by another open tab."));

      });
    
      return databasePromise;
    }

      return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        transaction.oncomplete = () => resolve();
        transaction.onerror = () => reject(transaction.error || new Error("The library transaction failed."));

      });

      const videoExtensions = new Set(["mp4", "m4v", "mov", "webm", "ogv", "mkv", "avi"]);
      const audioExtensions = new Set(["mp3", "m4a", "aac", "wav", "flac", "ogg", "oga", "opus", "aiff"]);
    
      if (videoExtensions.has(extension)) return "video";
      if (audioExtensions.has(extension)) return "audio";

    export async function listPlaylists() {

      const transaction = database.transaction(PLAYLISTS_STORE, "readonly");
      const request = transaction.objectStore(PLAYLISTS_STORE).getAll();
    
      return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result.sort((first, second) => {
          if (first.pinned !== second.pinned) return Number(second.pinned) - Number(first.pinned);
          return first.createdAt - second.createdAt;
        }));
        request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
      });
    }
    
    async function savePlaylistName(id, name) {
      const normalizedName = name.trim().replace(/\s+/g, " ");
      if (!normalizedName) throw new Error("Enter a playlist name.");
    
      const database = await openDatabase();
      const transaction = database.transaction(PLAYLISTS_STORE, "readwrite");
      const completion = transactionComplete(transaction);
      const store = transaction.objectStore(PLAYLISTS_STORE);
      const request = store.getAll();
      request.onsuccess = () => {
        const duplicate = request.result.some((playlist) =>
          playlist.id !== id && playlist.name.toLocaleLowerCase() === normalizedName.toLocaleLowerCase());
        if (duplicate) {
          transaction.abort();
          return;
        }
    
        if (id) {
          const playlist = request.result.find((item) => item.id === id);
          if (!playlist) {
            transaction.abort();
            return;
          }
          playlist.name = normalizedName;
          playlist.updatedAt = Date.now();
          store.put(playlist);
        } else {
          const now = Date.now();
          store.add({
            id: crypto.randomUUID?.() || `${now}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}`,
            name: normalizedName,
            pinned: false,
            mediaIds: [],
            createdAt: now,
            updatedAt: now,
          });
        }
      };
    
      try {
        await completion;
      } catch (error) {
        if (error?.name === "AbortError") {
          const playlists = await listPlaylists();
          if (playlists.some((playlist) => playlist.id !== id && playlist.name.toLocaleLowerCase() === normalizedName.toLocaleLowerCase())) {
            throw new Error("A playlist with that name already exists.");
          }
          throw new Error("That playlist no longer exists.");
        }
        throw error;
      }
    }
    
    export function createPlaylist(name) {
      return savePlaylistName(null, name);
    }
    
    export function renamePlaylist(id, name) {
      return savePlaylistName(id, name);
    }

      const database = await openDatabase();
      const transaction = database.transaction(PLAYLISTS_STORE, "readwrite");
      const completion = transactionComplete(transaction);
      transaction.objectStore(PLAYLISTS_STORE).delete(id);
      await completion;
    }
    
    export async function setPlaylistPinned(id, pinned) {
      const database = await openDatabase();
      const transaction = database.transaction(PLAYLISTS_STORE, "readwrite");
      const completion = transactionComplete(transaction);
      const store = transaction.objectStore(PLAYLISTS_STORE);
      const request = store.get(id);
      request.onsuccess = () => {
        if (!request.result) {
          transaction.abort();
          return;
        }
        request.result.pinned = pinned;
        request.result.updatedAt = Date.now();
        store.put(request.result);
      };
      await completion;
    }
    
    export async function addMediaToPlaylist(playlistId, mediaId) {
      const database = await openDatabase();
      const transaction = database.transaction([PLAYLISTS_STORE, TRACKS_STORE], "readwrite");
      const completion = transactionComplete(transaction);
      const playlistStore = transaction.objectStore(PLAYLISTS_STORE);
      const playlistRequest = playlistStore.get(playlistId);
      playlistRequest.onsuccess = () => {
        const playlist = playlistRequest.result;
        if (!playlist) {
          transaction.abort();
          return;
        }
        const mediaRequest = transaction.objectStore(TRACKS_STORE).get(mediaId);
        mediaRequest.onsuccess = () => {
          if (!mediaRequest.result) {
            transaction.abort();
            return;
          }
          if (!playlist.mediaIds.includes(mediaId)) {
            playlist.mediaIds.push(mediaId);
            playlist.updatedAt = Date.now();
            playlistStore.put(playlist);
          }
        };
      };
      await completion;
    }
    
    export async function removeMediaFromPlaylist(playlistId, mediaId) {
      const database = await openDatabase();
      const transaction = database.transaction(PLAYLISTS_STORE, "readwrite");
      const completion = transactionComplete(transaction);
      const store = transaction.objectStore(PLAYLISTS_STORE);
      const request = store.get(playlistId);
      request.onsuccess = () => {
        if (!request.result) return;
        request.result.mediaIds = request.result.mediaIds.filter((id) => id !== mediaId);
        request.result.updatedAt = Date.now();
        store.put(request.result);
      };

    }

        def _create_download(self) -> None:
            try:
                request = self._read_json()
            except ValueError as error:
                self._json(400, {"error": str(error)})
                return
    
            url = request.get("url")
            kind = request.get("kind")
            if not _is_allowed_media_url(url):

                return
            if not isinstance(kind, str) or kind not in {"audio", "video"}:
                self._json(400, {"error": "Choose audio (M4A) or video (MP4)."})
                return
            requested_audio_formats = request.get("supported_audio_formats", [])
            if not isinstance(requested_audio_formats, list):
                requested_audio_formats = []
            supported_audio_formats = [
                extension.lower()
                for extension in requested_audio_formats
                if isinstance(extension, str) and extension.lower() in SUPPORTED_AUDIO_EXTENSIONS
            ]
    
            DOWNLOAD_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            with JOBS_LOCK:
                existing_job = next((
                    job for job in JOBS.values()
                    if job["status"] in {"queued", "downloading", "converting"}
                    or (job["status"] == "ready" and job["transfers"])
                ), None)
                if existing_job:
                    self._json(409, {"error": "Finish or cancel the current Pi download before starting another."})
                    return
    
                # A completed but unconfirmed file is replaceable when another
                # download is requested; the original client's local save failed
                # or it never returned to confirm receipt.
                for old_job_id, old_job in list(JOBS.items()):
                    if old_job["status"] == "ready" and not old_job["transfers"]:
                        _remove_work_directory(old_job)
                        del JOBS[old_job_id]
    
                free_bytes = shutil.disk_usage(DOWNLOAD_DIR).free
                if free_bytes < MIN_FREE_BYTES:

                    return
    
                job_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
                work_dir = DOWNLOAD_DIR / job_id

                job = {
                    "id": job_id,

        def _complete_download(self, job_id: str) -> None:
            with JOBS_LOCK:
                job = JOBS.get(job_id)
                if not job:
                    self._json(404, {"error": "Download job not found or expired."})
                    return
                if job["status"] != "ready":
                    self._json(409, {"error": "Only a ready download can be confirmed."})
                    return
                if job["transfers"]:
                    self._json(409, {"error": "Wait for the file transfer to finish before confirming it."})
                    return
                _remove_work_directory(job)
                del JOBS[job_id]
    
            LOGGER.info("Puffin confirmed and removed download job %s", job_id)
            self._no_content()
    
        def do_DELETE(self) -> None:
            if self._reject_origin():
                return
            path_parts = [unquote(part) for part in urlsplit(self.path).path.strip("/").split("/")]
            if len(path_parts) != 3 or path_parts[:2] != ["api", "downloads"]:
                self._json(404, {"error": "Endpoint not found."})
                return
    
            job_id = path_parts[2]
            with JOBS_LOCK:
                job = JOBS.get(job_id)
                if not job:
                    self._json(404, {"error": "Download job not found or expired."})
                    return
                if job["transfers"]:
                    self._json(409, {"error": "Wait for the current file transfer to finish before cancelling."})
                    return
                job["cancel_requested"] = True
                process = job.get("process")
                if process and process.poll() is None:
                    process.terminate()
                if job["status"] == "ready":
                    _remove_work_directory(job)
                    del JOBS[job_id]
                elif process and process.poll() is None:
                    # Keep the job active until yt-dlp exits so another job cannot overlap it.
                    pass
                else:
                    job["status"] = "cancelled"
                    job["updated_at"] = time.time()
                    _remove_work_directory(job)
    
            self._no_content(202)
    
    
    def _remove_stale_files() -> None:
        """Clear abandoned Puffin job folders without touching unrelated files."""
        DOWNLOAD_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        for path in DOWNLOAD_DIR.iterdir():
            if path.is_dir() and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{32}", path.name):
                shutil.rmtree(path, ignore_errors=True)

      function formatDuration(seconds) {
        if (!Number.isFinite(Number(seconds)) || Number(seconds) < 0) return "Duration unavailable";
        const total = Math.floor(Number(seconds));
        const hours = Math.floor(total / 3600);
        const minutes = Math.floor((total % 3600) / 60);
        const remainder = total % 60;
        return hours
          ? `${hours}:${String(minutes).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(remainder).padStart(2, "0")}`
