       504          return;
       505        }
       506        submitButton.disabled = true;
       507        cancelButton.hidden = false;
       508        cancelButton.disabled = false;
       509        activeDownload = { cancelled: false, controller: new AbortController() };
       510        progress.hidden = false;
       511        progress.value = 0;
       512        progressDetails.hidden = false;
       513        progressDetails.textContent = "Preparing download…";
       514
       515        let baseUrl;
       516        let jobId;
       517        let savedLocally = false;
       518        let transferStarted = false;
       519
       520        try {
       521          baseUrl = getPiBaseUrl(piAddress.value);
       522          const capacity = await getMediaStorageCapacity();
       523          if (capacity.remainingBytes <= 0) {
       524            throw new Error("Puffin media storage limit reached. Delete files or raise the limit before downloading.");
       525          }
       526          setStatus(status, "Connecting to the Pi…");
       527          await checkPi(baseUrl);
       528
       529          const downloadTarget = /^https?:\/\//i.test(entered)
       530            ? entered
       531            : (entered.startsWith("ytsearch:") || entered.startsWith("ytsearch1:") ? entered : `ytsearch:${entered}`);
       532          const job = await requestJson(baseUrl, "/api/downloads", {
       533            method: "POST",
       534            headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
       535            body: JSON.stringify({
       536              url: downloadTarget,
       537              kind: downloadKind.value,
       538              supported_audio_formats: downloadKind.value === "audio" ? getSupportedAudioFormats() : [],
       539            }),
       540          });
       541          jobId = job.id;
       542          activeDownload.baseUrl = baseUrl;
       543          activeDownload.jobId = jobId;
       544          if (activeDownload.cancelled) {
       545            await cancelPiDownload(baseUrl, jobId);
       546            throw new DOMException("Download cancelled.", "AbortError");
       547          }
       548
       549          let currentJob = job;
       550          while (["queued", "downloading", "converting"].includes(currentJob.status)) {
       551            progress.value = currentJob.progress || 0;
       552            if (currentJob.status === "queued") {
       553              setStatus(status, "Pi download queued…");
       554              progressDetails.textContent = "Waiting for the Pi to start the download…";
       555            }
       556            else if (currentJob.status === "converting") {
       557              setStatus(status, "Converting media on the Pi…");
       558              progressDetails.textContent = "Converting media on the Pi…";
       559            }
       560            else if (currentJob.progress) {
       561              setStatus(status, `Downloading on the Pi · ${Math.round(currentJob.progress)}%`);
       562              const details = [currentJob.speed, currentJob.eta ? `${currentJob.eta} remaining` : ""].filter(Boolean);
       563              progressDetails.textContent = details.length ? details.join(" · ") : "Calculating transfer speed and remaining time…";
       564            }
       565            else setStatus(status, "Downloading on the Pi…");
       566
       567            await sleep(1200);
       568            currentJob = await requestJson(baseUrl, `/api/downloads/${jobId}`);
       569          }
       570
       571          if (currentJob.status !== "ready") {
       572            throw new Error(currentJob.error || "The Pi download did not finish.");
       573          }
       574
       575          try {
       576            await guardReadyPiDownload({
       577              fileSize: currentJob.size,
       578              assertCapacity: assertMediaStorageCapacity,
       579              cancelDownload: () => cancelPiDownload(baseUrl, jobId),
       580            });
       581          } catch (error) {
       582            jobId = null;
       583            throw error;
       584          }
       585
       586          progress.value = 100;
       587          progressDetails.textContent = "Download complete · Saving to your Puffin library";
       588          setStatus(status, "Receiving file from the Pi…");
       589          transferStarted = true;
       590          const fileResponse = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/api/downloads/${jobId}/file`, { signal: activeDownload.controller.signal });
       591          if (!fileResponse.ok) {
       592            const payload = await responsePayload(fileResponse);
       593            throw new Error(payload.error || `File transfer failed (${fileResponse.status}).`);
       594          }
       595
       596          const piMedia = await readDirectMedia(fileResponse, youtubeUrl.value.trim(), capacity, ({ received, total, speed, eta }) => {
       597            progress.value = total ? Math.min(100, (received / total) * 100) : 0;
       598            if (!total) progress.removeAttribute("value");
       599            else progress.setAttribute("value", String(progress.value));
       600            const amount = total ? `${formatBytes(received)} of ${formatBytes(total)}` : `${formatBytes(received)} received`;
       601            progressDetails.textContent = `${amount} · ${formatBytes(speed)}/s · ${eta === null ? "time remaining unavailable" : `${formatTime(eta)} remaining`}`;
       602            setStatus(status, "Receiving file from the Pi…");
       603          });
       604          if (activeDownload.cancelled) throw new DOMException("Download cancelled.", "AbortError");
       605          cancelButton.disabled = true;
       606          const mediaBlob = piMedia.blob;
       607          setStatus(status, "Saving to this device…");
       608          const encodedName = fileResponse.headers.get("X-Download-Name");
       609          let filename = piMedia.name || `puffin-download.${downloadKind.value === "audio" ? "m4a" : "mp4"}`;
       610          if (encodedName) {
       611            try {
       612              filename = decodeURIComponent(encodedName);
       613            } catch {
       614              filename = encodedName;
       615            }
       616          } else if (currentJob.filename) {
       617            filename = currentJob.filename;
       618          }
       619
       620          try {
       621            if (navigator.storage?.persist) await navigator.storage.persist();
       622          } catch {
       623            // IndexedDB can still save the file when persistent storage is unavailable.
       624          }
       625          await saveMediaFile(mediaBlob, { name: filename, type: currentJob.mime_type || mediaBlob.type });
       626          savedLocally = true;
       627          recordPuffinActivity("downloads").catch((statsError) => console.warn("Could not record completed download:", statsError));
       628          window.dispatchEvent(new Event("puffin:library-updated"));
       629
       630          try {
       631            const cleanedUp = await confirmPiSavedFile(baseUrl, jobId);
       632            if (cleanedUp) setStatus(status, "Saved to your Puffin library on this device.");
       633            else setStatus(status, "Saved locally. The Pi will remove its temporary copy after it expires.");
       634          } catch {
       635            setStatus(status, "Saved locally. The Pi could not confirm cleanup; its temporary copy will expire automatically.");
       636          }
       637        } catch (error) {
       638          if (csvBatch && !activeDownload.cancelled) csvBatch.failed += 1;
       639          setStatus(status, activeDownload.cancelled || error.name === "AbortError" ? "Download cancelled. Partial transfer was discarded."
       640            : error.message || "The download failed.");
       641          if (jobId && !savedLocally && !activeDownload.cancelled && !(error instanceof MediaCapacityError)) {
       642            recordPuffinActivity("failedJobs", 1, error.message || "The download failed.").catch((statsError) => console.warn("Could not record download failure:", statsError));
       643          }
       644          if (jobId && baseUrl && !savedLocally && !activeDownload.cancelled) {
       645            if (transferStarted && error instanceof MediaCapacityError) {
       646              try {
       647                await cancelPiDownload(baseUrl, jobId);
       648              } catch {
       649                setStatus(status, `${error.message} The Pi could not confirm cleanup; its temporary copy will expire automatically.`);
       650              }
       651            } else if (transferStarted) {
       652              // Keep completed files on the Pi for retry if transfer or browser storage fails.
       653              setStatus(status, `${error.message || "The transfer failed."} The Pi will keep its temporary copy for up to one hour.`);
       654            } else {
       655              fetch(`${baseUrl}/api/downloads/${jobId}`, { method: "DELETE" }).catch(() => {});
       656            }
       657          }
       658        } finally {
       659          const wasCancelled = activeDownload?.cancelled;
       660          submitButton.disabled = false;
       661          cancelButton.hidden = true;
       662          cancelButton.disabled = false;
       663          activeDownload = null;
       664          progress.hidden = true;
       665          progressDetails.hidden = true;
       666          if (csvBatch) {
       667            if (wasCancelled) csvBatch.cancelled = true;
       668            else csvBatch.index += 1;
       669            window.setTimeout(startNextCsvTrack, 300);
       670          }
       671        }
       672      });

        44        "m4a": "audio/mp4",

        55    def _is_allowed_media_url(value: object) -> bool:
        56        if not isinstance(value, str) or len(value) > 4096:
        57            return False
        58        if value.startswith(("ytsearch:", "ytsearch1:")):
        59            query = value.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
        60            return bool(query) and len(query) <= 1000 and not any(ord(character) < 32 for character in query)
        61        try:
        62            parsed = urlsplit(value)
        63            hostname = (parsed.hostname or "").lower().rstrip(".")
        64            port = parsed.port
        65        except ValueError:
        66            return False
        67
        68        youtube_host = hostname == "youtu.be" or hostname == "youtube.com" or hostname.endswith(".youtube.com")
        69        return parsed.scheme == "https" and port in {None, 443} and not parsed.username and not parsed.password and youtube_host
        70
        71
        72    def _safe_filename(path: Path) -> str:
        73        name = path.name.replace("\r", "").replace("\n", "").replace('"', "'")
        74        return name or "puffin-media"
        75
        76
        77    def _ensure_supported_audio(path: Path, supported_formats: list[str], job: dict) -> Path:
        78        extension = path.suffix.lower().lstrip(".")
        79        if extension in supported_formats and extension in SUPPORTED_AUDIO_EXTENSIONS:
        80            return path
        81
        82        output_path = path.with_suffix(".m4a")
        83        with JOBS_LOCK:
        84            job["status"] = "converting"
        85            job["progress"] = 99
        86            job["updated_at"] = time.time()
        87
        88        common_args = ["ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-y", "-i", str(path), "-vn"]
        89        copied = subprocess.run(
        90            [*common_args, "-c:a", "copy", "-movflags", "+faststart", str(output_path)],
        91            capture_output=True,
        92            text=True,
        93        )
        94        if copied.returncode != 0:
        95            encoded = subprocess.run(
        96                [*common_args, "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "192k", "-movflags", "+faststart", str(output_path)],
        97                capture_output=True,
        98                text=True,
        99            )
       100            if encoded.returncode != 0:
       101                raise RuntimeError("Could not convert this audio to a Puffin-compatible M4A file")
       102
       103        path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
       104        return output_path

       107    def _public_job(job: dict) -> dict:
       108        return {
       109            "id": job["id"],
       110            "status": job["status"],
       111            "progress": job["progress"],
       112            "speed": job.get("speed"),
       113            "eta": job.get("eta"),
       114            "kind": job["kind"],
       115            "filename": job.get("filename"),
       116            "size": job.get("size"),
       117            "mime_type": job.get("mime_type"),
       118            "error": job.get("error"),
       119        }

       122    def _search_youtube(query: str) -> list[dict]:
       123        command = [
       124            "yt-dlp",
       125            "--dump-single-json",
       126            "--flat-playlist",
       127            "--skip-download",
       128            "--quiet",
       129            "--no-warnings",
       130            f"ytsearch10:{query}",
       131        ]
       132        result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30, check=True)
       133        payload = json.loads(result.stdout)
       134        videos = []
       135        for entry in payload.get("entries") or []:
       136            video_id = entry.get("id")
       137            if not video_id:
       138                continue
       139            thumbnails = entry.get("thumbnails") or []
       140            thumbnail = entry.get("thumbnail") or (thumbnails[-1].get("url") if thumbnails else None)
       141            videos.append({
       142                "id": video_id,
       143                "url": f"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={quote(str(video_id), safe='')}",
       144                "title": entry.get("title") or "Untitled video",
       145                "channel": entry.get("uploader") or entry.get("channel") or "Unknown channel",
       146                "duration": entry.get("duration"),
       147                "thumbnail": thumbnail,
       148            })
       149            if len(videos) == 10:
       150                break

       221      const database = await openDatabase();
       222      const transaction = database.transaction([TRACKS_STORE, FILES_STORE, PLAYLISTS_STORE], "readwrite");
       223      const completion = transactionComplete(transaction);
       224      transaction.objectStore(TRACKS_STORE).delete(id);
       225      transaction.objectStore(FILES_STORE).delete(id);
       226      const playlists = transaction.objectStore(PLAYLISTS_STORE);

       233            playlists.put(playlist);

       235        });
       236      };
       237      await completion;

## Assistant

## Architecture

Puffin is a vanilla JavaScript PWA built with Vite. Vercel serves the frontend from `web/`; downloads go to a separate Python service on a Raspberry Pi, intended to be reachable through Tailscale Serve. The app has no frontend framework or backend database.

The main frontend entry point is [web/index.html](/Users/admin/Desktop/Puffin/web/index.html), which defines the tabs, player, settings, and dialogs. It loads [main.js](/Users/admin/Desktop/Puffin/web/src/main.js), which wires navigation and playback, then initializes the feature modules:

- `downloader.js` handles YouTube search and downloads, including CSV batches.
- `library.js` stores media, metadata, playlists, history, and statistics in IndexedDB.
- `playlist-library.js` renders the local library and playlists.
- `edit.js`, `home.js`, `stats.js`, and `settings.js` implement their respective screens.
- `styles.css` contains the app’s styling; `web/public/sw.js` caches the app shell for offline use.
- `pi-service/app.py` implements the Pi API. `vercel.json` points Vercel at the Vite app in `web/`.

## How media flows through the app

1. The user enters a YouTube URL or search phrase, browses results, or selects rows from a CSV. YouTube search is performed by the Pi service using `yt-dlp`.
2. The browser sends a download request and polls the Pi for job status. The service limits concurrent work to one download or transfer, enforces a temporary file size limit and free-space reserve, and expires unconfirmed jobs after an hour.
3. For audio, `yt-dlp` selects the best audio stream. Puffin tells the Pi which extensions the browser reports it can play. If the source format isn’t supported, the Pi uses FFmpeg to remux to M4A where possible, or encode AAC at 192 kb/s. For video, it requests H.264 video with AAC audio and produces MP4; it errors if those streams aren’t available.
4. The browser streams the result into memory, checks Puffin’s configured media limit, and saves the media blob and its record to IndexedDB. After a successful save, it confirms completion so the Pi deletes its temporary copy.
5. Playback reads the blob from IndexedDB, creates an object URL, and plays it in an HTML audio or video element. Imported files stay in their original formats, so playback depends on the browser’s codec support.

Metadata edits update the record in IndexedDB; Smart Fill queries MusicBrainz. They do not appear to write tags into the media file itself. The library is local to each device, with no synchronization.

## Main files and entry points

- [web/src/main.js](/Users/admin/Desktop/Puffin/web/src/main.js): tab routing, player controls, listening-time tracking, module startup, and service worker registration.
- [web/src/downloader.js](/Users/admin/Desktop/Puffin/web/src/downloader.js): request, polling, transfer, local save, cleanup, search, and CSV batch flow.
- [web/src/library.js](/Users/admin/Desktop/Puffin/web/src/library.js): IndexedDB schema and operations for media and user data.
- [pi-service/app.py](/Users/admin/Desktop/Puffin/pi-service/app.py): API endpoints, job lifecycle, `yt-dlp`, FFmpeg conversion, and temporary-file cleanup.
- [web/src/playlist-library.js](/Users/admin/Desktop/Puffin/web/src/playlist-library.js): library and playlist UI.
- [web/src/edit.js](/Users/admin/Desktop/Puffin/web/src/edit.js): metadata editing and MusicBrainz lookup.
- [README.md](/Users/admin/Desktop/Puffin/README.md) and [pi-service/README.md](/Users/admin/Desktop/Puffin/pi-service/README.md): feature descriptions and deployment instructions.

## Potential issues and technical debt

- The README describes an equalizer, visualizer, shuffle/repeat, and queue controls. I couldn’t find corresponding implementation in the current UI or source, so those descriptions may be stale.
- The Pi service keeps jobs in memory and has no API authentication. The design relies on keeping it private behind Tailscale; CORS only restricts browser access and is not authentication.
- The browser’s `canPlayType()` response is used to choose audio formats, but codec support can vary by browser and device. The local storage limit is also Puffin’s own setting; the browser may enforce a lower quota.
- The frontend modules share a large DOM defined in one HTML file and communicate through custom window events. This works, but makes changes across features tightly coupled.
- `yt-dlp` is unpinned in `requirements.txt`, and FFmpeg is an external system dependency documented separately. Reproducing a specific deployment may depend on the versions installed on the Pi.
- Audio conversion runs in a subprocess that isn’t tracked as the active job process. A cancellation during conversion may not stop FFmpeg promptly.
- The only checked-in test file covers media capacity helpers; I did not run tests as part of this read-only review.

The working tree already reports `yt-dlp_player.py` as deleted. I did not modify any files.

    const tabButtons = document.querySelectorAll("[data-tab]");
    const panels = document.querySelectorAll("[data-panel]");
    
    tabButtons.forEach((button) => {
      button.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const selectedTab = button.dataset.tab;
    
        tabButtons.forEach((tab) => {
          if (tab === button) tab.setAttribute("aria-current", "page");
          else tab.removeAttribute("aria-current");
        });
    
        panels.forEach((panel) => {
          panel.hidden = panel.dataset.panel !== selectedTab;
        });
    
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("puffin:tab-changed", { detail: selectedTab }));
      });
    });

## Assistant

The player already uses local audio/video elements and has a responsive dock. I’m adding the equalizer as a separate player control panel, with ten frequency bands, preamp, the README’s four presets, and saved custom presets. It will process both audio and video through Web Audio and retain its settings on the device.

    const STORAGE_KEY = "puffin.equalizer";
    const FREQUENCIES = [31, 62, 125, 250, 500, 1000, 2000, 4000, 8000, 16000];
    const FLAT = Array(10).fill(0);
    const BUILT_IN_PRESETS = {
      Flat: FLAT,
      Rock: [4, 3, 1, -1, -2, 1, 3, 4, 4, 3],
      Pop: [-1, 1, 3, 4, 2, -1, -1, 1, 2, 2],
      Classical: [3, 2, 1, 0, -1, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3],
      "Vocal Boost": [-2, -1, 1, 3, 4, 4, 3, 1, 0, -1],
    };
    
    function clampGain(value) {
      const gain = Number(value);
      return Number.isFinite(gain) ? Math.max(-12, Math.min(12, Math.round(gain))) : 0;
    }
    
    function readSavedState() {
      try {
        const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) || "{}");
        return {
          enabled: saved.enabled !== false,
          preamp: clampGain(saved.preamp),
          bands: Array.isArray(saved.bands) && saved.bands.length === FREQUENCIES.length
            ? saved.bands.map(clampGain)
            : [...FLAT],
          preset: typeof saved.preset === "string" ? saved.preset : "Flat",
          customPresets: Array.isArray(saved.customPresets)
            ? saved.customPresets.filter((preset) => typeof preset?.name === "string"
              && Array.isArray(preset.bands) && preset.bands.length === FREQUENCIES.length)
              .map((preset) => ({
                name: preset.name.slice(0, 40),
                preamp: clampGain(preset.preamp),
                bands: preset.bands.map(clampGain),
              }))
            : [],
        };
      } catch {
        return { enabled: true, preamp: 0, bands: [...FLAT], preset: "Flat", customPresets: [] };
      }
    }
    
    export function initializeEqualizer({ audioPlayer, videoPlayer }) {
      const openButton = document.querySelector("#player-equalizer-open");
      const dialog = document.querySelector("#equalizer-dialog");
      const closeButton = document.querySelector("#equalizer-close");
      const enabledInput = document.querySelector("#equalizer-enabled");
      const presetSelect = document.querySelector("#equalizer-preset");
      const bandInputs = [...dialog.querySelectorAll("[data-eq-band]")];
      const bandOutputs = [...dialog.querySelectorAll("[data-eq-value]")];
      const preampInput = document.querySelector("#equalizer-preamp");
      const preampOutput = document.querySelector("#equalizer-preamp-value");
      const presetNameInput = document.querySelector("#equalizer-custom-name");
      const savePresetButton = document.querySelector("#equalizer-save-preset");
      const deletePresetButton = document.querySelector("#equalizer-delete-preset");
      const status = document.querySelector("#equalizer-status");
      const state = readSavedState();
      let audioContext;
      let routes;
    
      function persist() {
        try {
          localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(state));
          return true;
        } catch {
          status.textContent = "Equalizer changes work for this session, but could not be saved on this device.";
          return false;
        }
      }
    
      function smooth(param, value) {
        if (!audioContext || !param) return;
        const now = audioContext.currentTime;
        param.cancelScheduledValues(now);
        param.setTargetAtTime(value, now, 0.025);
      }
    
      function updateAudioGraph() {
        if (!routes) return;
        const enabled = state.enabled;
        routes.forEach((route) => {
          route.filters.forEach((filter, index) => {
            smooth(filter.gain, enabled ? state.bands[index] : 0);
          });
          smooth(route.preamp.gain, enabled ? 10 ** (state.preamp / 20) : 1);
        });
      }
    
      function createAudioGraph() {
        if (routes) return;
        const AudioContextClass = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
        if (!AudioContextClass) throw new Error("This browser does not support audio equalizer controls.");
    
        audioContext = new AudioContextClass();
        routes = [audioPlayer, videoPlayer].map((player) => {
          const source = audioContext.createMediaElementSource(player);
          const filters = FREQUENCIES.map((frequency) => {
            const filter = audioContext.createBiquadFilter();
            filter.type = "peaking";
            filter.frequency.value = frequency;
            filter.Q.value = 1;
            return filter;
          });
          const preamp = audioContext.createGain();
          source.connect(filters[0]);
          filters.forEach((filter, index) => {
            if (index < filters.length - 1) filter.connect(filters[index + 1]);
            else filter.connect(preamp);
          });
          preamp.connect(audioContext.destination);
          return { filters, preamp };
        });
        updateAudioGraph();
      }
    
      function findCustomPreset(name) {
        return state.customPresets.find((preset) => preset.name === name);
      }
    
      function refreshPresetOptions() {
        [...presetSelect.options].filter((option) => option.dataset.custom === "true").forEach((option) => option.remove());
        state.customPresets.forEach((preset) => {
          const option = document.createElement("option");
          option.value = preset.name;
          option.textContent = preset.name;
          option.dataset.custom = "true";
          presetSelect.append(option);
        });
        deletePresetButton.disabled = !findCustomPreset(presetSelect.value);
      }
    
      function render() {
        enabledInput.checked = state.enabled;
        bandInputs.forEach((input, index) => {
          input.value = String(state.bands[index]);
          bandOutputs[index].value = `${state.bands[index]} dB`;
          bandOutputs[index].textContent = `${state.bands[index]} dB`;
        });
        preampInput.value = String(state.preamp);
        preampOutput.value = `${state.preamp} dB`;
        preampOutput.textContent = `${state.preamp} dB`;
        refreshPresetOptions();
        if ([...presetSelect.options].some((option) => option.value === state.preset)) {
          presetSelect.value = state.preset;
        } else {
          presetSelect.value = "Flat";
          state.preset = "Flat";
        }
        updateAudioGraph();
      }
    
      function applyPreset(name) {
        const builtIn = BUILT_IN_PRESETS[name];
        const custom = findCustomPreset(name);
        if (builtIn) {
          state.bands = [...builtIn];
          state.preamp = -Math.max(0, ...builtIn);
        } else if (custom) {
          state.bands = [...custom.bands];
          state.preamp = custom.preamp;
        } else {
          return;
        }
        state.preset = name;
        presetNameInput.value = custom ? custom.name : "";
        status.textContent = name === "Flat" ? "Flat response selected." : `${name} preset selected with headroom for its boosted bands.`;
        render();
        persist();
      }
    
      openButton.addEventListener("click", async () => {
        try {
          createAudioGraph();
          await audioContext.resume();
          status.textContent = "Equalizer controls audio and video playback on this device.";
        } catch (error) {
          status.textContent = error.message || "Could not start the equalizer.";
        }
        render();
        dialog.showModal();
        closeButton.focus();
      });
    
      closeButton.addEventListener("click", () => dialog.close());
      dialog.addEventListener("close", () => openButton.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false"));
      dialog.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
        if (event.target === dialog) dialog.close();
      });
      dialog.addEventListener("cancel", () => openButton.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false"));
      dialog.addEventListener("close", () => openButton.focus());
      openButton.setAttribute("aria-haspopup", "dialog");
      openButton.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
      dialog.addEventListener("open", () => openButton.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true"));
    
      enabledInput.addEventListener("change", () => {
        state.enabled = enabledInput.checked;
        updateAudioGraph();
        persist();
        status.textContent = state.enabled ? "Equalizer enabled." : "Equalizer bypassed.";
      });
      presetSelect.addEventListener("change", () => applyPreset(presetSelect.value));
      bandInputs.forEach((input, index) => {
        input.addEventListener("input", () => {
          state.bands[index] = clampGain(input.value);
          bandOutputs[index].value = `${state.bands[index]} dB`;
          bandOutputs[index].textContent = `${state.bands[index]} dB`;
          if (findCustomPreset(presetSelect.value)) {
            state.preset = "Custom changes";
            status.textContent = "Modified from the saved custom preset. Save it again to update it.";
          } else {
            state.preset = "Custom";
            status.textContent = "Custom curve. Save a name to keep it as a preset.";
          }
          if (presetSelect.value !== "Custom") {
            let customOption = presetSelect.querySelector('[value="Custom"]');
            if (!customOption) {
              customOption = document.createElement("option");
              customOption.value = "Custom";
              customOption.textContent = "Custom";
              presetSelect.append(customOption);
            }
            presetSelect.value = "Custom";
          }
          updateAudioGraph();
          persist();
        });
      });
      preampInput.addEventListener("input", () => {
        state.preamp = clampGain(preampInput.value);
        preampOutput.value = `${state.preamp} dB`;
        preampOutput.textContent = `${state.preamp} dB`;
        state.preset = findCustomPreset(presetSelect.value) ? "Custom changes" : "Custom";
        if (!presetSelect.querySelector('[value="Custom"]')) {
          const option = document.createElement("option");
          option.value = "Custom";
          option.textContent = "Custom";
          presetSelect.append(option);
        }
        presetSelect.value = "Custom";
        status.textContent = "Custom curve. Save a name to keep it as a preset.";
        updateAudioGraph();
        persist();
      });
      savePresetButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const name = presetNameInput.value.trim().replace(/\s+/g, " ");
        if (!name) {
          status.textContent = "Enter a name for this preset first.";
          presetNameInput.focus();
          return;
        }
        if (Object.hasOwn(BUILT_IN_PRESETS, name)) {
          status.textContent = "Choose a different name from the built-in presets.";
          presetNameInput.focus();
          return;
        }
        const existing = state.customPresets.findIndex((preset) => preset.name.toLocaleLowerCase() === name.toLocaleLowerCase());
        const preset = { name, preamp: state.preamp, bands: [...state.bands] };
        if (existing >= 0) state.customPresets[existing] = preset;
        else state.customPresets.push(preset);
        state.preset = name;
        render();
        persist();
        status.textContent = `${name} preset saved on this device.`;
      });
      deletePresetButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const preset = findCustomPreset(presetSelect.value);
        if (!preset) return;
        state.customPresets = state.customPresets.filter((candidate) => candidate !== preset);
        state.preset = "Flat";
        state.bands = [...FLAT];
        state.preamp = 0;
        presetNameInput.value = "";
        render();
        persist();
        status.textContent = `${preset.name} preset deleted.`;
      });
    
      render();
      if (state.preset === "Custom") {
        const option = document.createElement("option");
        option.value = "Custom";
        option.textContent = "Custom";
        presetSelect.append(option);
        presetSelect.value = "Custom";
      }
      return { frequencies: [...FREQUENCIES] };
    }

    import {
      addMediaToPlaylist,
      createPlaylist,
      deleteMediaFile,
      deletePlaylist,
      getMediaKind,
      getMediaBlob,
      listMediaFiles,
      listPlaylists,
      removeMediaFromPlaylist,
      renamePlaylist,
      saveMediaFile,
      setPlaylistPinned,
    } from "./library.js";
    
    const ICONS = {
      play: "▶",
      add: "+",
      remove: "−",
      delete: "×",
    };
    
    function formatBytes(bytes) {
      if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`;
      const units = ["KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"];
      let value = bytes / 1024;
      let unit = 0;
      while (value >= 1024 && unit < units.length - 1) {
        value /= 1024;
        unit += 1;
      }
      return `${value.toFixed(value >= 100 ? 0 : 1)} ${units[unit]}`;
    }
    
    function iconButton(label, icon, className, action) {
      const button = document.createElement("button");
      button.type = "button";
      button.className = className;
      button.setAttribute("aria-label", label);
      button.title = label;
      const glyph = document.createElement("span");
      glyph.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
      glyph.textContent = icon;
      button.append(glyph);
      button.addEventListener("click", action);
      return button;
    }
    
    export function initializePlaylistLibrary({ onPlay, onDeleted }) {
      const importButton = document.querySelector("#import-media");
      const filePicker = document.querySelector("#media-files");
      const libraryStatus = document.querySelector("#library-status");
      const libraryStorage = document.querySelector("#library-storage");
      const mediaList = document.querySelector("#media-list");
      const playlistList = document.querySelector("#playlist-list");
      const allMediaButton = document.querySelector("#all-media-view");
      const createPlaylistButton = document.querySelector("#create-playlist");
      const viewEyebrow = document.querySelector("#playlist-eyebrow");
      const viewTitle = document.querySelector("#playlist-view-title");
      const viewCount = document.querySelector("#playlist-view-count");
      const viewActions = document.querySelector("#playlist-view-actions");
    
      const dialog = document.querySelector("#playlist-dialog");
      const dialogForm = document.querySelector("#playlist-dialog-form");
      const dialogTitle = document.querySelector("#playlist-dialog-title");
      const dialogDescription = document.querySelector("#playlist-dialog-description");
      const nameField = document.querySelector("#playlist-name-field");
      const nameInput = document.querySelector("#playlist-name-input");
      const selectField = document.querySelector("#playlist-select-field");
      const playlistSelect = document.querySelector("#playlist-select");
      const cancelDialogButton = document.querySelector("#playlist-dialog-cancel");
      const submitDialogButton = document.querySelector("#playlist-dialog-submit");
    
      let mediaRecords = [];
      let playlists = [];
      let activeView = "all";
      let dialogAction = null;
    
      function setStatus(message) {
        libraryStatus.textContent = message;
      }
    
      async function updateStorageSummary() {
        const libraryBytes = mediaRecords.reduce((total, record) => total + record.size, 0);
        if (!navigator.storage?.estimate) {
          libraryStorage.textContent = `${mediaRecords.length} ${mediaRecords.length === 1 ? "file" : "files"} · ${formatBytes(libraryBytes)} in your library`;
          return;
        }
    
        try {
          const { usage, quota } = await navigator.storage.estimate();
          const browserUsage = Number.isFinite(usage) ? formatBytes(usage) : "unknown";
          const browserQuota = Number.isFinite(quota) ? formatBytes(quota) : "unknown";
          libraryStorage.textContent = `${mediaRecords.length} ${mediaRecords.length === 1 ? "file" : "files"} · ${formatBytes(libraryBytes)} in your library · ${browserUsage} of ${browserQuota} browser storage used`;
        } catch {
          libraryStorage.textContent = `${mediaRecords.length} ${mediaRecords.length === 1 ? "file" : "files"} · ${formatBytes(libraryBytes)} in your library`;
        }
      }
    
      function showDialog({ title, description = "", name = "", nameVisible = false, selectVisible = false, submitLabel = "Save", destructive = false, action }) {
        dialogTitle.textContent = title;
        dialogDescription.textContent = description;
        dialogDescription.hidden = !description;
        nameField.hidden = !nameVisible;
        selectField.hidden = !selectVisible;
        nameInput.value = name;
        submitDialogButton.textContent = submitLabel;
        submitDialogButton.classList.toggle("danger-button", destructive);
        dialogAction = action;
        dialog.showModal();
        if (nameVisible) {
          nameInput.focus();
          nameInput.select();
        } else if (selectVisible) {
          playlistSelect.focus();
        } else {
          submitDialogButton.focus();
        }
      }
    
      function openCreateDialog(addMediaId = null) {
        showDialog({
          title: "Create playlist",
          nameVisible: true,
          submitLabel: "Create",
          action: async () => {
            await createPlaylist(nameInput.value);
            await loadLibrary();
            const created = playlists.find((playlist) => playlist.name.toLocaleLowerCase() === nameInput.value.trim().replace(/\s+/g, " ").toLocaleLowerCase());
            if (created && addMediaId) {
              await addMediaToPlaylist(created.id, addMediaId);
              activeView = created.id;
            } else if (created) {
              activeView = created.id;
            }
            await render();
            setStatus(addMediaId ? "Playlist created and media added." : "Playlist created.");
          },
        });
      }
    
      function openAddToPlaylistDialog(record) {
        const availablePlaylists = playlists.filter((playlist) => !playlist.mediaIds.includes(record.id));
        if (playlists.length === 0 || availablePlaylists.length === 0) {
          if (playlists.length > 0) {
            setStatus("This media is already in every playlist.");
            return;
          }
          openCreateDialog(record.id);
          return;
        }
    
        playlistSelect.replaceChildren();
        availablePlaylists.forEach((playlist) => {
          const option = document.createElement("option");
          option.value = playlist.id;
          option.textContent = playlist.name;
          playlistSelect.append(option);
        });
        showDialog({
          title: "Add to playlist",
          selectVisible: true,
          submitLabel: "Add",
          action: async () => {
            const playlist = playlists.find((item) => item.id === playlistSelect.value);
            if (!playlist) throw new Error("Choose a playlist first.");
            await addMediaToPlaylist(playlist.id, record.id);
            activeView = playlist.id;
            await render();
            setStatus(`Added to ${playlist.name}.`);
          },
        });
      }
    
      function openRenameDialog(playlist) {
        showDialog({
          title: "Rename playlist",
          name: playlist.name,
          nameVisible: true,
          submitLabel: "Save",
          action: async () => {
            await renamePlaylist(playlist.id, nameInput.value);
            await loadLibrary();
            await render();
            setStatus("Playlist renamed.");
          },
        });
      }
    
      function openDeletePlaylistDialog(playlist) {
        showDialog({
          title: "Delete playlist?",
          description: `“${playlist.name}” will be deleted. The media files will stay in your library.`,
          submitLabel: "Delete",
          destructive: true,
          action: async () => {
            await deletePlaylist(playlist.id);
            if (activeView === playlist.id) activeView = "all";
            await loadLibrary();
            await render();
            setStatus("Playlist deleted. Your media files are still in the library.");
          },
        });
      }
    
      function openDeleteMediaDialog(record) {
        showDialog({
          title: "Delete media?",
          description: `“${record.name}” will be deleted from this device and removed from any playlists.`,
          submitLabel: "Delete",
          destructive: true,
          action: async () => {
            await deleteMediaFile(record.id);
            onDeleted?.(record);
            await render();
            setStatus("Media deleted from this device.");
          },
        });
      }
    
      function renderPlaylistSidebar() {
        playlistList.replaceChildren();
        allMediaButton.classList.toggle("is-selected", activeView === "all");
        if (activeView === "all") allMediaButton.setAttribute("aria-current", "page");
        else allMediaButton.removeAttribute("aria-current");
    
        playlists.forEach((playlist) => {
          const item = document.createElement("li");
          item.className = "playlist-item";
          if (activeView === playlist.id) item.classList.add("is-selected");
    
          const selectButton = document.createElement("button");
          selectButton.type = "button";
          selectButton.className = "playlist-item-button";
          if (activeView === playlist.id) selectButton.setAttribute("aria-current", "page");
          selectButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
            activeView = playlist.id;
            render();
          });
    
    
          const name = document.createElement("span");
          name.className = "playlist-item-name";
          name.textContent = playlist.name;
          selectButton.append(name);
          if (playlist.pinned) {
            const pinMark = document.createElement("span");
            pinMark.className = "playlist-pin-mark";
            pinMark.setAttribute("aria-label", "Pinned");
            pinMark.textContent = "◆";
            selectButton.append(pinMark);
          }
    
          const count = document.createElement("span");
          count.className = "playlist-item-count";
          count.textContent = String(playlist.mediaIds.length);
          selectButton.append(count);
    
          const actions = document.createElement("details");
          actions.className = "playlist-overflow";
          const summary = document.createElement("summary");
          summary.setAttribute("aria-label", `More options for ${playlist.name}`);
          summary.title = `More options for ${playlist.name}`;
          summary.textContent = "•••";
          actions.append(summary);
    
          const menu = document.createElement("div");
          menu.className = "playlist-action-menu";
          const pinButton = document.createElement("button");
          pinButton.type = "button";
          pinButton.textContent = playlist.pinned ? "Unpin from top" : "Pin to top";
          pinButton.addEventListener("click", async (event) => {
            event.stopPropagation();
            await setPlaylistPinned(playlist.id, !playlist.pinned);
            await loadLibrary();
            await render();
          });
    
          const renameButton = document.createElement("button");
          renameButton.type = "button";
          renameButton.textContent = "Rename";
          renameButton.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
            event.stopPropagation();
            actions.open = false;
            openRenameDialog(playlist);
          });
    
          const deleteButton = document.createElement("button");
          deleteButton.type = "button";
          deleteButton.className = "delete-playlist-action";
          deleteButton.textContent = "Delete";
          deleteButton.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
            event.stopPropagation();
            actions.open = false;
            openDeletePlaylistDialog(playlist);
          });
          menu.append(pinButton, renameButton, deleteButton);
          actions.append(menu);
          item.append(selectButton, actions);
          playlistList.append(item);
        });
      }
    
      function renderMediaRow(record, playlist) {
        const item = document.createElement("li");
        item.className = "media-item";
    
        const artwork = document.createElement("img");
        artwork.className = "media-row-artwork";
        artwork.src = record.artwork || "/favicon.svg";
        artwork.alt = "";
        artwork.addEventListener("error", () => { if (!artwork.src.endsWith("/favicon.svg")) artwork.src = "/favicon.svg"; }, { once: true });
        const info = document.createElement("div");
        info.className = "media-info";
        const name = document.createElement("span");
        name.className = "media-name";
        name.textContent = record.title || record.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, "");
        const details = document.createElement("span");
        details.className = "media-details";
        const typeAndSize = `${record.kind === "video" ? "Video" : "Audio"} · ${formatBytes(record.size)}`;
        const formatDuration = (seconds) => `${Math.floor(seconds / 60)}:${String(Math.floor(seconds % 60)).padStart(2, "0")}`;
        const updateDetails = (duration = record.duration) => {
          details.textContent = [
            record.artist,
            record.album,
            Number.isFinite(duration) && duration > 0 ? formatDuration(duration) : "",
            typeAndSize,
            `Added ${new Date(record.importedAt).toLocaleDateString()}`,
          ].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
        };
        updateDetails();
        if (!Number.isFinite(record.duration)) {
          getMediaBlob(record.id).then((blob) => {
            if (!blob) return;
            const element = document.createElement(record.kind === "video" ? "video" : "audio");
            const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            element.preload = "metadata";
            element.onloadedmetadata = () => { updateDetails(element.duration); URL.revokeObjectURL(url); };
            element.onerror = () => URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
            element.src = url;
          }).catch(() => {});
        }
        info.append(name, details);
    
        const actions = document.createElement("div");
        actions.className = "media-actions";
        actions.append(iconButton("Play", ICONS.play, "media-action", () => onPlay(record)));
        const overflow = document.createElement("details");
        overflow.className = "media-overflow";
        const summary = document.createElement("summary");
        summary.setAttribute("aria-label", `More options for ${record.title || record.name}`);
        summary.title = "More options";
        summary.textContent = "•••";
        const menu = document.createElement("div");
        menu.className = "media-overflow-menu";
        if (playlist) {
          const remove = document.createElement("button"); remove.type = "button"; remove.textContent = "Remove from playlist";
          remove.addEventListener("click", async () => {
            await removeMediaFromPlaylist(playlist.id, record.id);
            await render();
            setStatus(`Removed from ${playlist.name}.`);
          }); menu.append(remove);
        } else {
          const add = document.createElement("button"); add.type = "button"; add.textContent = "Add to playlist"; add.addEventListener("click", () => openAddToPlaylistDialog(record)); menu.append(add);
        }
        const removeLibrary = document.createElement("button"); removeLibrary.type = "button"; removeLibrary.className = "danger-menu-action"; removeLibrary.textContent = "Delete from library"; removeLibrary.addEventListener("click", () => openDeleteMediaDialog(record)); menu.append(removeLibrary);
        overflow.append(summary, menu);
        actions.append(overflow);
        item.append(artwork, info, actions);
        return item;
      }
    
      function renderMediaList() {
        mediaList.replaceChildren();
        const playlist = activeView === "all" ? null : playlists.find((item) => item.id === activeView);
        if (activeView !== "all" && !playlist) activeView = "all";
        const visibleRecords = playlist
          ? playlist.mediaIds.map((id) => mediaRecords.find((record) => record.id === id)).filter(Boolean)
          : mediaRecords;
    
        viewEyebrow.textContent = playlist ? "PLAYLIST" : "LIBRARY";
        viewTitle.textContent = playlist?.name || "All media";
        viewCount.textContent = `${visibleRecords.length} ${visibleRecords.length === 1 ? "item" : "items"}`;
        viewActions.replaceChildren();
    
        if (visibleRecords.length === 0) {
          const empty = document.createElement("li");
          empty.className = "playlist-empty-state";
          if (playlist) {
            const message = document.createElement("p");
            message.textContent = "This playlist is empty.";
            const browse = document.createElement("button");
            browse.type = "button";
            browse.className = "secondary-button";
            browse.textContent = "Browse all media";
            browse.addEventListener("click", () => {
              activeView = "all";
              render();
            });
            empty.append(message, browse);
          } else {
            const message = document.createElement("p");
            message.textContent = "Your library is empty. Import media to get started.";
            empty.append(message);
          }
          mediaList.append(empty);
          return;
        }
    
        visibleRecords.forEach((record) => mediaList.append(renderMediaRow(record, playlist)));
      }
    
      async function loadLibrary() {
        [mediaRecords, playlists] = await Promise.all([listMediaFiles(), listPlaylists()]);
      }
    
      async function render() {
        try {
          await loadLibrary();
          if (activeView !== "all" && !playlists.some((playlist) => playlist.id === activeView)) {
            activeView = "all";
          }
          renderPlaylistSidebar();
          renderMediaList();
          await updateStorageSummary();
        } catch (error) {
          setStatus(`Could not open your library: ${error.message}`);
          libraryStorage.textContent = "Browser storage information is unavailable.";
        }
      }
    
      allMediaButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
        activeView = "all";
        render();
      });
      createPlaylistButton.addEventListener("click", () => openCreateDialog());
      cancelDialogButton.addEventListener("click", () => dialog.close());
      dialog.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
        if (event.target === dialog) dialog.close();
      });
      dialogForm.addEventListener("submit", async (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        if (!dialogAction) return;
        submitDialogButton.disabled = true;
        try {
          await dialogAction();
          dialog.close();
          dialogAction = null;
        } catch (error) {
          setStatus(error.message || "The playlist action failed.");
        } finally {
          submitDialogButton.disabled = false;
        }
      });
    
      importButton.addEventListener("click", () => filePicker.click());
      filePicker.addEventListener("change", async () => {
        const files = Array.from(filePicker.files || []);
        filePicker.value = "";
        if (files.length === 0) return;
    
        importButton.disabled = true;
        let imported = 0;
        let skipped = 0;
        let failure;
        try {
          try {
            if (navigator.storage?.persist) await navigator.storage.persist();
          } catch {
            // Importing can proceed if persistent storage is unavailable.
          }
          for (const file of files) {
            if (!getMediaKind(file.name, file.type)) {
              skipped += 1;
              continue;
            }
            setStatus(`Importing ${file.name}…`);
            try {
              await saveMediaFile(file);

## User

# Puffin: Dedicated Watch Page + Mobile-Friendly Video Experience

You are working on my existing project, **Puffin**. I want you to upgrade its video experience significantly while preserving the existing music-player functionality, architecture, and overall visual quality.

The goal is to make Puffin feel more like Apple Music: polished, modern, intuitive, and native-feeling. However, I also want video playback to feel like a first-class feature rather than an afterthought.

**IMPORTANT: Inspect the existing codebase before making changes. Understand how the current navigation, media library, playlists, playback engine, video theater, and player dock work. Reuse existing functionality wherever possible. Do not unnecessarily rewrite working systems.**

## 1. Create a dedicated Watch page

Create a dedicated Watch page that is separate from the existing music-focused experience.

The page should feel like a modern streaming service, with a clean, premium interface.

Include:

- A featured video section at the top with a large thumbnail, title, and Play button.
- A Continue Watching section showing videos the user hasn't finished.
- A Recently Watched section.
- A video library displaying all locally stored videos.
- Video playlists or collections, if compatible with the existing playlist architecture.
- Attractive landscape video thumbnails with consistent 16:9 aspect ratios.
- Video titles, duration, and other useful metadata.
- Search and filtering functionality.

The page should automatically populate from the user's existing local media library. Do not create a separate video database if the existing IndexedDB media records already support this.

Make sure videos are correctly identified using the existing media type/kind system.

If a video has no thumbnail or artwork, provide an attractive fallback thumbnail rather than displaying a broken image or generic app icon.

## 2. Create an expanded video player / Watch experience

When the user selects a video, open a dedicated expanded viewing experience.

This should be visually distinct from the music player.

The player should include:

- A large 16:9 video area.
- Play/pause.
- Seek bar with current time and total duration.
- Volume controls.
- Playback speed selection.
- Fullscreen toggle.
- A clear close/back button.
- Video title and relevant metadata.
- A way to return to the Watch page without losing playback progress.

Controls should be clean and unobtrusive. They should appear when the user interacts with the player and disappear after a reasonable period of inactivity, where appropriate.

The video should remain the visual focus.

Preserve the existing playback engine wherever possible. Do not break audio playback, playlists, playback speed, or the existing mini-player.

## 3. CRITICAL: Fix mobile fullscreen and video playback bugs

There is currently a serious mobile issue:

When I play a video and enter fullscreen, sometimes the video becomes stuck in fullscreen. Closing the video or attempting to navigate away does not properly reset the interface. The only reliable workaround is closing the entire PWA app and reopening it.

**This must be investigated and fixed properly. Do not simply hide the fullscreen interface with CSS.**

Inspect the existing fullscreen implementation, video elements, event listeners, dialog/theater logic, and playback state management.

Implement robust fullscreen handling:

- Correctly enter and exit fullscreen.
- Listen for fullscreenchange and the relevant browser-specific fullscreen events where necessary.
- Handle fullscreen state becoming desynchronized from the application's UI state.
- Ensure the close button works even after entering fullscreen.
- Ensure exiting fullscreen restores the normal Watch page.
- Ensure closing the video properly cleans up its state.
- Handle browser back navigation appropriately.
- Handle Escape where supported.
- Handle switching between fullscreen and normal playback.
- Handle the user navigating away from the video.
- Prevent stale event listeners and duplicated playback state.
- Ensure that reopening a video after closing it works correctly.

Pay particular attention to iOS Safari and installed PWAs.

Account for differences between the standard Fullscreen API and iOS-specific video fullscreen behavior, including WebKit video fullscreen events where applicable.

Use appropriate video attributes such as `playsinline` when needed so that mobile browsers do not unexpectedly force native fullscreen playback.

Do not assume that every mobile browser supports the same fullscreen API.

The application must always have a reliable way to return to its normal interface without requiring an app restart.

## 4. Make the entire experience mobile-friendly

This is extremely important. I want the Watch page and all existing Puffin features to work properly on phones and tablets.

Audit the entire interface, not just the new Watch page.

Check:

- Navigation and sidebar behavior.
- Home page.
- Watch page.
- Music player.
- Video player.
- Download page.
- Edit page.
- Playlists and library.
- Stats page.
- Settings and dialogs.
- Search interfaces.
- All buttons, menus, and controls.

### Mobile design requirements

- Use responsive layouts rather than simply shrinking the desktop interface.
- Make navigation comfortable on touchscreens.
- Consider a mobile bottom navigation bar or an appropriate collapsible navigation system.
- Ensure buttons and interactive controls have sufficiently large touch targets.
- Prevent horizontal overflow.
- Make dialogs and menus fit within mobile screens.
- Respect device safe areas, including notches and home indicators.
- Account for mobile browser viewport changes when the keyboard appears or fullscreen is entered/exited.
- Ensure text remains readable.
- Avoid controls that require precise mouse positioning.
- Ensure the mini-player does not cover important content or navigation.
- Make video thumbnails and cards adapt naturally to smaller screens.
- Ensure scrolling works correctly in every page and dialog.

The interface should feel intentionally designed for mobile, not like a desktop website squeezed into a phone.

## 5. Improve the mini-player

Keep the existing music mini-player, but ensure it works consistently across desktop and mobile.

For video playback:

- Display the video's thumbnail instead of album artwork.
- Show the video title.
- Provide play/pause and expand controls.
- Make tapping the mini-player reopen the expanded video experience.
- Ensure the mini-player behaves correctly when entering and exiting fullscreen.
- Prevent it from appearing over the fullscreen video.

For music playback, preserve the existing behavior.

## 6. Visual design direction

Keep Puffin's existing design language, but make the new experience feel more premium.

Think:

- Apple Music's clean hierarchy.
- Apple TV's video-focused presentation.
- Modern streaming-service layouts.
- Consistent spacing and typography.
- Attractive thumbnails and artwork.
- Subtle animations and transitions.
- Rounded corners and restrained use of borders.
- Responsive layouts that feel native on mobile.

Do not turn the interface into a cluttered dashboard.

The Watch page should feel cinematic and media-focused, while the existing music experience should remain music-focused.

## 7. Preserve existing functionality

This is an upgrade, not a rebuild.

Preserve:

- Existing IndexedDB media storage.
- Existing download functionality.
- Existing Python backend integration.
- Existing playlist system.
- Existing audio playback.
- Existing editing and metadata functionality.
- Existing playback statistics.
- Existing offline/PWA functionality.
- Existing service worker behavior.

Avoid introducing unnecessary dependencies.

Do not migrate the entire application to a different framework.

Keep the code organized and consistent with the existing project structure.

## 8. Testing and verification

After implementing the changes, thoroughly inspect the result.

Test the following scenarios:

1. Open the Watch page and confirm existing videos appear.
2. Play a video from the Watch page.
3. Enter fullscreen.
4. Exit fullscreen.
5. Close the video.
6. Immediately open another video.
7. Navigate between Watch and other pages.
8. Play a video, navigate away, and return.
9. Test video playback on a narrow mobile viewport.
10. Test the mini-player during video playback.
11. Verify that audio playback still works.
12. Verify that playlists and local media remain intact.
13. Verify that the PWA still works offline where expected.

Pay special attention to fullscreen state synchronization and mobile navigation.

If automated browser testing is available, use it. Otherwise, inspect the relevant code paths and clearly document anything that requires manual testing on a physical iPhone or Android device.

Do not claim that mobile fullscreen behavior has been verified on devices you cannot test.

## 9. Final report

When finished, provide:

- A summary of what changed.
- The files modified.
- Any new components or modules created.
- How fullscreen handling was fixed.
- What mobile improvements were made.
- Any remaining limitations or manual tests needed.

**Most important priorities:**

1. Fix the fullscreen bug permanently.
2. Build the dedicated Watch page.
3. Build the expanded video player.
4. Make the entire application mobile-friendly.
5. Preserve existing functionality and visual quality.

Take the time to understand the existing architecture before coding. I want a cohesive, reliable upgrade, not a collection of disconnected UI changes.

    const tabButtons = document.querySelectorAll("[data-tab]");

        const selectedTab = button.dataset.tab;
    
        tabButtons.forEach((tab) => {
          if (tab === button) tab.setAttribute("aria-current", "page");
          else tab.removeAttribute("aria-current");
        });
    
        panels.forEach((panel) => {
          panel.hidden = panel.dataset.panel !== selectedTab;
        });
    
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("puffin:tab-changed", { detail: selectedTab }));
      });
    });

      function showDialog({ title, description = "", name = "", nameVisible = false, selectVisible = false, submitLabel = "Save", destructive = false, action }) {

        playlistSelect.replaceChildren();

      function openRenameDialog(playlist) {

      function renderPlaylistSidebar() {

        if (activeView === "all") allMediaButton.setAttribute("aria-current", "page");

        playlists.forEach((playlist) => {

          const menu = document.createElement("div");
          menu.className = "playlist-action-menu";
          const pinButton = document.createElement("button");
          pinButton.type = "button";
          pinButton.textContent = playlist.pinned ? "Unpin from top" : "Pin to top";
          pinButton.addEventListener("click", async (event) => {
            event.stopPropagation();

          const renameButton = document.createElement("button");
          renameButton.type = "button";
          renameButton.textContent = "Rename";
          renameButton.addEventListener("click", (event) => {

          const deleteButton = document.createElement("button");
          deleteButton.type = "button";
          deleteButton.className = "delete-playlist-action";
          deleteButton.textContent = "Delete";
          deleteButton.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
            event.stopPropagation();

          actions.append(menu);
          item.append(selectButton, actions);
          playlistList.append(item);
        });

      function renderMediaRow(record, playlist) {
        const item = document.createElement("li");
        item.className = "media-item";
    
        const artwork = document.createElement("img");
        artwork.className = "media-row-artwork";
        artwork.src = record.artwork || "/favicon.svg";
        artwork.alt = "";
        artwork.addEventListener("error", () => { if (!artwork.src.endsWith("/favicon.svg")) artwork.src = "/favicon.svg"; }, { once: true });

        const formatDuration = (seconds) => `${Math.floor(seconds / 60)}:${String(Math.floor(seconds % 60)).padStart(2, "0")}`;
        const updateDetails = (duration = record.duration) => {
          details.textContent = [
            record.artist,
            record.album,
            Number.isFinite(duration) && duration > 0 ? formatDuration(duration) : "",

            element.onloadedmetadata = () => { updateDetails(element.duration); URL.revokeObjectURL(url); };

        const actions = document.createElement("div");
        actions.className = "media-actions";

        const summary = document.createElement("summary");
        summary.setAttribute("aria-label", `More options for ${record.title || record.name}`);
        summary.title = "More options";

        if (playlist) {

          remove.addEventListener("click", async () => {
            await removeMediaFromPlaylist(playlist.id, record.id);

            setStatus(`Removed from ${playlist.name}.`);

        } else {

        }
        const removeLibrary = document.createElement("button"); removeLibrary.type = "button"; removeLibrary.className = "danger-menu-action"; removeLibrary.textContent = "Delete from library"; removeLibrary.addEventListener("click", () => openDeleteMediaDialog(record)); menu.append(removeLibrary);
        overflow.append(summary, menu);
        actions.append(overflow);

      function renderMediaList() {
        mediaList.replaceChildren();
        let playlist = activeView === "all" ? null : playlists.find((item) => item.id === activeView);
        if (activeView !== "all" && !playlist) {
          activeView = "all";
          playlist = null;

        viewEyebrow.textContent = playlist ? "PLAYLIST" : "LIBRARY";
        viewTitle.textContent = playlist?.name || "All media";
        viewCount.textContent = `${visibleRecords.length} ${visibleRecords.length === 1 ? "item" : "items"}`;
        viewActions.replaceChildren();
    
        if (visibleRecords.length === 0) {

          empty.className = "playlist-empty-state";
          if (playlist) {

      async function loadLibrary() {

      async function render() {
