    .player-timeline input[type="range"]::-moz-range-track { height: 4px; background: var(--border); border-radius: 999px; }
    .player-timeline input[type="range"]::-moz-range-thumb { width: 10px; height: 10px; background: var(--accent); border: 2px solid var(--surface); border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 1px 4px #0003; }
    .player-timeline input[type="range"]:disabled { cursor: default; opacity: 0.45; }
    .player-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 10px; min-width: 0; }
    .player-equalizer-button { display: grid; width: 36px; height: 34px; flex: 0 0 36px; padding: 0; place-items: center; color: var(--text); background: var(--page); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: .02em; }
    .player-equalizer-button:hover { color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft); }
    .player-equalizer-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
    .player-speed {
      width: 62px;
      min-height: 34px;
      padding: 0 7px;
      color: var(--text);
      background: var(--page);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 999px;
      cursor: pointer;
      font: inherit;
      font-size: 0.78rem;
    }
    .player-speed:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
    .player-close { display: grid; flex: 0 0 34px; width: 34px; height: 34px; padding: 0; place-items: center; color: var(--muted); background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; cursor: pointer; font-size: 1.4rem; }
    .player-close:hover { color: var(--text); background: var(--accent-soft); }
    .player-toggle:focus-visible, .player-close:focus-visible, .player-timeline input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }
    
    .equalizer-dialog {
      width: min(760px, calc(100vw - 28px));
      max-width: none;
      max-height: min(92dvh, 760px);
      padding: 0;
      overflow: auto;
      color: var(--text);
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 24px;
      box-shadow: 0 30px 100px #0004;
    }
    .equalizer-dialog::backdrop { background: #10171980; backdrop-filter: blur(5px); }
    .equalizer-dialog form { display: grid; gap: 20px; padding: clamp(18px, 4vw, 30px); }
    .equalizer-header { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 16px; }
    .equalizer-header h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.5rem; letter-spacing: -.035em; }
    .equalizer-header p { margin: 5px 0 0; }
    .equalizer-toolbar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; }
    .equalizer-enable { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; font-weight: 650; }
    .equalizer-enable input { width: 18px; height: 18px; accent-color: var(--accent); }
    .equalizer-preset-field { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: var(--muted); font-size: .88rem; }
    .equalizer-preset-field select { min-width: 155px; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; color: var(--text); background: var(--page); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; font: inherit; }
    .equalizer-bands-scroll { max-width: 100%; overflow-x: auto; }
    .equalizer-bands { display: grid; min-width: 590px; grid-template-columns: repeat(10, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; padding: 16px 12px 12px; background: var(--page); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 16px; }
    .equalizer-band { display: grid; min-width: 0; justify-items: center; gap: 9px; color: var(--muted); font-size: .7rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
    .equalizer-band input { width: 28px; height: 116px; margin: 0; accent-color: var(--accent); cursor: pointer; writing-mode: vertical-lr; direction: rtl; }
    .equalizer-band output { color: var(--text); font-size: .7rem; }
    .equalizer-preamp-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(100px, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 8px 18px; }
    .equalizer-preamp-row label { display: flex; min-width: 140px; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; font-weight: 650; }
    .equalizer-preamp-row output { color: var(--muted); font-weight: 500; }
    .equalizer-preamp-row input { width: 100%; accent-color: var(--accent); }
    .equalizer-preamp-row p { grid-column: 1 / -1; margin: 0; font-size: .82rem; }
    .equalizer-custom-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto auto; align-items: end; gap: 10px; }
    .equalizer-custom-row .form-field { gap: 6px; }
    .equalizer-custom-row input { min-height: 42px; padding: 0 12px; color: var(--text); background: var(--page); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px; font: inherit; }
    .equalizer-custom-row button { min-height: 42px; }
    .equalizer-custom-row button:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .5; }
    .equalizer-status { min-height: 1.3em; margin: -8px 0 0; font-size: .84rem; }
    .equalizer-dialog button:focus-visible, .equalizer-dialog input:focus-visible, .equalizer-dialog select:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
    
    .media-list { display: grid; gap: 10px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
    .media-item { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 54px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 16px; }
    .media-row-artwork { flex: 0 0 54px; width: 54px; height: 54px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--accent-soft); }
    .media-info { min-width: 0; justify-self: stretch; text-align: left; }
    .media-name { display: block; overflow-wrap: anywhere; font-weight: 600; }
    .media-details { display: block; margin-top: 4px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.85rem; }
    .media-actions { display: flex; flex: 0 0 auto; gap: 8px; }
    .media-overflow { position: relative; }
    .media-overflow > summary { display: grid; width: 38px; height: 38px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 50%; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1px; }
    .media-overflow > summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; }
    .media-overflow-menu { position: absolute; z-index: 3; top: calc(100% + 6px); right: 0; display: grid; min-width: 185px; gap: 3px; padding: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--surface); box-shadow: 0 12px 30px #0002; }
    .media-overflow-menu button { padding: 9px 11px; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; background: transparent; color: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; }
    .media-overflow-menu button:hover { background: var(--accent-soft); }
    .media-overflow-menu .danger-menu-action { color: #c72f40; }
    .edit-toolbar, .edit-mask-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
    .edit-toolbar { margin: 16px 0; }
    .edit-select-all { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-weight: 600; }
    .edit-batch-card { display: grid; gap: 14px; margin: 0 0 16px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 18px; background: var(--surface); }
    .edit-fields { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(100px, 1fr)) auto; align-items: end; gap: 10px; }
    .edit-fields .form-field, .edit-mask-row .form-field { margin: 0; }
    .edit-mask-row .form-field { flex: 1; }
    .edit-mask-help { margin: -8px 0 0; font-size: .85rem; }
    .edit-media-list { display: grid; gap: 8px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
    .edit-media-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 52px minmax(200px, 1fr) auto auto auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 15px; background: var(--surface); }
    .edit-artwork { width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 10px; object-fit: cover; background: var(--accent-soft); }
    .edit-artwork-wrap { position: relative; width: 52px; height: 52px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 10px; cursor: zoom-in; }
    .edit-artwork-wrap .edit-artwork { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; transition: filter .16s ease; }
    .edit-artwork-upload { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 0; border-radius: inherit; background: rgb(25 30 34 / 58%); color: #fff; font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 300; opacity: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity .16s ease; }
    .edit-artwork-wrap:hover .edit-artwork-upload, .edit-artwork-upload:focus-visible { opacity: 1; }
    .edit-artwork-wrap:hover .edit-artwork { filter: grayscale(.65); }
    .artwork-preview-dialog { position: fixed; width: min(80vw, 720px); max-width: none; max-height: 90dvh; padding: 0; overflow: visible; border: 0; border-radius: 20px; background: transparent; box-shadow: 0 24px 80px #0006; }
    .artwork-preview-dialog::backdrop { background: rgb(0 0 0 / 76%); backdrop-filter: blur(6px); }
    .artwork-preview-dialog img { display: block; width: 100%; max-height: 85dvh; object-fit: contain; border-radius: 20px; }
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 26px;
      box-shadow: 0 30px 100px #0004;
    }
    .settings-dialog::backdrop { background: #10171980; backdrop-filter: blur(5px); }
    .settings-layout { display: grid; width: 100%; height: 100%; grid-template-columns: 220px minmax(0, 1fr); }
    .settings-sidebar { padding: 26px 14px; background: var(--page); border-right: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .settings-sidebar-label { margin: 0 10px 20px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.13em; }
    .settings-nav { display: grid; gap: 5px; }
    .settings-nav button { min-height: 42px; padding: 0 12px; color: var(--muted); background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; font: inherit; font-size: 0.9rem; }
    .settings-nav button:hover { color: var(--text); background: var(--surface); }
    .settings-nav button[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft); font-weight: 650; }
    .settings-main { display: flex; min-width: 0; flex-direction: column; }
    .settings-header { display: flex; min-height: 72px; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 12px 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .settings-header h1 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 650; }
    .settings-back, .settings-close { display: grid; width: 40px; height: 40px; flex: 0 0 auto; padding: 0; place-items: center; color: var(--text); background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; cursor: pointer; font-size: 1.3rem; }
    .settings-back:hover, .settings-close:hover { background: var(--page); }
    .settings-close { margin-left: auto; }
    .settings-content { flex: 1; padding: 30px clamp(20px, 4vw, 48px); overflow-y: auto; }
    .settings-content h2 { margin: 0 0 12px; font-size: 1.55rem; letter-spacing: -0.035em; }
    .settings-content > section > .muted { line-height: 1.6; }
    .about-puffin-card { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; margin: 24px 0 18px; padding: 18px; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 18px; }
    .about-puffin-card img { flex: 0 0 auto; border-radius: 14px; }
    .about-puffin-card h3 { margin: 0 0 4px; font-size: 1.2rem; }
    .about-puffin-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.5; }
    .about-puffin-description { max-width: 680px; }
    .about-puffin-features { display: grid; max-width: 720px; gap: 10px; margin: 22px 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
    .about-puffin-features li { display: grid; gap: 4px; padding: 14px 16px; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 15px; }
    .about-puffin-features strong { font-size: .92rem; }
    .about-puffin-features span, .about-puffin-footer { color: var(--muted); font-size: .86rem; line-height: 1.55; }
    .about-puffin-footer { max-width: 680px; }
    .settings-storage-summary { margin: 0 0 26px; padding: 16px 18px; background: var(--page); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 16px; line-height: 1.6; }
    .settings-capacity-meter { display: grid; gap: 10px; margin: 0 0 12px; padding: 16px 18px; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 16px; }
    .settings-capacity-heading { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.88rem; }
    .settings-capacity-heading strong { color: var(--text); font-size: 0.9rem; text-align: right; }
    .settings-capacity-meter progress { width: 100%; height: 10px; accent-color: var(--accent); }
    .settings-capacity-meter.is-over-limit progress { accent-color: #c83d4b; }
    .settings-capacity-warning { margin: 0 0 20px; padding: 12px 14px; color: #8d3039; background: #fff0f1; border: 1px solid #f2c7cb; border-radius: 14px; font-size: 0.88rem; line-height: 1.5; }
    .settings-capacity-warning[hidden] { display: none; }
    .settings-storage-form { display: grid; max-width: 440px; gap: 14px; margin-top: 28px; }
    .settings-storage-form .form-field { color: var(--text); }
    .settings-storage-form > .primary-button { justify-self: start; }
    .settings-storage-form > .muted { margin: 0; font-size: 0.85rem; line-height: 1.5; }
    .settings-storage-form [role="status"] { min-height: 1.3em; }
    .settings-home-options { display: grid; gap: 10px; margin-top: 24px; }
    .settings-toggle-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 18px; padding: 15px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 15px; background: var(--surface); cursor: pointer; }
    .settings-toggle-row span { display: grid; gap: 4px; }
    .settings-toggle-row strong { font-size: .92rem; }
    .settings-toggle-row small { color: var(--muted); font-size: .82rem; line-height: 1.45; }
    .settings-toggle-row input { width: 20px; height: 20px; flex: 0 0 auto; accent-color: var(--accent); }
    .settings-clear-history { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; margin-top: 32px; padding-top: 20px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .settings-clear-history p { margin: 5px 0 0; font-size: .82rem; }
    .settings-clear-history .danger-button { padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid #e9bdc1; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff3f4; color: #a52a2a; font: inherit; font-size: .86rem; cursor: pointer; }
    .settings-clear-history .danger-button:hover { background: #ffe4e6; }
    .settings-clear-history .danger-button:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: wait; }
    .settings-actions { display: flex; gap: 10px; margin-top: 22px; }
    .settings-dialog button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
    body.dark .settings-capacity-warning { color: #ffd7da; background: #48282b; border-color: #704047; }
    
    body.dark {
      color-scheme: dark;
      --page: #15191c;
      --surface: #1e2428;
      --text: #edf1f2;
      --muted: #a0aaaf;
      --border: #343c41;
      --accent: #9bd0d5;
      --accent-soft: #263b3e;
    }
    
    body.dark .media-action.danger:hover { background: #48282b; }
    
    @media (max-width: 960px) and (min-width: 641px) {
      .player-bar { grid-template-columns: minmax(130px, 1fr) minmax(210px, 1.4fr) minmax(150px, 0.8fr); gap: 12px; padding-right: 16px; padding-left: 16px; }
      .player-artwork, .player-video { flex-basis: 48px; width: 48px; height: 48px; }
      .player-actions { gap: 6px; }
    }
    
    @media (max-width: 800px) and (min-width: 641px) {
      .player-bar { grid-template-columns: minmax(110px, 0.9fr) minmax(190px, 1.4fr) minmax(130px, 0.7fr); gap: 10px; }
      .player-actions { gap: 5px; }
      .player-speed { width: 56px; padding-inline: 5px; }
      .player-close { flex-basis: 30px; width: 30px; height: 30px; }
    }
    
    @media (max-width: 640px) {
      .app { grid-template-columns: 1fr; grid-template-rows: 1fr auto; }
      .sidebar {
        grid-row: 2;
        padding: 8px 8px max(8px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
        border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-right: 0;
      }
      .brand, .sidebar-bottom { display: none; }
      .nav-list { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 2px; }
      .nav-button { min-height: 58px; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 3px; padding: 4px 2px; font-size: 0.72rem; text-align: center; }
      .nav-icon { font-size: 1.1rem; }
      .workspace { grid-row: 1; min-height: 0; }
      .topbar { min-height: 56px; padding: 6px 12px; }
      .mobile-settings-button { display: flex; }
      main { padding: 24px 18px 36px; }
      .recently-played-list { gap: 12px; }
      .recently-played-item { flex-basis: 132px; }
      .music-picks-list { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .music-pick-row { grid-template-columns: 48px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 10px; }
      .music-pick-artwork { width: 48px; height: 48px; }
      .music-picks-controls { gap: 6px; }
      .music-picks-sort { gap: 5px; }
      .home-section-heading:has(#music-picks-sort) { flex-wrap: wrap; }
      .music-picks-sort > span { display: none; }
      .music-picks-sort select { max-width: 145px; padding-right: 24px; }
      .music-pick-download { padding-inline: 10px; font-size: .7rem; }
      .settings-clear-history { align-items: flex-start; flex-direction: column; }
      .media-item { grid-template-columns: 46px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 9px; }
      .media-row-artwork { flex-basis: 46px; width: 46px; height: 46px; }
      .media-actions { margin-left: auto; }
      .edit-fields { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
      .edit-fields > button { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
      .edit-mask-row { align-items: stretch; flex-wrap: wrap; }
      .edit-mask-row .form-field { flex-basis: 100%; }
      .edit-media-row { grid-template-columns: auto 44px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 8px; }
      .edit-artwork-wrap { width: 44px; height: 44px; }
      .edit-track-fields { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
      .edit-track-fields input:not(:first-child) { display: none; }
      .edit-track-meta { display: none; }
      .edit-row-smart { grid-column: 3; justify-self: start; }
      .edit-save { grid-column: 4; grid-row: 1; }
      .playlist-library { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 18px; }
      .playlist-sidebar { padding: 12px; }
      .playlist-list { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(140px, 1fr)); }
      .playlist-view-heading { align-items: flex-start; }
      .playlist-dialog form { padding: 22px; }
      .pi-connection-row { align-items: stretch; flex-direction: column; }
      .download-link-row { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 120px; gap: 8px; }
      .csv-download-controls { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
      .csv-download-controls .secondary-button, .csv-download-section > .primary-button { width: 100%; }
      .download-form > .primary-button { width: 100%; }
      .youtube-search-row { align-items: stretch; flex-direction: column; }
      .youtube-search-row .secondary-button { width: 100%; }
      .youtube-result { grid-template-columns: 88px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 8px 10px; padding: 8px; }
      .youtube-result-thumbnail { width: 88px; grid-row: span 2; }
      .youtube-result-actions { grid-column: 2; flex-direction: row; flex-wrap: wrap; }
      .youtube-selected-video { align-items: flex-start; flex-direction: column; }
      body.has-player main { padding-bottom: calc(210px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); }
      .player-dock {
        right: 8px;
        bottom: calc(74px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
        left: 8px;
        transform: none;
      }
      .player-reveal-zone { display: none; }
      .player-dock.is-revealed { transform: none; }
      .player-reveal { display: none; }
      .player-bar {
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
        grid-template-areas: "track actions" "center center";
        gap: 8px 12px;
        min-height: 124px;
        padding: 10px 12px;
        border: 1px solid var(--border);
        border-radius: 20px;
        box-shadow: 0 12px 34px #0002;
      }
      .player-track { grid-area: track; gap: 9px; }
      .player-artwork, .player-video { flex-basis: 44px; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 10px; }
      .player-track-copy h2 { font-size: 0.82rem; }
      .player-track-copy p { font-size: 0.72rem; }
      .player-center { grid-area: center; grid-template-columns: 38px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 10px; }
      .player-toggle { width: 38px; height: 38px; }
      .player-timeline { grid-template-columns: 32px minmax(50px, 1fr) 32px; gap: 6px; font-size: 0.68rem; }
      .player-actions { grid-area: actions; gap: 7px; }
      .player-speed { width: 52px; padding: 0 4px; font-size: 0.7rem; }
      .player-equalizer-button { width: 32px; height: 30px; flex-basis: 32px; }
      .player-close { flex-basis: 30px; width: 30px; height: 30px; }
      .equalizer-dialog { width: calc(100vw - 16px); max-height: calc(100dvh - 16px); border-radius: 20px; }
      .equalizer-dialog form { gap: 16px; padding: 18px 14px; }
      .equalizer-toolbar { align-items: flex-start; }
      .equalizer-preset-field { align-items: flex-start; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; }
      .equalizer-preset-field select { min-width: 135px; }
      .equalizer-custom-row { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; }
      .equalizer-custom-row .form-field { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
      .settings-dialog { width: calc(100vw - 16px); height: calc(100dvh - 16px); border-radius: 20px; }
      .settings-layout { grid-template-columns: 132px minmax(0, 1fr); }
      .settings-sidebar { padding: 18px 8px; }
      .settings-sidebar-label { margin: 0 8px 14px; font-size: 0.62rem; }
      .settings-nav { gap: 3px; }
      .settings-nav button { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 8px; font-size: 0.76rem; }
      .settings-header { min-height: 58px; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 10px; }
      .settings-back, .settings-close { width: 34px; height: 34px; }
      .settings-content { padding: 22px 14px; }
      .settings-storage-summary { padding: 12px; font-size: 0.84rem; }
      .settings-capacity-meter { padding: 12px; }
      .settings-capacity-heading { align-items: flex-start; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }
      .settings-capacity-heading strong { text-align: left; }
      .settings-storage-form .primary-button { width: 100%; }
      .video-theater .player-dock { bottom: 0; }

The current Watch page can reuse `tracks` and existing playlist records. The fullscreen problem is concentrated in `main.js`: the video element and dock are moved into a theater dialog, but fullscreen and native iOS video events aren’t synchronized. I’ll keep the same video element and playback state, replace the dock-in-theater behavior with dedicated theater controls, and persist video progress in the existing play-history store.

    +  const database = await openDatabase();
    +  const request = database.transaction(HISTORY_STORE, "readonly")
    +    .objectStore(HISTORY_STORE).get(VIDEO_PROGRESS_KEY);
    +  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    +    request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result?.items || []);
    +    request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);

    +export async function recordVideoWatchProgress(mediaId, currentTime, duration) {
    +  if (!mediaId || !Number.isFinite(currentTime) || currentTime < 0) return;
    +  const database = await openDatabase();
    +  const transaction = database.transaction(HISTORY_STORE, "readwrite");
    +  const completion = transactionComplete(transaction);
    +  const store = transaction.objectStore(HISTORY_STORE);
    +  const request = store.get(VIDEO_PROGRESS_KEY);
    +  request.onsuccess = () => {
    +    const items = request.result?.items || [];
    +    const previous = items.find((item) => item.mediaId === mediaId);
    +    const safeDuration = Number.isFinite(duration) && duration > 0 ? duration : (previous?.duration || 0);
    +    const progress = {
    +      mediaId,
    +      currentTime,
    +      duration: safeDuration,
    +      watchedAt: Date.now(),
    +      completed: safeDuration > 0 && currentTime >= safeDuration * 0.9,
    +    };
    +    const nextItems = [progress, ...items.filter((item) => item.mediaId !== mediaId)].slice(0, 100);
    +    store.put({ id: VIDEO_PROGRESS_KEY, items: nextItems });
    +  };
    +  await completion;
    +  window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("puffin:video-progress-updated", { detail: { mediaId } }));
    +}

    import { getVideoWatchHistory, listMediaFiles, listPlaylists } from "./library.js";
    
    const titleOf = (record) => record.title || record.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, "");
    const normalize = (value) => String(value || "").toLocaleLowerCase().trim();
    
    function formatTime(seconds) {
      if (!Number.isFinite(seconds) || seconds <= 0) return "";
      const total = Math.floor(seconds);
      const hours = Math.floor(total / 3600);
      const minutes = Math.floor((total % 3600) / 60);
      const remainder = total % 60;
      return hours
        ? `${hours}:${String(minutes).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(remainder).padStart(2, "0")}`
        : `${minutes}:${String(remainder).padStart(2, "0")}`;
    }
    
    export function initializeWatch({ onPlay }) {
      const featured = document.querySelector("#watch-featured");
      const featuredSection = document.querySelector("#watch-featured-section");
      const continueList = document.querySelector("#watch-continue-list");
      const continueEmpty = document.querySelector("#watch-continue-empty");
      const recentList = document.querySelector("#watch-recent-list");
      const recentEmpty = document.querySelector("#watch-recent-empty");
      const libraryList = document.querySelector("#watch-video-library");
      const libraryEmpty = document.querySelector("#watch-library-empty");
      const searchInput = document.querySelector("#watch-search");
      const filterSelect = document.querySelector("#watch-filter");
      const playlistSelect = document.querySelector("#watch-playlist-filter");
    
      let videos = [];
      let playlists = [];
      let history = [];
      let progressById = new Map();
      let recentIds = new Set();
      let renderRequest = 0;
    
      function makeThumbnail(record, className = "watch-thumbnail") {
        const wrapper = document.createElement("div");
        wrapper.className = className;
        wrapper.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
        wrapper.style.setProperty("--thumbnail-seed", String([...titleOf(record)].reduce((sum, character) => sum + character.charCodeAt(0), 0) % 360));
        const image = document.createElement("img");
        image.alt = "";
        image.loading = "lazy";
        if (record.artwork) {
          image.src = record.artwork;
          image.addEventListener("error", () => {
            image.remove();
            wrapper.classList.add("has-fallback");
          }, { once: true });
          wrapper.append(image);
        } else {
          wrapper.classList.add("has-fallback");
        }
        const playMark = document.createElement("span");
        playMark.className = "watch-thumbnail-mark";
        playMark.textContent = "▶";
        wrapper.append(playMark);
        return wrapper;
      }
    
      function addProgressMark(wrapper, progress) {
        if (!progress || progress.duration <= 0 || progress.completed) return;
        const bar = document.createElement("span");
        bar.className = "watch-progress-track";
        bar.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
        const fill = document.createElement("span");
        fill.style.width = `${Math.max(2, Math.min(100, progress.currentTime / progress.duration * 100))}%`;
        bar.append(fill);
        wrapper.append(bar);
      }
    
      function createVideoCard(record, { progress = progressById.get(record.id), compact = false } = {}) {
        const card = document.createElement("article");
        card.className = compact ? "watch-video-card watch-video-card-compact" : "watch-video-card";
        card.setAttribute("role", "listitem");
        const playButton = document.createElement("button");
        playButton.type = "button";
        playButton.className = "watch-thumbnail-button";
        playButton.setAttribute("aria-label", `Play ${titleOf(record)}`);
        const thumbnail = makeThumbnail(record);
        addProgressMark(thumbnail, progress);
        playButton.append(thumbnail);
        playButton.addEventListener("click", () => onPlay(record, progress && !progress.completed ? progress.currentTime : 0));
        const title = document.createElement("h3");
        title.textContent = titleOf(record);
        const metadata = document.createElement("p");
        metadata.className = "watch-video-metadata";
        const details = [record.artist, formatTime(progress?.duration || record.duration), new Date(record.importedAt).toLocaleDateString()]
          .filter(Boolean);
        metadata.textContent = details.join(" · ") || "Video";
        const textButton = document.createElement("button");
        textButton.type = "button";
        textButton.className = "watch-video-title-button";
        textButton.setAttribute("aria-label", `Play ${titleOf(record)}`);
        textButton.append(title);
        textButton.addEventListener("click", () => onPlay(record, progress && !progress.completed ? progress.currentTime : 0));
        card.append(playButton, textButton, metadata);
        return card;
      }
    
      function renderFeatured() {
        featured.replaceChildren();
        const candidate = [...history]
          .sort((first, second) => second.watchedAt - first.watchedAt)
          .map((item) => videos.find((video) => video.id === item.mediaId))
          .find(Boolean) || videos[0];
        if (!candidate) {
          const empty = document.createElement("div");
          empty.className = "watch-featured-empty";
          const copy = document.createElement("div");
          const eyebrow = document.createElement("p");
          eyebrow.className = "watch-eyebrow";
          eyebrow.textContent = "YOUR PERSONAL VIDEO LIBRARY";
          const heading = document.createElement("h2");
          heading.textContent = "Make room for movie night.";
          const message = document.createElement("p");
          message.textContent = "Videos you import into Puffin will be ready to watch here.";
          const button = document.createElement("button");
          button.type = "button";
          button.className = "secondary-button";
          button.textContent = "Open your library";
          button.addEventListener("click", () => document.querySelector('[data-tab="play"]')?.click());
          copy.append(eyebrow, heading, message, button);
          const art = document.createElement("div");
          art.className = "watch-featured-art watch-featured-art-empty";
          art.innerHTML = '<span aria-hidden="true">▶</span>';
          empty.append(copy, art);
          featured.append(empty);
          return;
        }
    
        const sectionTitle = document.createElement("h2");
        sectionTitle.id = "watch-featured-title";
        sectionTitle.className = "visually-hidden";
        sectionTitle.textContent = "Featured video";
        const hero = document.createElement("article");
        hero.className = "watch-featured-card";
        const art = makeThumbnail(candidate, "watch-featured-art");
        const copy = document.createElement("div");
        copy.className = "watch-featured-copy";
        const eyebrow = document.createElement("p");
        eyebrow.className = "watch-eyebrow";
        eyebrow.textContent = progressById.has(candidate.id) ? "PICK UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF" : "FEATURED VIDEO";
        const heading = document.createElement("h2");
        heading.textContent = titleOf(candidate);
        const metadata = document.createElement("p");
        metadata.className = "watch-featured-metadata";
        metadata.textContent = [candidate.artist, formatTime(progressById.get(candidate.id)?.duration || candidate.duration)]
          .filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
        const play = document.createElement("button");
        play.type = "button";
        play.className = "primary-button watch-featured-play";
        play.textContent = progressById.has(candidate.id) ? "Continue watching" : "Play video";
        play.addEventListener("click", () => {
          const progress = progressById.get(candidate.id);
          onPlay(candidate, progress && !progress.completed ? progress.currentTime : 0);
        });
        copy.append(eyebrow, heading, metadata, play);
        hero.append(art, copy);
        featured.append(sectionTitle, hero);
      }
    
      function renderShortRows() {
        const continueVideos = [...history]
          .filter((item) => !item.completed && item.currentTime > 1)
          .sort((first, second) => second.watchedAt - first.watchedAt)
          .map((item) => videos.find((video) => video.id === item.mediaId))
          .filter(Boolean)
          .slice(0, 12);
        continueList.replaceChildren(...continueVideos.map((record) => createVideoCard(record, { compact: true })));
        continueEmpty.hidden = continueVideos.length > 0;
    
        const recentVideos = [...history]
          .sort((first, second) => second.watchedAt - first.watchedAt)
          .map((item) => videos.find((video) => video.id === item.mediaId))
          .filter((record, index, list) => record && list.findIndex((candidate) => candidate.id === record.id) === index)
          .slice(0, 12);
        recentIds = new Set(recentVideos.map((record) => record.id));
        recentList.replaceChildren(...recentVideos.map((record) => createVideoCard(record, { compact: true })));
        recentEmpty.hidden = recentVideos.length > 0;
      }
    
      function renderLibrary() {
        const query = normalize(searchInput.value);
        const selectedPlaylist = playlistSelect.value;
        const playlist = playlists.find((item) => item.id === selectedPlaylist);
        const playlistIds = playlist ? new Set(playlist.mediaIds) : null;
        let filtered = videos.filter((record) => {
          if (playlistIds && !playlistIds.has(record.id)) return false;
          const searchable = normalize([titleOf(record), record.name, record.artist, record.album, record.genre].join(" "));
          if (query && !searchable.includes(query)) return false;
          if (filterSelect.value === "continue") {
            const progress = progressById.get(record.id);
            return Boolean(progress && !progress.completed && progress.currentTime > 1);
          }
          if (filterSelect.value === "recent") return recentIds.has(record.id);
          return true;
        });
        filtered = filtered.sort((first, second) => second.importedAt - first.importedAt);
        libraryList.replaceChildren(...filtered.map((record) => createVideoCard(record)));
        libraryEmpty.hidden = filtered.length > 0;
      }
    
      function renderPlaylistOptions() {
        const previousValue = playlistSelect.value;
        playlistSelect.replaceChildren(new Option("All playlists", "all"));
        playlists.forEach((playlist) => playlistSelect.add(new Option(playlist.name, playlist.id)));
        playlistSelect.value = playlists.some((playlist) => playlist.id === previousValue) ? previousValue : "all";
      }
    
      async function render() {
        const request = ++renderRequest;
        try {
          const [records, nextPlaylists, nextHistory] = await Promise.all([
            listMediaFiles(), listPlaylists(), getVideoWatchHistory(),
          ]);
          if (request !== renderRequest) return;
          videos = records.filter((record) => record.kind === "video");
          playlists = nextPlaylists;
          history = nextHistory.filter((item) => videos.some((record) => record.id === item.mediaId));
          progressById = new Map(history.map((item) => [item.mediaId, item]));
          renderPlaylistOptions();
          renderFeatured();
          renderShortRows();
          renderLibrary();
          featuredSection.hidden = false;
        } catch (error) {
          featured.replaceChildren();
          const message = document.createElement("p");
          message.className = "watch-empty";
          message.textContent = `Could not load videos: ${error.message}`;
          featured.append(message);
        }
      }
    
      searchInput.addEventListener("input", renderLibrary);
      filterSelect.addEventListener("change", renderLibrary);
      playlistSelect.addEventListener("change", renderLibrary);
      window.addEventListener("puffin:library-updated", render);
      window.addEventListener("puffin:metadata-updated", render);
      window.addEventListener("puffin:video-progress-updated", render);
      window.addEventListener("puffin:tab-changed", (event) => {
        if (event.detail === "watch") render();
      });
      render();
    }

    function formatTime(seconds) {
      if (!Number.isFinite(seconds) || seconds < 0) return "0:00";
      const total = Math.floor(seconds);
      const hours = Math.floor(total / 3600);
      const minutes = Math.floor((total % 3600) / 60);
      const remainder = String(total % 60).padStart(2, "0");
      return hours ? `${hours}:${String(minutes).padStart(2, "0")}:${remainder}` : `${minutes}:${remainder}`;
    }
    
    function getPlaybackErrorMessage(player, error) {
      const mediaErrorCode = player.error?.code;
      if (error?.name === "NotAllowedError") {
        return "The browser blocked playback. Tap Play again to allow it.";
      }
      if (error?.name === "NotSupportedError" || mediaErrorCode === 3 || mediaErrorCode === 4) {
        return "This file uses a video or audio codec the browser cannot play. Try an H.264/AAC MP4.";
      }
      if (mediaErrorCode === 2) {
        return "The browser could not load this media file from local storage.";
      }
      return `Playback failed${error?.name ? ` (${error.name})` : ""}.`;
    }
    
    function updatePlayerControls() {

      const currentTime = activePlayer && Number.isFinite(activePlayer.currentTime) ? activePlayer.currentTime : 0;
      playerSeek.max = String(duration);
      playerSeek.disabled = !activePlayer || duration <= 0;
      if (!isSeeking) playerSeek.value = String(Math.min(currentTime, duration));
      playerCurrentTime.textContent = formatTime(currentTime);
      playerDuration.textContent = formatTime(duration);
    
      const playing = Boolean(activePlayer && !activePlayer.paused && !activePlayer.ended);
      playerToggle.textContent = playing ? "Ⅱ" : "▶";

      playerToggle.title = playing ? "Pause" : "Play";
      updateVideoTheaterControls();
      if (playing && activePlayer === videoPlayer && videoTheater.open) scheduleVideoControlsHide();
    }
    
    function updateVideoTheaterControls() {

## Assistant

The requested feature flows are implemented. The mobile navigation is now a six-item bottom bar, scrolling stays in the content area above it, and the editor’s hidden metadata fields are available on phones. I also bumped the service worker cache so the new Watch module joins Puffin’s offline shell. The environment has no browser automation or installed browser, so I’m using the project build/tests and static interaction checks here; physical-device fullscreen testing will still be needed.

    $ sed -n '1,100p' README.md
    # Puffin
    
    Puffin is a music and video app for macOS and iOS. It is designed as a static Progressive Web App (PWA), hosted on Vercel, with an interface that adapts to desktop and mobile screens. Its main features are downloading, editing, playing, and tracking music and video.
    
    ## Download
    
    Users can paste a YouTube link or search YouTube within Puffin. Search results show video thumbnails, titles, channels, and durations; users can preview a result in YouTube or select it for download. Audio downloads preserve the source audio format when the browser supports it, with AAC in M4A as a compatibility fallback. Video downloads use H.264 video and AAC audio in MP4 for browser compatibility.
    
    Downloads are intended for public-domain videos or users' own videos. Users are trusted to download only content they are authorized to download.
    
    ### Download workflow
    
    The PWA sends a download request to a private service running on a Raspberry Pi. The Pi runs `yt-dlp`, temporarily stores the downloaded file, and streams it to the device that requested it. Puffin saves the file in that device's browser storage for offline playback. After Puffin confirms that the local save succeeded, the Pi deletes its temporary copy. The Pi has approximately 18 GB of available storage for temporary files.
    
    The Raspberry Pi service is intended to be reachable only over a private network. Tailscale must be installed and connected on the Pi and on each Mac or iPhone that will request downloads. If the Pi or private connection is unavailable, new downloads cannot be requested; files already saved on a device remain available offline.
    
    The Pi service setup, including Raspberry Pi OS commands, Tailscale Serve, and an optional systemd service for automatic startup, is documented in [pi-service/README.md](pi-service/README.md). Set `PUFFIN_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` there to the exact Vercel deployment origin and any local development origin you use. The Pi stores downloads only temporarily; Puffin stores each completed file in the requesting device's browser storage.
    
    ## Edit
    
    The Edit tab is a music tag editor with the following features:
    
    - **Batch editing:** Modify multiple files at once to standardize capitalization, genres, album titles, and other tags.
    - **Filename and tag conversion:** Convert between filenames and tags using custom naming masks.
    - **Metadata lookup:** Look up metadata from online sources such as MusicBrainz.
    
    ## Play
    
    The Play tab plays downloaded audio and video from the local library. Pi downloads preserve a browser-supported source audio format where possible, with AAC in M4A as a compatibility fallback; videos use H.264 with AAC audio in MP4. Files imported from the device are kept in their original format; browser playback depends on the codecs the browser supports. Users can create, rename, and delete playlists, add or remove local media, and pin playlists to the top. Playlist data and media files are stored on the device. It includes an equalizer with:
    
    - **Multiple bands:** Support five to ten or more bands, covering core hearing ranges from sub-bass (20–60 Hz) to treble and air (8–16+ kHz). A 10-band graphic equalizer offers a balance between control and simplicity.
    - **Preset profiles:** Quick-start modes such as Rock, Pop, Classical, Vocal Boost, and Flat.
    - **Preamp / gain control:** Lower overall volume when boosting frequencies to help prevent digital clipping and distortion.
    - **Custom presets:** Save, name, and recall frequency curves for different headphones or speakers.
    
    The player also includes an audio visualizer with dancing bars, play and pause, shuffle, repeat, queue controls (add to queue and edit queue), and a smooth scrub bar.
    
    ## Stats
    
    The Stats tab displays separate tables ranking the most frequently played artists, albums, and songs. It also shows total listening time and the storage space used by media files. Users can reset their statistics.
    
    ## Interface
    
    The home page should have a navigation menu for Download, Edit, Play, and Stats; a dark-mode button; and a settings gear icon. The main area should display:
    
    > **Puffin: A Music Player**
    > Click an option to get started
    
    The PWA should provide a more compact mobile layout while keeping all features available.

      if (!count && !errorMessage) return;
      await updateStats((stats) => {
        const day = getOrCreateStatsDay(stats, localDateKey());
        day[type] += count;
        if (type === "failedJobs" && errorMessage) {
          stats.recentErrors ||= [];

      });

    async function cacheModuleGraph(cache, moduleUrl, visited = new Set()) {

      await Promise.all(importPaths.map((importPath) => {
        const importUrl = new URL(importPath, moduleUrl);
        if (importUrl.origin !== self.location.origin) return Promise.resolve();

      }));
    }

            if (response.ok) {
              await caches.open(CACHE_NAME).then((cache) => cache.put(request, response.clone()));

## Assistant

During the final interaction audit, I found that videos launched from Play playlists or Home’s recent list still stayed in the compact dock. I’ve routed those launches into the same expanded Watch player too, so video selection behaves consistently across the app. I also enabled full-bleed mobile safe-area handling for notched screens.

    3:Puffin is a music and video app for macOS and iOS. It is designed as a static Progressive Web App (PWA), hosted on Vercel, with an interface that adapts to desktop and mobile screens. Its main features are downloading, editing, playing, and tracking music and video.
    7:Users can paste a YouTube link or search YouTube within Puffin. Search results show video thumbnails, titles, channels, and durations; users can preview a result in YouTube or select it for download. Audio downloads preserve the source audio format when the browser supports it, with AAC in M4A as a compatibility fallback. Video downloads use H.264 video and AAC audio in MP4 for browser compatibility.

Implemented the Watch experience using Puffin’s existing IndexedDB media records and playlist system.

### What changed

Existing playlists can filter its library. See [index.html](/Users/admin/Desktop/Puffin/web/index.html:91) and [watch.js](/Users/admin/Desktop/Puffin/web/src/watch.js:1).
- Added on-device video progress to the existing `playHistory` store, without creating a separate database or changing the schema. Videos selected from Watch, Play, or Home open in the expanded player. See [library.js](/Users/admin/Desktop/Puffin/web/src/library.js:351) and [main.js](/Users/admin/Desktop/Puffin/web/src/main.js:271).

- Added fullscreen synchronization for standard and WebKit APIs, iOS video fullscreen events, Escape, browser Back, tab changes, and explicit close. The video uses `playsinline`; the dock is hidden while the theater is open.
- Added responsive bottom navigation, touch-friendly controls, safe-area support, and mobile layouts for the Watch page and existing app screens. Bumped the service worker cache so the new module is included offline.           activeView = "all";

        playTitle.hidden = viewingPlaylist;

          playPanel.setAttribute("aria-label", "Play");

          playPanel.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", "play-title");
          playPanel.removeAttribute("aria-label");

          ? playlist.mediaIds.map((id) => mediaRecords.find((record) => record.id === id)).filter(Boolean)

        viewEyebrow.textContent = playlist ? "PLAYLIST" : "LIBRARY";

        viewCount.textContent = `${visibleRecords.length} ${visibleRecords.length === 1 ? "item" : "items"}`;
        viewActions.replaceChildren();

    function formatBytes(bytes) {
      if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`;
      const units = ["KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"];
      let value = bytes / 1024;
      let unit = 0;
      while (value >= 1024 && unit < units.length - 1) {
        value /= 1024;
        unit += 1;
      }
      return `${value.toFixed(value >= 100 ? 0 : 1)} ${units[unit]}`;
    }

      function renderPlaylistSidebar() {
        playlistList.replaceChildren();
        allMediaButton.classList.toggle("is-selected", activeView === "all");
        if (activeView === "all") allMediaButton.setAttribute("aria-current", "page");
        else allMediaButton.removeAttribute("aria-current");
    
        playlists.forEach((playlist) => {
          const item = document.createElement("li");
          item.className = "playlist-item";
          if (activeView === playlist.id) item.classList.add("is-selected");
    
          const selectButton = document.createElement("button");
          selectButton.type = "button";
          selectButton.className = "playlist-item-button";
          if (activeView === playlist.id) selectButton.setAttribute("aria-current", "page");
          selectButton.addEventListener("click", () => {
            activeView = playlist.id;
            render();
          });
    
          const name = document.createElement("span");
          name.className = "playlist-item-name";
          name.textContent = playlist.name;
          selectButton.append(name);
          if (playlist.pinned) {
            const pinMark = document.createElement("span");
            pinMark.className = "playlist-pin-mark";
            pinMark.setAttribute("aria-label", "Pinned");
            pinMark.textContent = "◆";
            selectButton.append(pinMark);
          }
    
          const count = document.createElement("span");
        item.append(artwork, info, actions);
        return item;
      }
    
      function renderMediaList() {
        mediaList.replaceChildren();
        let playlist = activeView === "all" ? null : playlists.find((item) => item.id === activeView);
        if (activeView !== "all" && !playlist) {
          activeView = "all";
          playlist = null;
        }
        const viewingPlaylist = Boolean(playlist);
        playTitle.hidden = viewingPlaylist;
        importButton.hidden = viewingPlaylist;
        if (viewingPlaylist) {
          playPanel.removeAttribute("aria-labelledby");
          playPanel.setAttribute("aria-label", "Play");
        } else {
          playPanel.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", "play-title");
          playPanel.removeAttribute("aria-label");
        }
        const visibleRecords = playlist
          ? playlist.mediaIds.map((id) => mediaRecords.find((record) => record.id === id)).filter(Boolean)
          : mediaRecords;
    
        viewEyebrow.textContent = playlist ? "PLAYLIST" : "LIBRARY";
        viewTitle.textContent = playlist?.name || "All media";
        viewCount.textContent = `${visibleRecords.length} ${visibleRecords.length === 1 ? "item" : "items"}`;
        viewActions.replaceChildren();
    
        if (visibleRecords.length === 0) {
          const empty = document.createElement("li");
          empty.className = "playlist-empty-state";
          if (playlist) {
            const message = document.createElement("p");
            message.textContent = "This playlist is empty.";
            const browse = document.createElement("button");
            browse.type = "button";
            browse.className = "secondary-button";
            browse.textContent = "Browse all media";
            browse.addEventListener("click", () => {
              activeView = "all";

            empty.append(message, browse);

    .edit-track-meta { color: var(--muted); font-size: .85rem; white-space: nowrap; }
    .edit-row-smart { padding: 8px 10px; }
    .edit-save { width: 38px; height: 38px; color: var(--accent); }
    .media-action { display: grid; width: 40px; min-height: 40px; padding: 0; place-items: center; font-size: 1rem; }
    .media-action.secondary { color: var(--text); background: var(--page); border: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .media-action.secondary:hover { background: var(--accent-soft); }
    .media-action.danger { color: #a52a2a; background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .media-action.danger:hover { background: #fff0f0; }
    .empty-library { padding: 22px 18px; color: var(--muted); background: var(--page); border-radius: 16px; text-align: center; }
    
    .playlist-library { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(190px, 240px) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 24px; margin-top: 30px; }
    .playlist-sidebar { align-self: start; min-width: 0; padding: 14px; background: var(--page); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 20px; }
    .playlist-sidebar-heading { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; margin: 2px 2px 12px 8px; }
    .playlist-sidebar-heading h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 0.95rem; }
    .round-button, .round-icon-button { display: inline-grid; flex: 0 0 auto; width: 40px; height: 40px; padding: 0; place-items: center; color: var(--text); background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 50%; cursor: pointer; }
    .round-button { font-size: 1.4rem; line-height: 1; }
    .round-button:hover, .round-icon-button:hover { background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent); }
    .playlist-nav-item { display: flex; width: 100%; min-height: 46px; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 0 12px; color: var(--muted); background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; font-weight: 600; }
    .playlist-nav-item:hover, .playlist-item-button:hover { background: var(--surface); }

    ## Stats
    
    The Stats tab displays separate tables ranking the most frequently played artists, albums, and songs. It also shows total listening time and the storage space used by media files. Users can reset their statistics.
    
    ## Interface
    
    The app has a navigation menu for Watch, Download, Edit, Play, and Stats, plus a dark-mode button and settings. Home shows recently played music and optional music picks.
    
    The PWA should provide a more compact mobile layout while keeping all features available.

      if (error?.name === "NotAllowedError") {

      if (error?.name === "NotSupportedError" || mediaErrorCode === 3 || mediaErrorCode === 4) {

The sidebar now follows the concept’s grouping: Discover, Your Library, and tools. On desktop it can collapse to an icon rail; on phones it opens as a drawer. The video title and controls now sit over the video and fade out after three seconds of inactivity. I’m checking the navigation and player changes together now.

## Assistant

GitHub rejected the push because `origin/main` has a commit your local `main` doesn’t have. Your local tracking info shows **2 commits ahead and 1 behind**: your local commits include `UI Redesign`, while the remote has `Update preset profiles in README.md`.

Fetch the latest remote state, then rebase your commits on top of it:

```bash
git fetch origin
git log --oneline --graph --decorate --left-right origin/main...main
git rebase origin/main
git push origin main
```

Because both sides changed `README.md`, the rebase may stop for a conflict. If it does, keep both the remote preset-profile update and your local README changes, then run:

```bash
git add README.md
git rebase --continue
```

If you want to cancel the rebase, run `git rebase --abort`. Avoid `git push --force`; the remote commit should be incorporated, not overwritten.

    export async function assertMediaStorageCapacity(incomingBytes) {
      const capacity = await getMediaStorageCapacity();
      return assertMediaFits(capacity.usedBytes, capacity.limitBytes, incomingBytes);
    }
    
    export async function listMediaFiles() {
      const database = await openDatabase();
      const transaction = database.transaction(TRACKS_STORE, "readonly");
      const request = transaction.objectStore(TRACKS_STORE).getAll();
    
      return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        request.onsuccess = () => {
          resolve(request.result.sort((first, second) => second.importedAt - first.importedAt));
        };
        request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
      });
    }
    
    export async function updateMediaMetadata(id, updates) {
      const database = await openDatabase();
      const transaction = database.transaction(TRACKS_STORE, "readwrite");
      const completion = transactionComplete(transaction);
      const store = transaction.objectStore(TRACKS_STORE);
      const request = store.get(id);
      let updatedRecord;
      request.onsuccess = () => {
        if (!request.result) {
          transaction.abort();
          return;
        }
        updatedRecord = { ...request.result, ...updates, updatedAt: Date.now() };
        store.put(updatedRecord);

    export async function listPlaylists() {
      const database = await openDatabase();
      const transaction = database.transaction(PLAYLISTS_STORE, "readonly");
      const request = transaction.objectStore(PLAYLISTS_STORE).getAll();
    
      return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result.sort((first, second) => {
          if (first.pinned !== second.pinned) return Number(second.pinned) - Number(first.pinned);
          return first.createdAt - second.createdAt;
        }));
        request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
      });
    }

        artwork.alt = "";
        artwork.addEventListener("error", () => { if (!artwork.src.endsWith("/favicon.svg")) artwork.src = "/favicon.svg"; }, { once: true });
        const info = document.createElement("div");
        info.className = "media-info";
        const name = document.createElement("span");
        name.className = "media-name";
        name.textContent = record.title || record.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, "");
        const details = document.createElement("span");
        details.className = "media-details";
        const typeAndSize = `${record.kind === "video" ? "Video" : "Audio"} · ${formatBytes(record.size)}`;
        const formatDuration = (seconds) => `${Math.floor(seconds / 60)}:${String(Math.floor(seconds % 60)).padStart(2, "0")}`;
        const updateDetails = (duration = record.duration) => {
          details.textContent = [
            record.artist,
            record.album,
            Number.isFinite(duration) && duration > 0 ? formatDuration(duration) : "",
            typeAndSize,
            `Added ${new Date(record.importedAt).toLocaleDateString()}`,
          ].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
        };
        updateDetails();
        if (!Number.isFinite(record.duration)) {
          getMediaBlob(record.id).then((blob) => {
            if (!blob) return;
            const element = document.createElement(record.kind === "video" ? "video" : "audio");
            const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            element.preload = "metadata";
            element.onloadedmetadata = () => { updateDetails(element.duration); URL.revokeObjectURL(url); };
            element.onerror = () => URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
            element.src = url;
          }).catch(() => {});
        }
        info.append(name, details);
    
        const actions = document.createElement("div");
        actions.className = "media-actions";
        actions.append(iconButton("Play", ICONS.play, "media-action", () => onPlay(record)));
        const overflow = document.createElement("details");
        overflow.className = "media-overflow";
        const summary = document.createElement("summary");
        summary.setAttribute("aria-label", `More options for ${record.title || record.name}`);
        summary.title = "More options";
        summary.textContent = "•••";
        const menu = document.createElement("div");
        menu.className = "media-overflow-menu";
        if (playlist) {
          const remove = document.createElement("button"); remove.type = "button"; remove.textContent = "Remove from playlist";
          remove.addEventListener("click", async () => {

        overflow.append(summary, menu);
        actions.append(overflow);
        item.append(artwork, info, actions);
        return item;

                </button>
                <button class="nav-button" type="button" data-tab="play" data-library-view="listen" aria-label="Listen" title="Listen">
                  <span class="nav-icon" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M9 18V5l12-2v13M9 18a3 3 0 1 1-3-3c1.7 0 3 1.3 3 3Zm12-2a3 3 0 1 1-3-3c1.7 0 3 1.3 3 3Z"/></svg></span><span class="nav-label">Listen</span>
                </button>
                <button class="nav-button" type="button" data-tab="watch" aria-label="Watch" title="Watch">
                  <span class="nav-icon" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 7.5 21 5v12L3 19.5v-12ZM3 12l18-2.5M8 6.8l2.5 5M14 6l2.5 5"/></svg></span><span class="nav-label">Watch</span>
                </button>
              </section>
              <section class="nav-group" aria-labelledby="nav-library-heading">
                <h2 class="nav-group-heading" id="nav-library-heading">Your Library</h2>
                <button class="nav-button" type="button" data-tab="play" data-library-view="library" aria-label="Library" title="Library">
                  <span class="nav-icon" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 4v16M9 6v12M14 4v16M19 8v12"/></svg></span><span class="nav-label">Library</span>
                </button>
                <button class="nav-button" type="button" data-tab="play" data-library-view="playlists" aria-label="Playlists" title="Playlists">
                  <span class="nav-icon" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 5h12M4 10h12M4 15h7M18 4v13a2 2 0 1 1-2-2h2M4 20h7"/></svg></span><span class="nav-label">Playlists</span>
