                </button>
                <button class="nav-button" type="button" data-tab="edit" aria-label="Edit" title="Edit">
                  <span class="nav-icon" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="m4 16.5-.9 4.4 4.4-.9L20 7.5 16.5 4 4 16.5ZM14.5 6l3.5 3.5"/></svg></span><span class="nav-label">Edit</span>
                </button>
                <button class="nav-button" type="button" data-tab="stats" aria-label="Stats" title="Stats">
                  <span class="nav-icon" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 20v-6M12 20V9M19 20V4"/></svg></span><span class="nav-label">Stats</span>
                </button>
              </section>
            </nav>
            <div class="sidebar-bottom">
              <button class="nav-button settings-nav-button" id="settings-open" data-open-settings type="button" aria-label="Settings" title="Settings">
                <span class="nav-icon" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 8.5a3.5 3.5 0 1 0 0 7 3.5 3.5 0 0 0 0-7Z"/><path d="m19.4 13.5 1.1.9-1.5 2.6-1.4-.5a7.8 7.8 0 0 1-1.5.9l-.3 1.5h-3l-.3-1.5a7.8 7.8 0 0 1-1.5-.9l-1.4.5-1.5-2.6 1.1-.9a7.4 7.4 0 0 1 0-1.8l-1.1-.9 1.5-2.6 1.4.5a7.8 7.8 0 0 1 1.5-.9l.3-1.5h3l.3 1.5a7.8 7.8 0 0 1 1.5.9l1.4-.5 1.5 2.6-1.1.9a7.4 7.4 0 0 1 0 1.8Z"/></svg></span><span class="nav-label">Settings</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </aside>
          <button id="sidebar-scrim" class="sidebar-scrim" type="button" aria-label="Close navigation" tabindex="-1" hidden></button>
    
          <div class="workspace">
            <header class="topbar">
              <button class="icon-button mobile-menu-button" id="mobile-menu-open" type="button" aria-label="Open navigation" aria-controls="app-sidebar" aria-expanded="false" title="Open navigation">☰</button>
              <button class="icon-button" id="theme-toggle" type="button" aria-label="Toggle dark mode" aria-pressed="false" title="Toggle dark mode">☾</button>
            </header>
    
            <main>
              <section class="panel home-panel" id="home-panel" data-panel="home" aria-labelledby="home-title">
                <h1 id="home-title">Home</h1>
                <div class="home-sections">
                  <section class="home-section" id="recently-played-section" aria-labelledby="recently-played-title">
                    <div class="home-section-heading">
                      <h2 id="recently-played-title">Recently played</h2>
                      <div class="recent-scroll-controls" aria-label="Recently played controls">
                        <button id="recent-scroll-left" class="round-button" type="button" aria-label="Scroll recently played left" title="Scroll left" disabled>‹</button>
                        <button id="recent-scroll-right" class="round-button" type="button" aria-label="Scroll recently played right" title="Scroll right" disabled>›</button>
                        <button id="recent-scroll-right" class="round-button" type="button" aria-label="Scroll recently played right" title="Scroll right" disabled>›</button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <p id="recently-played-empty" class="home-empty-state">Your recently played music will appear here.</p>
                    <ol id="recently-played-list" class="recently-played-list" aria-label="Your last 30 played songs" hidden></ol>
                  </section>
                  <section class="home-section" id="music-picks-section" aria-labelledby="music-picks-title">
                    <div class="home-section-heading">
                      <h2 id="music-picks-title">Music picks</h2>
                      <div class="music-picks-controls">
                        <label class="music-picks-sort">
                          <span>Sort</span>
                          <select id="music-picks-sort" aria-label="Sort music picks by relevance">
                            <option value="desc">Most relevant</option>
                            <option value="asc">Least relevant</option>
                          </select>
                        </label>
                        <button id="music-picks-refresh" class="secondary-button music-picks-refresh" type="button" aria-label="Refresh music picks">↻ <span id="music-picks-refresh-label">Refresh</span></button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <p id="music-picks-status" class="home-empty-state" role="status" aria-live="polite">Add a MusicAtlas API key in Settings to get music picks.</p>
                    <ol id="music-picks-list" class="music-picks-list" aria-label="Recommended songs" hidden></ol>
                    <p id="musicatlas-attribution" class="musicatlas-attribution" hidden>Music recommendations by <a href="https://musicatlas.ai/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">MusicAtlas</a></p>
                  </section>
                </div>
              </section>
    
              <section class="panel watch-panel" id="watch-panel" data-panel="watch" aria-labelledby="watch-title" hidden>
                <header class="watch-page-heading">
                  <div><p class="watch-eyebrow">PUFFIN VIDEO</p><h1 id="watch-title" tabindex="-1">Watch</h1><p class="muted">Your videos, ready when you are.</p></div>
                </header>
                <section id="watch-featured-section" class="watch-featured-section" aria-labelledby="watch-featured-title">
                  <h2 id="watch-featured-title" class="visually-hidden">Featured video</h2>
                  <div id="watch-featured"></div>
                </section>
                <section id="watch-continue-section" class="watch-library-section" aria-labelledby="watch-continue-title">
                  <div class="watch-section-heading"><div><p class="watch-eyebrow">PICK UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF</p><h2 id="watch-continue-title">Continue watching</h2></div></div>
                  <p id="watch-continue-empty" class="watch-empty" hidden>No videos in progress yet.</p>
                  <div id="watch-continue-list" class="watch-card-grid watch-card-row" role="list"></div>
                </section>
                <section id="watch-recent-section" class="watch-library-section" aria-labelledby="watch-recent-title">
                  <div class="watch-section-heading"><div><p class="watch-eyebrow">BACK FOR MORE</p><h2 id="watch-recent-title">Recently watched</h2></div></div>
                  <p id="watch-recent-empty" class="watch-empty" hidden>Videos you watch will appear here.</p>
                  <div id="watch-recent-list" class="watch-card-grid watch-card-row" role="list"></div>
                </section>
                <section class="watch-library-section" aria-labelledby="watch-library-title">
                  <div class="watch-section-heading watch-library-heading"><div><p class="watch-eyebrow">ON THIS DEVICE</p><h2 id="watch-library-title">Your video library</h2></div></div>
                  <div class="watch-library-controls">
                    <label class="watch-search"><span class="visually-hidden">Search videos</span><input id="watch-search" type="search" placeholder="Search videos" autocomplete="off" /></label>
                    <label class="watch-select-field"><span>Show</span><select id="watch-filter"><option value="all">All videos</option><option value="continue">Continue watching</option><option value="recent">Recently watched</option></select></label>
                    <label class="watch-select-field"><span>Playlist</span><select id="watch-playlist-filter"><option value="all">All playlists</option></select></label>
                  </div>
                  <p id="watch-library-empty" class="watch-empty" hidden>No videos match these filters.</p>
                  <div id="watch-video-library" class="watch-card-grid" role="list"></div>
                </section>
              </section>
    
              <section class="panel" id="download-panel" data-panel="download" aria-labelledby="download-title" hidden>
                <h1 id="download-title">Download</h1>
                <form id="download-form" class="download-form">
                  <div class="download-source-switch" role="group" aria-label="Choose download source">
                    <button id="download-source-link" class="is-selected" type="button" aria-pressed="true">Enter a link or search</button>
                    <button id="download-source-browse" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Browse YouTube</button>
                  </div>
                  <div id="download-link-row" class="download-link-row">
                    <label id="youtube-link-field" class="form-field">
                      <span id="download-link-label">YouTube link or search phrase</span>
                      <input id="youtube-url" name="youtube-url" type="text" placeholder="Paste a YouTube link or search, e.g. Apollo 11 highlights" autocomplete="off" required />
                    </label>
                    <label class="form-field format-field" for="download-kind">
                      <span>Format</span>
                      <select id="download-kind" name="download-kind">
                        <option value="audio">Audio · original format when supported</option>
                        <option value="video">Video · MP4</option>
                      </select>
                    </label>
                  </div>
                  <section id="youtube-browse-panel" class="youtube-browse-panel" aria-label="Search YouTube" hidden>
                    <div class="youtube-search-row">
                      <label class="form-field" for="youtube-search-query">
                        <span>Search YouTube</span>
            actions.open = false;
            openDeletePlaylistDialog(playlist);
          });
          menu.append(pinButton, renameButton, deleteButton);
          actions.append(menu);
          item.append(selectButton, actions);
          playlistList.append(item);
        });
      }
    
      function renderMediaRow(record, playlist) {
        const item = document.createElement("li");
        item.className = "media-item";
    
        const artwork = document.createElement("img");
        artwork.className = "media-row-artwork";
        artwork.src = record.artwork || "/favicon.svg";
        artwork.alt = "";
        artwork.addEventListener("error", () => { if (!artwork.src.endsWith("/favicon.svg")) artwork.src = "/favicon.svg"; }, { once: true });
        const info = document.createElement("div");
        info.className = "media-info";
        const name = document.createElement("span");
        name.className = "media-name";
        name.textContent = record.title || record.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, "");
        const details = document.createElement("span");
        details.className = "media-details";
        const typeLabel = record.kind === "video" ? "Video" : "Audio";
        const formatDuration = (seconds) => `${Math.floor(seconds / 60)}:${String(Math.floor(seconds % 60)).padStart(2, "0")}`;
        const updateDetails = (duration = record.duration) => {
          details.textContent = [
            record.artist,
            record.album,
            Number.isFinite(duration) && duration > 0 ? formatDuration(duration) : "",
            typeLabel,
          ].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
        };
        updateDetails();
        if (!Number.isFinite(record.duration)) {
          getMediaBlob(record.id).then((blob) => {
            if (!blob) return;
            const element = document.createElement(record.kind === "video" ? "video" : "audio");
            const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            element.preload = "metadata";
            element.onloadedmetadata = () => { updateDetails(element.duration); URL.revokeObjectURL(url); };
            element.onerror = () => URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
            element.src = url;
          }).catch(() => {});
        }
        info.append(name, details);
    
        const actions = document.createElement("div");
        actions.className = "media-actions";
        actions.append(iconButton("Play", ICONS.play, "media-action", () => onPlay(record)));
        const overflow = document.createElement("details");
        overflow.className = "media-overflow";
        const summary = document.createElement("summary");
        summary.setAttribute("aria-label", `More options for ${record.title || record.name}`);
        summary.title = "More options";
        summary.textContent = "•••";
        const menu = document.createElement("div");
        menu.className = "media-overflow-menu";
        const more = document.createElement("button");
        more.type = "button";
        more.textContent = "More";
        more.addEventListener("click", () => {
          const info = document.createElement("p");
          info.className = "media-extra-info";
          const percent = getMediaStorageLimit() > 0 ? (record.size / getMediaStorageLimit() * 100).toFixed(2) : "0.00";
          info.textContent = `Added ${new Date(record.importedAt).toLocaleDateString()} · ${formatBytes(record.size)} · ${percent}% of storage limit`;
          more.replaceWith(info);
        });
        menu.append(more);
        if (playlist) {
          const remove = document.createElement("button"); remove.type = "button"; remove.textContent = "Remove from playlist";
          remove.addEventListener("click", async () => {
            await removeMediaFromPlaylist(playlist.id, record.id);
            await render();
            setStatus(`Removed from ${playlist.name}.`);
          }); menu.append(remove);
        } else {
          const add = document.createElement("button"); add.type = "button"; add.textContent = "Add to playlist"; add.addEventListener("click", () => openAddToPlaylistDialog(record)); menu.append(add);
        }
        const removeLibrary = document.createElement("button"); removeLibrary.type = "button"; removeLibrary.className = "danger-menu-action"; removeLibrary.textContent = "Delete from library"; removeLibrary.addEventListener("click", () => openDeleteMediaDialog(record)); menu.append(removeLibrary);
        overflow.append(summary, menu);
        actions.append(overflow);
        item.append(artwork, info, actions);
        return item;
      }
    
      function renderMediaList() {
        mediaList.replaceChildren();
        mediaList.replaceChildren();
        let playlist = activeView === "all" ? null : playlists.find((item) => item.id === activeView);
        if (activeView !== "all" && !playlist) {
          activeView = "all";
          playlist = null;
        }
        const viewingPlaylist = Boolean(playlist);
        playlistBrowser.hidden = currentLibraryView !== "playlists";
        libraryLayout.classList.toggle("is-playlist-view", currentLibraryView === "playlists");
        playPanel.setAttribute("aria-label", viewingPlaylist ? "Playlist" : "Library");
        playPanel.removeAttribute("aria-labelledby");
        const selectedRecords = playlist
          ? playlist.mediaIds.map((id) => mediaRecords.find((record) => record.id === id)).filter(Boolean)
          : mediaRecords;
        const visibleRecords = mediaKindFilter
          ? selectedRecords.filter((record) => record.kind === mediaKindFilter)
          : selectedRecords;
    
        viewEyebrow.textContent = playlist ? "PLAYLIST" : mediaKindFilter === "audio" ? "YOUR MUSIC" : "LIBRARY";
        viewTitle.textContent = playlist?.name || (mediaKindFilter === "audio" ? "Listen" : "All media");
        viewCount.textContent = `${visibleRecords.length} ${visibleRecords.length === 1 ? "item" : "items"}`;
        viewActions.replaceChildren();
    
        if (visibleRecords.length === 0) {
          const empty = document.createElement("li");
          empty.className = "playlist-empty-state";
          if (playlist) {
            const message = document.createElement("p");
            message.textContent = "This playlist is empty.";
            const browse = document.createElement("button");
            browse.type = "button";
            browse.className = "secondary-button";
            browse.textContent = "Browse all media";
            browse.addEventListener("click", () => {
              activeView = "all";
              mediaKindFilter = null;
              render();
            });
            empty.append(message, browse);
          } else {
            const message = document.createElement("p");
            message.textContent = mediaKindFilter === "audio" ? "No music is available in your library yet." : "Your library is empty.";
            empty.append(message);
          }
          mediaList.append(empty);
          return;
        }
    
        visibleRecords.forEach((record) => mediaList.append(renderMediaRow(record, playlist)));
      }
    
      async function loadLibrary() {
        [mediaRecords, playlists] = await Promise.all([listMediaFiles(), listPlaylists()]);
      }
    
      async function render() {
        try {
          await loadLibrary();
          if (activeView !== "all" && !playlists.some((playlist) => playlist.id === activeView)) {
            activeView = "all";
          }
          renderPlaylistSidebar();
          renderPinnedNavigation();
          renderMediaList();
          await updateStorageSummary();
        } catch (error) {
          setStatus(`Could not open your library: ${error.message}`);
          libraryStorage.textContent = "Browser storage information is unavailable.";
        }
      }
    
      function renderPinnedNavigation() {
        pinnedNav.replaceChildren();
        playlists.filter((playlist) => playlist.pinned).forEach((playlist) => {
          const item = document.createElement("li");
          const button = document.createElement("button");
          button.type = "button";
          button.className = "nav-button pinned-playlist-link";
          button.setAttribute("aria-label", playlist.name);
          button.title = playlist.name;
          const icon = document.createElement("span"); icon.className = "nav-icon"; icon.textContent = "♫";
          const label = document.createElement("span"); label.className = "nav-label"; label.textContent = playlist.name;
          button.append(icon, label);
          button.addEventListener("click", () => {
            activeView = playlist.id;
            mediaKindFilter = null;
            document.querySelector('[data-library-view="playlists"]').click();
          });
          item.append(button); pinnedNav.append(item);
        });
      }
      window.addEventListener("puffin:library-view", async (event) => {
        const view = event.detail;
        if (!["listen", "library", "playlists"].includes(view)) return;
        currentLibraryView = view;
        mediaKindFilter = view === "listen" ? "audio" : null;
        if (view !== "playlists") activeView = "all";
        playPanel.setAttribute("aria-label", view === "playlists" ? "Playlists" : view === "listen" ? "Listen" : "Library");
        playPanel.removeAttribute("aria-labelledby");
        await render();
        if (view === "playlists") {
    import { listMediaFiles, listRecentlyPlayed } from "./library.js";
    import { getHomePreferences } from "./home-preferences.js";
    
    const stripExtension = (name) => name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, "");
    const normalize = (value) => String(value || "").trim().toLocaleLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, " ");
    const recommendationCache = new Map();
    const artworkCache = new Map();
    
    function recommendationKey(artist, title) {
      return `${normalize(artist)}\u0000${normalize(title)}`;
    }
    
    async function recommendationArtwork(artist, title) {
      const key = recommendationKey(artist, title);
      if (artworkCache.has(key)) return artworkCache.get(key);
      try {
        const query = new URLSearchParams({ term: `${artist} ${title}`, entity: "song", limit: "1" });
        const response = await fetch(`https://itunes.apple.com/search?${query}`);
        if (!response.ok) return "";
        const data = await response.json();
        const artwork = data.results?.[0]?.artworkUrl100?.replace("100x100bb", "600x600bb") || "";
        artworkCache.set(key, artwork);
        return artwork;
      } catch {
        return "";
      }
    }
    
    export function initializeHome({ onPlay }) {
      const recentSection = document.querySelector("#recently-played-section");
      const recentList = document.querySelector("#recently-played-list");
      const recentEmpty = document.querySelector("#recently-played-empty");
      const previous = document.querySelector("#recent-scroll-left");
      const next = document.querySelector("#recent-scroll-right");
      const picksSection = document.querySelector("#music-picks-section");
      const picksList = document.querySelector("#music-picks-list");
      const picksStatus = document.querySelector("#music-picks-status");
      const picksSort = document.querySelector("#music-picks-sort");
      const picksRefresh = document.querySelector("#music-picks-refresh");
      const picksRefreshLabel = document.querySelector("#music-picks-refresh-label");
      const attribution = document.querySelector("#musicatlas-attribution");
      let recommendations = [];
      let picksRequestId = 0;
      let recentRecords = [];
    
      function updateScrollButtons() {
        const canScroll = !recentList.hidden && recentList.scrollWidth > recentList.clientWidth + 2;
        previous.disabled = !canScroll || recentList.scrollLeft <= 1;
        next.disabled = !canScroll || recentList.scrollLeft + recentList.clientWidth >= recentList.scrollWidth - 2;
      }
    
      function renderRecentlyPlayed(records) {
        recentRecords = records;
        recentList.replaceChildren();
        records.forEach((record) => {
          const title = record.title || stripExtension(record.name);
          const item = document.createElement("li");
          item.className = "recently-played-item";
          const button = document.createElement("button");
          button.type = "button";
          button.className = "recent-song-button";
          button.setAttribute("aria-label", `Play ${title}`);
          const artwork = document.createElement("img");
          artwork.className = "recent-song-artwork";
          artwork.src = record.artwork || "/favicon.svg";
          artwork.alt = "";
          artwork.loading = "lazy";
          artwork.addEventListener("error", () => {
            if (!artwork.src.endsWith("/favicon.svg")) artwork.src = "/favicon.svg";
          }, { once: true });
          const titleElement = document.createElement("span");
          titleElement.className = "recent-song-title";
          titleElement.textContent = title;
          button.append(artwork, titleElement);
          button.addEventListener("click", () => onPlay(record));
          item.append(button);
          recentList.append(item);
        });
        const hasRecords = records.length > 0;
        recentList.hidden = !hasRecords;
        recentEmpty.hidden = hasRecords;
        recentEmpty.textContent = "Your recently played music will appear here.";
        recentList.scrollLeft = 0;
        requestAnimationFrame(updateScrollButtons);
      }
    
      function renderRecommendations() {
        const sorted = [...recommendations].sort((a, b) => picksSort.value === "asc" ? a.score - b.score : b.score - a.score);
        picksList.replaceChildren();
        sorted.forEach((track) => {
          const row = document.createElement("li");
          row.className = "music-pick-row";
          const artwork = document.createElement("img");
          artwork.className = "music-pick-artwork";
          artwork.src = track.artwork || "/favicon.svg";
          artwork.alt = "";
          artwork.loading = "lazy";
          artwork.addEventListener("error", () => { if (!artwork.src.endsWith("/favicon.svg")) artwork.src = "/favicon.svg"; }, { once: true });
          const details = document.createElement("div");
          details.className = "music-pick-details";
          const title = document.createElement("strong");
          title.textContent = track.title;
          const artist = document.createElement("span");
          artist.textContent = track.artist;
          details.append(title, artist);
          const download = document.createElement("button");
          download.type = "button";
          download.className = "secondary-button music-pick-download";
          download.textContent = "Find on YouTube";
          download.setAttribute("aria-label", `Find ${track.title} by ${track.artist} to download`);
          download.addEventListener("click", () => {
            document.querySelector('[data-tab="download"]')?.click();
            window.scrollTo(0, 0);
            window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("puffin:download-pick", { detail: { query: `${track.title} ${track.artist}` } }));
          });
          row.append(artwork, details, download);

    import { listMediaFiles, listPlaylists, listRecentlyPlayed } from "./library.js";
    
    export function initializeListen({ onPlay }) {
      const featured = document.querySelector("#listen-featured");
      const recent = document.querySelector("#listen-recent");
      const recentEmpty = document.querySelector("#listen-recent-empty");
      const library = document.querySelector("#listen-library");
      const empty = document.querySelector("#listen-empty");
      const search = document.querySelector("#listen-search");
      const playlistSelect = document.querySelector("#listen-playlist");
      let songs = [];
      let recentSongs = [];
      let playlists = [];
    
      const titleOf = (song) => song.title || song.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, "");
      const artworkFor = (song, className) => {
        const img = document.createElement("img");
        img.className = className;
        img.src = song.artwork || "/favicon.svg";
        img.alt = "";
        img.loading = "lazy";
        img.addEventListener("error", () => { if (!img.src.endsWith("/favicon.svg")) img.src = "/favicon.svg"; }, { once: true });
        return img;
      };
      const makeRow = (song, compact = false) => {
        const card = document.createElement("article");
        card.className = compact ? "watch-video-card watch-video-card-compact" : "watch-video-card";
        card.setAttribute("role", "listitem");
        const button = document.createElement("button");
        button.type = "button";
        button.className = "watch-thumbnail-button listen-art-button";
        button.setAttribute("aria-label", `Play ${titleOf(song)}`);
        const art = artworkFor(song, "listen-artwork");
        const play = document.createElement("span");
        play.className = "watch-thumbnail-mark";
        play.textContent = "▶";
        button.append(art, play);
        button.addEventListener("click", () => onPlay(song));
        const title = document.createElement("button");
        title.type = "button";
        title.className = "watch-video-title-button";
        const heading = document.createElement("h3");
        heading.textContent = titleOf(song);
        title.append(heading);
        title.addEventListener("click", () => onPlay(song));
        const metadata = document.createElement("p");
        metadata.className = "watch-video-metadata";
        metadata.textContent = [song.artist, song.album].filter(Boolean).join(" · ") || "Puffin Library";
        card.append(button, title, metadata);
        return card;
      };
    
      function render() {
        recent.replaceChildren(...recentSongs.slice(0, 12).map((song) => makeRow(song, true)));
        recentEmpty.hidden = recentSongs.length > 0;
        const latest = recentSongs[0] || songs[0];
        featured.replaceChildren();
        if (latest) {
          const hero = document.createElement("article");
          hero.className = "watch-featured-card listen-featured-card";
          const art = artworkFor(latest, "watch-featured-art");
          const copy = document.createElement("div");
          copy.className = "watch-featured-copy";
          const eyebrow = document.createElement("p");
          eyebrow.className = "watch-eyebrow";
          eyebrow.textContent = recentSongs.length ? "PICK UP THE MUSIC" : "YOUR MUSIC LIBRARY";
          const heading = document.createElement("h2");
          heading.textContent = titleOf(latest);
          const byline = document.createElement("p");
          byline.className = "watch-featured-metadata";
          byline.textContent = [latest.artist, latest.album].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
          const play = document.createElement("button");
          play.type = "button";
          play.className = "primary-button watch-featured-play";
          play.textContent = "Play";
          play.addEventListener("click", () => onPlay(latest));
          copy.append(eyebrow, heading, byline, play);
          hero.append(art, copy);
          featured.append(hero);
        }
        const query = search.value.toLocaleLowerCase().trim();
        const selected = playlists.find((item) => item.id === playlistSelect.value);
        const selectedIds = selected ? new Set(selected.mediaIds) : null;
        const filtered = songs.filter((song) => {
          if (selectedIds && !selectedIds.has(song.id)) return false;
          return !query || [titleOf(song), song.artist, song.album, song.genre].join(" ").toLocaleLowerCase().includes(query);
        });
        library.replaceChildren(...filtered.map((song) => makeRow(song)));
        empty.hidden = filtered.length > 0;
      }
    
      async function load() {
        const [records, playlistsNext, recentNext] = await Promise.all([listMediaFiles(), listPlaylists(), listRecentlyPlayed()]);
        songs = records.filter((record) => record.kind === "audio");
        playlists = playlistsNext.filter((playlist) => playlist.mediaIds.some((id) => songs.some((song) => song.id === id)));
        recentSongs = recentNext.filter((record) => record.kind === "audio");
        const oldValue = playlistSelect.value;
        playlistSelect.replaceChildren(new Option("All playlists", "all"));
        playlists.forEach((playlist) => playlistSelect.add(new Option(playlist.name, playlist.id)));
        playlistSelect.value = playlists.some((playlist) => playlist.id === oldValue) ? oldValue : "all";
        render();
      }
      search.addEventListener("input", render);
      playlistSelect.addEventListener("change", render);
      window.addEventListener("puffin:library-updated", load);
      window.addEventListener("puffin:metadata-updated", load);
      window.addEventListener("puffin:recently-played-updated", load);
      window.addEventListener("puffin:tab-changed", (event) => { if (event.detail === "listen") load(); });
      load();
    }

    function formatBytes(bytes) {
      if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`;
      const units = ["KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"];
      let value = bytes / 1024;
      let unit = 0;
      while (value >= 1024 && unit < units.length - 1) {
        value /= 1024;
        unit += 1;
      }
      return `${value.toFixed(value >= 100 ? 0 : 1)} ${units[unit]}`;
    }

    function openVideoTheater() {
      if (activePlayer !== videoPlayer || videoTheater.open || videoTheaterClosePromise) return;
      videoTheaterTitle.textContent = activeMediaRecord?.title || activeMediaRecord?.name?.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, "") || "Now playing";
      videoTheaterSubtitle.textContent = [activeMediaRecord?.artist, activeMediaRecord?.album].filter(Boolean).join(" · ") || "Puffin video library";
      videoPlayer.controls = false;
      videoPlayer.hidden = false;
      videoTheaterStage.append(videoPlayer);
      playerDock.hidden = true;
      videoReturnFocus = document.activeElement === document.body || document.activeElement === document.documentElement
        ? null
        : document.activeElement;
      videoTheater.showModal();
      addVideoHistoryEntry();
      revealVideoControls();
      updateVideoTheaterControls();
      videoPlayer.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      scheduleVideoControlsHide();
    }
    
    function restoreVideoToPlayer() {
      window.clearTimeout(videoControlsTimeout);
      videoTheater.classList.remove("is-controls-hidden", "is-native-fullscreen");
      if (videoPlayer.parentElement !== playerTrack) {
        playerTrack.insertBefore(videoPlayer, playerVideoFallback);
      }
      videoPlayer.controls = false;
      videoPlayer.setAttribute("aria-label", "Expand video");
      videoPlayer.hidden = false;
      playerDock.hidden = !activePlayer;
      setDockRevealed(Boolean(activePlayer));
      if (videoReturnFocus?.isConnected) videoReturnFocus.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      else if (document.querySelector('[data-tab="watch"][aria-current="page"]')) document.querySelector("#watch-title").focus({ preventScroll: true });
      else if (activePlayer) playerToggle.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      videoReturnFocus = null;
      if (videoHistoryEntry) {
        videoHistoryEntry = false;
      if (videoFullscreenNative || videoPlayer.webkitDisplayingFullscreen) {
        const endEvent = new Promise((resolve) => videoPlayer.addEventListener("webkitendfullscreen", resolve, { once: true }));
        try { videoPlayer.webkitExitFullscreen?.(); } catch { /* WebKit may already have exited native video fullscreen. */ }
        await Promise.race([endEvent, new Promise((resolve) => window.setTimeout(resolve, 700))]);
        videoFullscreenNative = false;
        videoPlayer.controls = false;
        syncFullscreenState();
      }
    }
    
    async function closeVideoTheater({ fromHistory = false } = {}) {
      if (!videoTheater.open) return;
      if (fromHistory) videoHistoryEntry = false;
      if (videoTheaterClosePromise) return videoTheaterClosePromise;
      videoTheaterClosePromise = (async () => {
        await exitVideoFullscreen();
        if (videoTheater.open) videoTheater.close();
      })();
      try {
        await videoTheaterClosePromise;
      } finally {
        videoTheaterClosePromise = null;
      }
    }

    function closePlayerMode() {

      fullPlayerQueueList.replaceChildren();
      queueRecords.forEach((record) => {

        row.dataset.queueId = record.id;
        row.classList.toggle("is-current", record.id === activeMediaId);

        handle.className = "queue-drag-handle";

        art.alt = "";
        const title = document.createElement("span");
        title.className = "queue-row-title";
        title.textContent = `${record.title || record.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, "")} · ${record.artist || "Unknown artist"}`;
        const play = document.createElement("button");
        play.type = "button";
        play.className = "queue-row-play";
        play.textContent = record.id === activeMediaId ? "Playing" : "Play";

    function advanceQueue() {
      if (activePlayer !== audioPlayer || queueRecords.length === 0) return;

        audioPlayer.currentTime = 0;

        return;
      }
      const current = queueRecords.findIndex((record) => record.id === activeMediaId);
      let next = current + 1;
      if (shuffleEnabled && queueRecords.length > 1) {
        do { next = Math.floor(Math.random() * queueRecords.length); } while (next === current);

      const to = target ? queueRecords.findIndex((record) => record.id === target.dataset.queueId) : -1;

    function updateFullPlayerControls() {

      fullPlayerTime.textContent = formatTime(current);

    async function startPlayback(record, startTime = 0, openVideo = false) {

        playerTrack.classList.toggle("is-video", isVideo);
        if (record.artwork) playerArtwork.src = record.artwork;

        playerVideoFallback.hidden = !isVideo || Boolean(record.artwork);

        const player = record.kind === "video" ? videoPlayer : audioPlayer;

        document.body.classList.add("has-player");
        if (player === videoPlayer && startTime > 0) {
          const resume = () => {
