                  <span class="nav-icon" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="m3 10 9-7 9 7M5.5 9v11h13V9M9.5 20v-6h5v6"/></svg></span><span class="nav-label">Home</span>
                </button>
                <button class="nav-button" type="button" data-tab="listen" aria-label="Listen" title="Listen">
                  <span class="nav-icon" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M9 18V5l12-2v13M9 18a3 3 0 1 1-3-3c1.7 0 3 1.3 3 3Zm12-2a3 3 0 1 1-3-3c1.7 0 3 1.3 3 3Z"/></svg></span><span class="nav-label">Listen</span>
                </button>
                <button class="nav-button" type="button" data-tab="watch" aria-label="Watch" title="Watch">
                  <span class="nav-icon" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 7.5 21 5v12L3 19.5v-12ZM3 12l18-2.5M8 6.8l2.5 5M14 6l2.5 5"/></svg></span><span class="nav-label">Watch</span>
                </button>
              </section>
    
              <section class="nav-group" aria-labelledby="nav-library-heading">
                <h2 class="nav-group-heading" id="nav-library-heading">Your Library</h2>
                <button class="nav-button" type="button" data-tab="play" data-library-view="library" aria-label="Library" title="Library">
                  <span class="nav-icon" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 4v16M9 6v12M14 4v16M19 8v12"/></svg></span><span class="nav-label">Library</span>
                </button>
                <button class="nav-button" type="button" data-tab="play" data-library-view="playlists" aria-label="Playlists" title="Playlists">
                  <span class="nav-icon" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 5h12M4 10h12M4 15h7M18 4v13a2 2 0 1 1-2-2h2M4 20h7"/></svg></span><span class="nav-label">Playlists</span>
                </button>
                <ul id="sidebar-pinned-playlists" class="sidebar-pinned-playlists" aria-label="Pinned playlists"></ul>
              </section>
              <section class="nav-group nav-group-tools" aria-label="Tools">
                <button class="nav-button" type="button" data-tab="download" aria-label="Download" title="Download">
                  <span class="nav-icon" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 3v12m-5-5 5 5 5-5M4 16v4h16v-4"/></svg></span><span class="nav-label">Download</span>
                </button>
                <button class="nav-button" type="button" data-tab="edit" aria-label="Edit" title="Edit">
                  <span class="nav-icon" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="m4 16.5-.9 4.4 4.4-.9L20 7.5 16.5 4 4 16.5ZM14.5 6l3.5 3.5"/></svg></span><span class="nav-label">Edit</span>
                </button>
                <button class="nav-button" type="button" data-tab="stats" aria-label="Stats" title="Stats">
                  <span class="nav-icon" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 20v-6M12 20V9M19 20V4"/></svg></span><span class="nav-label">Stats</span>
                </button>
              </section>
            </nav>
            <div class="sidebar-bottom">
              <button class="nav-button settings-nav-button" id="settings-open" data-open-settings type="button" aria-label="Settings" title="Settings">
                <span class="nav-icon" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 8.5a3.5 3.5 0 1 0 0 7 3.5 3.5 0 0 0 0-7Z"/><path d="m19.4 13.5 1.1.9-1.5 2.6-1.4-.5a7.8 7.8 0 0 1-1.5.9l-.3 1.5h-3l-.3-1.5a7.8 7.8 0 0 1-1.5-.9l-1.4.5-1.5-2.6 1.1-.9a7.4 7.4 0 0 1 0-1.8l-1.1-.9 1.5-2.6 1.4.5a7.8 7.8 0 0 1 1.5-.9l.3-1.5h3l.3 1.5a7.8 7.8 0 0 1 1.5.9l1.4-.5 1.5 2.6-1.1.9a7.4 7.4 0 0 1 0 1.8Z"/></svg></span><span class="nav-label">Settings</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </aside>
          <button id="sidebar-scrim" class="sidebar-scrim" type="button" aria-label="Close navigation" tabindex="-1" hidden></button>
    
          <div class="workspace">
            <header class="topbar">
              <button class="icon-button mobile-menu-button" id="mobile-menu-open" type="button" aria-label="Open navigation" aria-controls="app-sidebar" aria-expanded="false" title="Open navigation">☰</button>
              <span id="connection-status" class="connection-status is-online" role="status" aria-label="Online" title="Online"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M2 8.8a15.5 15.5 0 0 1 20 0M5.5 12.3a10 10 0 0 1 13 0M9 15.8a4.7 4.7 0 0 1 6 0M12 19.5h.01"/></svg></span>
              <button class="icon-button" id="theme-toggle" type="button" aria-label="Toggle dark mode" aria-pressed="false" title="Toggle dark mode">☾</button>
            </header>
    
            <main>
              <section class="panel home-panel" id="home-panel" data-panel="home" aria-labelledby="home-title">
                <h1 id="home-title">Home</h1>
                <div class="home-sections">
                  <section class="home-section" id="recently-played-section" aria-labelledby="recently-played-title">
                    <div class="home-section-heading">
                      <h2 id="recently-played-title">Recently played</h2>
                      <div class="recent-scroll-controls" aria-label="Recently played controls">
                        <button id="recent-scroll-left" class="round-button" type="button" aria-label="Scroll recently played left" title="Scroll left" disabled>‹</button>
                        <button id="recent-scroll-right" class="round-button" type="button" aria-label="Scroll recently played right" title="Scroll right" disabled>›</button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <p id="recently-played-empty" class="home-empty-state">Your recently played music will appear here.</p>
                    <ol id="recently-played-list" class="recently-played-list" aria-label="Your last 30 played songs" hidden></ol>
                  </section>
                  <section class="home-section" id="music-picks-section" aria-labelledby="music-picks-title">
                    <div class="home-section-heading">
                      <h2 id="music-picks-title">Music picks</h2>
                      <div class="music-picks-controls">
                        <label class="music-picks-sort">
                          <span>Sort</span>
                          <select id="music-picks-sort" aria-label="Sort music picks by relevance">
                            <option value="desc">Most relevant</option>
                            <option value="asc">Least relevant</option>
                          </select>
                        </label>
                        <button id="music-picks-refresh" class="secondary-button music-picks-refresh" type="button" aria-label="Refresh music picks">↻ <span id="music-picks-refresh-label">Refresh</span></button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <p id="music-picks-status" class="home-empty-state" role="status" aria-live="polite">Add a MusicAtlas API key in Settings to get music picks.</p>
                    <ol id="music-picks-list" class="music-picks-list" aria-label="Recommended songs" hidden></ol>
                    <p id="musicatlas-attribution" class="musicatlas-attribution" hidden>Music recommendations by <a href="https://musicatlas.ai/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">MusicAtlas</a></p>
                  </section>
                </div>
              </section>
    
              <section class="panel watch-panel" id="watch-panel" data-panel="watch" aria-labelledby="watch-title" hidden>
                <header class="watch-page-heading">
                  <div><p class="watch-eyebrow">PUFFIN VIDEO</p><h1 id="watch-title" tabindex="-1">Watch</h1><p class="muted">Your videos, ready when you are.</p></div>
                </header>
                <section id="watch-featured-section" class="watch-featured-section" aria-labelledby="watch-featured-title">
                  <h2 id="watch-featured-title" class="visually-hidden">Featured video</h2>
                  <div id="watch-featured"></div>
                </section>
                <section id="watch-continue-section" class="watch-library-section" aria-labelledby="watch-continue-title">
                  <div class="watch-section-heading"><div><p class="watch-eyebrow">PICK UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF</p><h2 id="watch-continue-title">Continue watching</h2></div></div>
                  <p id="watch-continue-empty" class="watch-empty" hidden>No videos in progress yet.</p>
                  <div id="watch-continue-list" class="watch-card-grid watch-card-row" role="list"></div>
                </section>
                <section id="watch-recent-section" class="watch-library-section" aria-labelledby="watch-recent-title">
                  <div class="watch-section-heading"><div><p class="watch-eyebrow">BACK FOR MORE</p><h2 id="watch-recent-title">Recently watched</h2></div></div>
                  <p id="watch-recent-empty" class="watch-empty" hidden>Videos you watch will appear here.</p>
                  <div id="watch-recent-list" class="watch-card-grid watch-card-row" role="list"></div>
                </section>
                <section class="watch-library-section" aria-labelledby="watch-library-title">
                  <div class="watch-section-heading watch-library-heading"><div><p class="watch-eyebrow">ON THIS DEVICE</p><h2 id="watch-library-title">Your video library</h2></div></div>
                  <div class="watch-library-controls">
                    <label class="watch-search"><span class="visually-hidden">Search videos</span><input id="watch-search" type="search" placeholder="Search videos" autocomplete="off" /></label>
                    <label class="watch-select-field"><span>Show</span><select id="watch-filter"><option value="all">All videos</option><option value="continue">Continue watching</option><option value="recent">Recently watched</option></select></label>
                    <label class="watch-select-field"><span>Playlist</span><select id="watch-playlist-filter"><option value="all">All playlists</option></select></label>
                  </div>
                  <p id="watch-library-empty" class="watch-empty" hidden>No videos match these filters.</p>
                  <div id="watch-video-library" class="watch-card-grid" role="list"></div>
                </section>
              </section>
    
              <section class="panel listen-panel" id="listen-panel" data-panel="listen" aria-labelledby="listen-title" hidden>
                <header class="watch-page-heading"><div><p class="watch-eyebrow">PUFFIN MUSIC</p><h1 id="listen-title" tabindex="-1">Listen</h1><p class="muted">Your music, ready when you are.</p></div></header>
                <section class="watch-featured-section" aria-labelledby="listen-featured-title"><h2 id="listen-featured-title" class="visually-hidden">Featured song</h2><div id="listen-featured"></div></section>
                <section class="watch-library-section" aria-labelledby="listen-recent-title"><div class="watch-section-heading"><h2 id="listen-recent-title">Recently played</h2></div><div id="listen-recent" class="watch-card-grid watch-card-row" role="list"></div><p id="listen-recent-empty" class="watch-empty" hidden>No songs played yet.</p></section>
                <section class="watch-library-section"><div class="watch-section-heading"><h2>Your music library</h2></div><div class="watch-library-controls"><label class="watch-search"><span class="visually-hidden">Search songs</span><input id="listen-search" type="search" placeholder="Search songs" /></label><label class="watch-select-field"><span>Playlist</span><select id="listen-playlist"><option value="all">All playlists</option></select></label></div><p id="listen-empty" class="watch-empty" hidden>No songs match.</p><div id="listen-library" class="watch-card-grid" role="list"></div></section>
              </section>
    
              <section class="panel" id="download-panel" data-panel="download" aria-labelledby="download-title" hidden>
                <h1 id="download-title">Download</h1>
                <form id="download-form" class="download-form">
                  <div class="download-source-switch" role="group" aria-label="Choose download source">
                    <button id="download-source-link" class="is-selected" type="button" aria-pressed="true">Enter a link or search</button>
                    <button id="download-source-browse" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Browse YouTube</button>
                  </div>
                  <div id="download-link-row" class="download-link-row">
                    <label id="youtube-link-field" class="form-field">
                      <span id="download-link-label">YouTube link or search phrase</span>
                      <input id="youtube-url" name="youtube-url" type="text" placeholder="Paste a YouTube link or search, e.g. Apollo 11 highlights" autocomplete="off" required />
                    </label>
                    <label class="form-field format-field" for="download-kind">
                      <span>Format</span>
                      <select id="download-kind" name="download-kind">
                        <option value="audio">Audio · original format when supported</option>
                        <option value="video">Video · MP4</option>
                      </select>
                    </label>
                  </div>
                  <section id="youtube-browse-panel" class="youtube-browse-panel" aria-label="Search YouTube" hidden>
                    <div class="youtube-search-row">
                      <label class="form-field" for="youtube-search-query">
                        <span>Search YouTube</span>
                        <input id="youtube-search-query" type="search" maxlength="200" placeholder="Search for a video or song" autocomplete="off" />
                      </label>
                      <button id="youtube-search-button" class="secondary-button" type="button">Search</button>
                    </div>
                    <p id="youtube-search-status" class="muted" role="status" aria-live="polite">Search YouTube, then choose a result to download.</p>
                    <div id="youtube-selected-video" class="youtube-selected-video" hidden>
    :root {
      color-scheme: light;
      font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
      font-synthesis: none;
      text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
      --page: #f6f7f8;
      --surface: #fff;
      --text: #202428;
      --muted: #737b83;
      --border: #e4e7ea;
      --accent: #306b75;
      --accent-soft: #e8f1f2;
    }
    
    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    
    body {
      min-width: 320px;
      min-height: 100vh;
      min-height: 100dvh;
      overflow-x: hidden;
      margin: 0;
      background: var(--page);
      color: var(--text);
    }
    
    button, a { font: inherit; }
    
    .app {
      --sidebar-width: 248px;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: var(--sidebar-width) minmax(0, 1fr);
      min-height: 100vh;
      min-height: 100dvh;
      transition: grid-template-columns 220ms ease;
    }
    
    .sidebar {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      display: flex;
      height: 100vh;
      height: 100dvh;
      min-height: 0;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 18px;
      padding: 22px 14px 18px;
      overflow-x: hidden;
      overflow-y: auto;
      background: var(--surface);
      border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
      scrollbar-width: thin;
      scrollbar-color: var(--border) transparent;
      transition: padding 220ms ease;
    }
    
    .sidebar-brand-row { display: flex; min-height: 42px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; padding: 0 4px; }
    .brand { display: flex; min-width: 0; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin: 0; font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: -0.05em; white-space: nowrap; }
    .brand-mark { display: grid; width: 34px; height: 34px; flex: 0 0 34px; place-items: center; color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft); border-radius: 11px; font-size: 1.1rem; }
    .brand-name { overflow: hidden; }
    .sidebar-collapse { display: grid; width: 36px; height: 36px; flex: 0 0 36px; place-items: center; padding: 0; color: var(--muted); background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1; }
    .sidebar-collapse:hover { color: var(--text); background: var(--page); }
    .sidebar-collapse:focus-visible, .mobile-menu-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
    .nav-list { display: grid; gap: 16px; }
    .nav-group { display: grid; gap: 4px; min-width: 0; }
    .nav-group + .nav-group { padding-top: 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .nav-group-heading { margin: 0 10px 4px; color: var(--muted); font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: .1em; line-height: 1.4; text-transform: uppercase; }
    .nav-group-tools { padding-top: 14px !important; border-top: 1px solid var(--border) !important; }
    .nav-button { display: flex; width: 100%; min-width: 0; align-items: center; gap: 13px; min-height: 46px; padding: 0 12px; color: var(--muted); background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 13px; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; font-size: .94rem; font-weight: 550; white-space: nowrap; }
    .nav-button:hover { color: var(--text); background: var(--page); }
    .nav-button[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft); font-weight: 650; }
    .nav-icon { display: inline-grid; width: 22px; height: 22px; flex: 0 0 22px; place-items: center; }
    .nav-icon svg { display: block; width: 22px; height: 22px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
    .sidebar-bottom { margin-top: auto; padding-top: 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .settings-nav-button { min-height: 46px; }
    .sidebar-scrim { display: none; }
    .mobile-menu-button { display: none; }
    
    .app.is-sidebar-collapsed { --sidebar-width: 76px; }
    .app.is-sidebar-collapsed .sidebar { align-items: center; padding-inline: 10px; }
    .app.is-sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-brand-row { width: 100%; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
    .app.is-sidebar-collapsed .brand-name, .app.is-sidebar-collapsed .nav-group-heading, .app.is-sidebar-collapsed .nav-label { display: none; }
    .app.is-sidebar-collapsed .brand-mark { width: 34px; }
    .app.is-sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-collapse { transform: rotate(180deg); }
    .app.is-sidebar-collapsed .nav-list, .app.is-sidebar-collapsed .nav-group { width: 100%; }
    .app.is-sidebar-collapsed .nav-group { justify-items: center; }
    .app.is-sidebar-collapsed .nav-group + .nav-group { padding-top: 10px; }
    .app.is-sidebar-collapsed .nav-button { justify-content: center; gap: 0; padding: 0; }
    .app.is-sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-bottom { width: 100%; }
    .app.is-sidebar-collapsed .settings-nav-button { justify-content: center; padding: 0; }
    .app.is-sidebar-collapsed .workspace { min-width: 0; }
    .app.is-sidebar-collapsed ~ .player-dock { left: 76px; }
    
    .nav-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
    
    .icon-button {
      display: flex;
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 0;
      color: var(--muted);
      background: transparent;
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 12px;
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .icon-button:hover { color: var(--text); background: var(--page); }
    
    .workspace { display: flex; min-width: 0; flex-direction: column; }
    
    .topbar {
      display: flex;
      min-height: 68px;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      padding: 12px 28px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .topbar .icon-button + .icon-button { margin-left: 8px; }
    .mobile-menu-button { display: none; }
    .connection-status { display: grid; width: 40px; height: 40px; margin-right: 8px; place-items: center; color: #268b59; }
    .connection-status svg { width: 23px; height: 23px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
    .connection-status.is-offline { color: #c94a4a; }
    
    main {
      display: block;
      flex: 1;
      width: 100%;
      padding: 36px clamp(20px, 4vw, 64px) 48px;
    }
    
    .panel {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: none;
      padding: 0;
      background: transparent;
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 0;
    }
    
    .welcome {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: none;
      padding: 24px 0;
      text-align: left;
    }
    
    .welcome h1 { margin: 0 0 10px; font-size: clamp(2.25rem, 4vw, 2.75rem); letter-spacing: -0.05em; }
    .welcome p, .muted { color: var(--muted); }
    .welcome p { margin: 0; font-size: 1.05rem; }
    .home-panel > h1 { margin-bottom: 32px; font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 5vw, 3rem); }
    .home-sections { display: grid; gap: 38px; max-width: 1120px; }
    .home-section-heading { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
    .home-section h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.35rem; letter-spacing: -0.03em; }
    .recent-scroll-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
    .recent-scroll-controls .round-button { width: 36px; height: 36px; }
    .recent-scroll-controls .round-button:disabled { opacity: .38; cursor: default; }
    .home-empty-state { display: flex; min-height: 112px; align-items: center; margin: 0; padding: 22px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 18px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 68%, transparent); color: var(--muted); }
    .home-empty-state[hidden] { display: none; }
    .recently-played-list { display: flex; gap: 18px; overflow-x: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0 2px 12px; list-style: none; scroll-snap-type: x mandatory; scrollbar-width: thin; scrollbar-color: var(--border) transparent; }
    .recently-played-list[hidden] { display: none; }
    .recently-played-item { flex: 0 0 158px; min-width: 0; scroll-snap-align: start; }
    .recent-song-button { display: grid; width: 100%; gap: 10px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: transparent; color: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; }
    .recent-song-artwork { display: block; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--accent-soft); box-shadow: 0 4px 14px #00000012; transition: transform .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease; }
    .recent-song-button:hover .recent-song-artwork { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 10px 22px #00000020; }
    .recent-song-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 4px; }
    .recent-song-title { overflow: hidden; font-size: .95rem; font-weight: 600; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
    .music-picks-sort { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: var(--muted); font-size: .85rem; }
    .music-picks-sort select { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 28px 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 11px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); font: inherit; }
    .music-picks-controls { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
    .music-picks-refresh { display: inline-flex; min-height: 36px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 0 13px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: .82rem; }
    .music-picks-refresh[aria-busy="true"] { cursor: progress; }
    .music-picks-list { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 0 22px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
    .music-picks-list[hidden] { display: none; }
    .music-pick-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 50px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 11px; min-height: 72px; padding: 8px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .music-pick-artwork { width: 50px; height: 50px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--accent-soft); box-shadow: 0 3px 12px #00000012; }
    .music-pick-details { display: grid; min-width: 0; gap: 4px; }
    .music-pick-details strong, .music-pick-details span { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
    .stats-range { display: flex; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 76%, transparent); }
    .stats-range button { min-height: 34px; padding: 0 13px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; }
    .stats-range button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--text); color: var(--surface); }
    .stats-overview { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 14px; margin-bottom: 36px; }
    .stats-card { display: grid; min-height: 132px; align-content: space-between; gap: 18px; padding: 20px 22px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 22px; background: var(--surface); box-shadow: 0 7px 24px #18232b08; }
    .stats-card > span, .stats-highlights article span, .stats-activity-grid article span { color: var(--muted); font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 550; }
    .stats-card strong { overflow: hidden; font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3vw, 2.4rem); font-weight: 680; letter-spacing: -.055em; line-height: 1; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
    .stats-content { display: grid; gap: 38px; }
    .stats-section { display: grid; gap: 18px; }
    .stats-section-heading { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; }
    .stats-section-heading h2 { margin: 0 0 5px; font-size: 1.45rem; letter-spacing: -.04em; }
    .stats-section-heading p { margin: 0; font-size: .88rem; }
    .stats-empty { padding: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 20px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--muted); }
    .stats-empty[hidden] { display: none; }
    .stats-inline-empty { margin: 0; padding: 22px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 18px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--muted); }
    .stats-inline-empty[hidden] { display: none; }
    .stats-list-empty[hidden] { display: none; }
    .stats-list-empty { margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: .84rem; }
    .stats-list-card { min-width: 0; padding: 19px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 20px; background: var(--surface); }
    .stats-list-card h3, .stats-errors-wrap h3 { margin: 0 0 14px; font-size: .98rem; letter-spacing: -.02em; }
    .stats-list-card ol, .stats-errors-wrap ol { display: grid; gap: 0; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
    .stats-list-card ol[hidden] { display: none; }
    .stats-list-card li { display: flex; min-width: 0; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); font-size: .85rem; }
    .stats-list-card li:first-child { border-top: 0; }
    .stats-item-primary { overflow: hidden; font-weight: 600; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
    .stats-item-secondary { flex: 0 0 auto; overflow: hidden; color: var(--muted); font-size: .77rem; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
    .stats-list-card ol li { display: grid; gap: 4px; }
    .stats-list-card ol li .stats-item-secondary { overflow: visible; white-space: normal; }
    .stats-list-card:has(#stats-genres), .stats-list-card:has(#stats-albums), .stats-list-card:has(#stats-recent-added) { min-height: 150px; }
    .stats-chart-wrap { display: grid; gap: 10px; min-height: 192px; padding: 18px 18px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 20px; background: var(--surface); }
    .stats-chart-wrap[hidden] { display: none; }
    .stats-chart { display: grid; min-height: 142px; grid-template-columns: repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr)); align-items: end; gap: clamp(5px, 1.5vw, 16px); padding: 4px 6px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .stats-chart-column { display: flex; height: 100%; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: center; }
    .stats-chart-bar { width: min(100%, 38px); min-height: 0; border-radius: 8px 8px 3px 3px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fa5367, #e52e4a); transition: height .24s ease; }
    .stats-chart-labels { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: clamp(5px, 1.5vw, 16px); color: var(--muted); font-size: .7rem; text-align: center; }
    .stats-highlights { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 12px; }
    .stats-highlights article, .stats-activity-grid article { display: grid; gap: 9px; padding: 17px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 18px; background: var(--surface); }
    .stats-highlights article strong, .stats-activity-grid article strong { font-size: 1.3rem; letter-spacing: -.04em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
    .stats-columns { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 14px; }
    .stats-columns:has(#stats-genres) { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
    .stats-activity-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 12px; }
    .stats-errors-wrap { padding: 18px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 20px; background: var(--surface); }
    .stats-errors-wrap[hidden] { display: none; }
    .stats-errors-wrap li { display: grid; gap: 5px; padding: 10px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); font-size: .85rem; }
    .stats-errors-wrap time { color: var(--muted); font-size: .75rem; }
    .stats-footnote { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: .77rem; }
    #stats-status:empty { display: none; }
    
    .placeholder-list { margin: 0; padding-left: 20px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.9; }
    
    .library-toolbar {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
      margin-top: 24px;
    }
    
    .primary-button, .media-action {
      min-height: 42px;
      padding: 0 16px;
      color: #fff;
      background: #306b75;
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 999px;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-weight: 600;
    }
    
    .primary-button:hover, .media-action:hover { background: #255961; }
    .primary-button:focus-visible, .media-action:focus-visible, .nav-button:focus-visible, .icon-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
    .primary-button:disabled, .secondary-button:disabled { cursor: wait; opacity: 0.65; }
    .library-toolbar p { margin: 0; }
    .storage-summary { margin: 18px 0; font-size: 0.9rem; }
    .library-heading { margin: 28px 0 12px; font-size: 1.1rem; }
    
    .download-form { display: grid; gap: 18px; max-width: 620px; margin-top: 24px; }
    .download-link-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 170px; align-items: end; gap: 12px; }
    .download-source-switch { display: inline-flex; width: max-content; max-width: 100%; padding: 4px; background: var(--page); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 999px; }
    .download-source-switch button { min-height: 38px; padding: 0 16px; color: var(--muted); background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; font: inherit; font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 600; }
    .download-source-switch button.is-selected { color: #fff; background: var(--accent); }
    .download-source-switch button:focus-visible, .youtube-result-download:focus-visible, .youtube-result-formats button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
    #youtube-link-field[hidden], .youtube-browse-panel[hidden], .youtube-selected-video[hidden] { display: none; }
    .youtube-browse-panel { display: grid; gap: 12px; }
    .youtube-search-row { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 10px; }
    .youtube-search-row .form-field { min-width: 0; }
    .youtube-search-row .secondary-button { flex: 0 0 auto; }
    .youtube-search-status { margin: 0; font-size: 0.88rem; }
    .youtube-selected-video { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 14px; background: var(--accent-soft); border-radius: 14px; }
    .youtube-selected-video span { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; font-weight: 600; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
    .youtube-selected-video .secondary-button { min-height: 38px; }
    .youtube-search-results { display: grid; max-height: 380px; gap: 8px; margin: 0; padding: 0 4px 0 0; overflow-y: auto; list-style: none; }
    .youtube-result { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 144px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 16px; }
    .youtube-result-thumbnail { display: block; width: 144px; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; object-fit: cover; background: var(--page); border-radius: 10px; }
    .youtube-result-thumbnail[hidden] { display: none; }
    .youtube-result-details { display: grid; min-width: 0; gap: 5px; }
    .youtube-result-details strong { display: -webkit-box; overflow: hidden; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; line-clamp: 2; overflow-wrap: anywhere; font-size: 0.92rem; }
    .youtube-result-details span { overflow: hidden; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.8rem; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
    .youtube-result-actions { display: grid; min-width: 96px; justify-items: stretch; gap: 6px; }
    .youtube-result-download { min-height: 38px; padding: 0 14px; }
    .youtube-result-formats { display: flex; gap: 5px; }
    .youtube-result-formats[hidden] { display: none; }
    .youtube-result-formats button { min-height: 34px; padding: 0 9px; font-size: .78rem; }
    .csv-download-section { display: grid; max-width: 620px; gap: 12px; margin-top: 10px; padding: 18px; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 18px; }
    .csv-download-section h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; }
    .csv-download-section > .muted { margin: 0; font-size: .84rem; line-height: 1.5; }
    .csv-download-controls { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: end; gap: 10px; }
    .csv-download-controls .form-field { min-width: 0; }
    .csv-download-section > .primary-button { justify-self: start; }
    .csv-download-section button:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .55; }
    .pi-connection-row { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 10px; }
    .form-field { display: grid; flex: 1; gap: 7px; min-width: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 600; }
    .form-field input, .form-field select {
      width: 100%;
      min-height: 44px;
      padding: 0 12px;
      color: var(--text);
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 999px;
      font: inherit;
      font-weight: 400;
    }
    .form-field input:focus, .form-field select:focus { border-color: var(--accent); outline: 2px solid var(--accent-soft); }
    .secondary-button {
      min-height: 44px;
      padding: 0 14px;
      color: var(--text);
      background: var(--page);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 9px;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-weight: 600;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .download-form > .primary-button { justify-self: start; }
    .download-form > #cancel-download { justify-self: start; }
    .download-form progress { width: 100%; height: 10px; accent-color: var(--accent); }
    .download-form [role="status"] { margin: 0; }
    .download-transfer-details { margin: -10px 0 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: .85rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
    
    .player-dock {
      position: fixed;
      z-index: 20;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 248px;
      transform: translateY(100%);
      transition: left 220ms ease, transform 220ms ease;
    }
    .player-dock[hidden] { display: none; }
    .player-dock.is-revealed { transform: translateY(0); }
    .player-reveal-zone {
      position: fixed;
      z-index: 19;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      left: 0;
      height: 8px;
    }
    .player-reveal {
      position: absolute;
      top: -22px;
      left: 50%;
      display: none;
      width: 76px;
      height: 28px;
      padding: 0;
      place-items: center;
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-bottom: 0;
      border-radius: 14px 14px 0 0;
      box-shadow: 0 -6px 18px #1111;
      cursor: pointer;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
    }
    .player-dock.is-revealed .player-reveal { display: grid; }
    .player-reveal span { width: 30px; height: 4px; background: var(--muted); border-radius: 999px; }
    body.dark .player-reveal { background: rgba(30, 36, 40, 0.9); box-shadow: 0 -6px 18px #0003; }
    .player-fullscreen { position: fixed; z-index: 30; inset: 0 0 0 248px; display: grid; grid-template-rows: auto minmax(0,1fr) auto; padding: clamp(22px,4vw,54px); overflow: auto; background: var(--page); opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); transition: transform 320ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), opacity 240ms ease; }
    .player-fullscreen[hidden] { display: none; }
    .app.is-sidebar-collapsed ~ .player-fullscreen { left: 76px; }
    .player-fullscreen.is-closing { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(100%); }
    .full-player-heading { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; }
    .full-player-heading img { width: clamp(92px,13vw,170px); height: clamp(92px,13vw,170px); flex: 0 0 auto; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 22px; box-shadow: 0 18px 48px #0003; }
    .full-player-heading h1 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: clamp(1.6rem,4vw,3rem); letter-spacing: -.05em; }
    .full-player-heading p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 1.1rem; }
    .full-player-back { position: absolute; top: 16px; right: 22px; display: grid; width: 44px; height: 44px; place-items: center; color: var(--text); background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 50%; font-size: 1.5rem; cursor: pointer; }
    .full-player-content { display: grid; min-height: 0; place-items: center; padding: 28px 0; }
    .full-player-pane { width: min(900px,100%); max-height: 100%; overflow: auto; }
    .full-player-pane[hidden] { display: none; }
    .full-player-placeholder { color: var(--muted); font-size: clamp(1.4rem,3vw,2.4rem); text-align: center; }
    .full-player-bottom { width: min(920px,100%); justify-self: center; }
    .full-player-controls { display: flex; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 18px; }
    .full-player-controls button { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; color: var(--text); background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; }
    .full-player-controls button[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft); }
    .full-player-transport { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 42px minmax(0,1fr) 42px 48px; align-items: center; gap: 12px; color: var(--muted); font-size: .8rem; }
    .full-player-transport input { width: 100%; accent-color: var(--accent); }
    .full-player-transport button { width: 46px; height: 46px; color: white; background: var(--accent); border: 0; border-radius: 50%; cursor: pointer; }
    .full-player-queue-list { display: grid; gap: 5px; max-height: 55vh; margin: 0; padding: 0; overflow: auto; list-style: none; }
    .full-player-queue-list li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 38px 44px minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 58px; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 12px; }
    .full-player-queue-list li.is-current { background: var(--accent-soft); }
    .queue-drag-handle { cursor: grab; touch-action: none; user-select: none; font-size: 1.25rem; text-align: center; }
    .queue-drag-handle.is-dragging { cursor: grabbing; }
    .queue-row-art { width: 42px; height: 42px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 8px; }
    .queue-row-title { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
    .compact-visualizer { display: flex; height: 160px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; }
    .compact-visualizer span { width: 8px; height: 24%; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--accent); animation: visualizer-bob 900ms ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
    .compact-visualizer span:nth-child(3n) { animation-duration: 650ms; }.compact-visualizer span:nth-child(3n + 1) { animation-duration: 1100ms; }
    @keyframes visualizer-bob { to { height: 76%; } }
    .full-player-equalizer { max-width: 820px; }
    .full-player-equalizer .equalizer-bands { min-width: 590px; }
    .full-player-equalizer form { display: grid; max-width: 820px; gap: 20px; padding: 10px; }
    .full-player-equalizer button:focus-visible, .full-player-equalizer input:focus-visible, .full-player-equalizer select:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
    .player-bar {
      position: relative;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(120px, .9fr) minmax(230px, 1.2fr) minmax(270px, 1.2fr);
      align-items: center;
      gap: 20px;
      min-height: 92px;
      padding: 12px 24px;
      color: var(--text);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      box-shadow: 0 -10px 32px #1111;
      backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.4);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(1.4);
    }
    .player-bar[hidden], .player-artwork[hidden], .player-video[hidden] { display: none; }
    body.dark .player-bar { background: rgba(30, 36, 40, 0.84); box-shadow: 0 -10px 32px #0003; }
    body.has-player main { padding-bottom: 132px; }
    .player-track { display: flex; min-width: 0; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
    .player-artwork, .player-video { display: block; flex: 0 0 58px; width: 58px; height: 58px; object-fit: cover; background: var(--accent-soft); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px #0002; }
    .player-video { cursor: zoom-in; }
    .player-track.is-video .player-video { display: none; }
    .player-video:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }
    .player-video-fallback { display: grid; flex: 0 0 58px; width: 58px; height: 58px; place-items: center; color: white; background: radial-gradient(circle at 70% 28%, #7fb9c5, transparent 45%), linear-gradient(135deg, #192f3c, #11171d); border-radius: 12px; font-size: .9rem; }
    .player-video-fallback[hidden] { display: none; }
    .player-video-fallback span { display: grid; width: 28px; height: 28px; place-items: center; padding-left: 2px; background: #10171d88; border: 1px solid #ffffff70; border-radius: 50%; }
    .video-theater {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      display: block;
      width: 100vw;
      height: 100dvh;
      max-width: none;
      max-height: none;
      padding: 0;
      overflow: hidden;
      color: #fff;
      background: #050505;
      border: 0;
      overscroll-behavior: contain;
    }
    .video-theater:not([open]) { display: none; }
    .video-theater::backdrop { background: #050708; }
    .video-theater-shell { position: relative; display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; min-height: 100dvh; overflow: hidden; background: #080b0e; }
    .video-theater-shell:fullscreen { width: 100vw; height: 100dvh; min-height: 100dvh; background: #080b0e; }
    .video-theater-shell:-webkit-full-screen { width: 100vw; height: 100dvh; min-height: 100dvh; background: #080b0e; }
    .settings-clear-history p { margin: 5px 0 0; font-size: .82rem; }
    .settings-clear-history .danger-button { padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid #e9bdc1; border-radius: 12px; background: #fff3f4; color: #a52a2a; font: inherit; font-size: .86rem; cursor: pointer; }
    .settings-clear-history .danger-button:hover { background: #ffe4e6; }
    .settings-clear-history .danger-button:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: wait; }
    .settings-actions { display: flex; gap: 10px; margin-top: 22px; }
    .settings-dialog button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
    body.dark .settings-capacity-warning { color: #ffd7da; background: #48282b; border-color: #704047; }
    
    body.dark {
      color-scheme: dark;
      --page: #15191c;
      --surface: #1e2428;
      --text: #edf1f2;
      --muted: #a0aaaf;
      --border: #343c41;
      --accent: #9bd0d5;
      --accent-soft: #263b3e;
    }
    
    body.dark .media-action.danger:hover { background: #48282b; }
    
    @media (max-width: 960px) and (min-width: 641px) {
      .player-bar { grid-template-columns: minmax(112px, 1fr) minmax(175px, 1.4fr) minmax(164px, 0.8fr); gap: 10px; padding-right: 12px; padding-left: 12px; }
      .player-artwork, .player-video { flex-basis: 48px; width: 48px; height: 48px; }
      .player-actions { gap: 6px; }
    }
    
    @media (max-width: 800px) and (min-width: 641px) {
      .player-bar { grid-template-columns: minmax(96px, 0.9fr) minmax(160px, 1.4fr) minmax(148px, 0.7fr); gap: 8px; padding-right: 8px; padding-left: 8px; }
      .player-actions { gap: 4px; }
      .player-equalizer-button, .player-expand-video { width: 30px; flex-basis: 30px; }
      .player-speed { width: 50px; padding-inline: 4px; }
      .player-close { flex-basis: 30px; width: 30px; height: 30px; }
    }
    
    @media (max-width: 960px) and (min-width: 721px) {
      .player-bar { grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) auto; grid-template-areas: "track actions" "center center"; gap: 7px 10px; min-height: 124px; padding: 8px 10px; }
      .player-track { grid-area: track; }
      .player-center { grid-area: center; }
      .player-actions { grid-area: actions; }
    }
    
    @media (max-width: 1100px) and (min-width: 641px) {
      .watch-card-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
    }
    
    @media (max-width: 720px) {
      .app { height: 100dvh; min-height: 100dvh; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-rows: minmax(0, 1fr); overflow: visible; }
      .sidebar {
        position: fixed;
        z-index: 52;
        inset: 0 auto 0 0;
        width: min(86vw, 320px);
        height: 100dvh;
        min-height: 100dvh;
        align-items: stretch;
        padding: max(18px, env(safe-area-inset-top)) 16px max(18px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
        overflow-y: auto;
        border: 0;
        border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
        box-shadow: 12px 0 40px #0002;
        transform: translateX(-105%);
        visibility: hidden;
        transition: transform 220ms ease, visibility 0s linear 220ms;
      }
      .app.is-sidebar-open .sidebar { visibility: visible; transform: translateX(0); transition-delay: 0s; }
      .app.is-sidebar-open .sidebar-scrim { display: block; position: fixed; z-index: 51; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; padding: 0; background: #11182075; border: 0; backdrop-filter: blur(2px); }
      .app.is-sidebar-collapsed .sidebar { width: min(86vw, 320px); align-items: stretch; padding-inline: 16px; }
      .app.is-sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-brand-row { width: 100%; flex-direction: row; gap: 8px; }

    function formatBytes(bytes) {
      if (bytes < 1024) return `${bytes} B`;
      const units = ["KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"];
      let value = bytes / 1024;
      let unit = 0;
      while (value >= 1024 && unit < units.length - 1) {
        value /= 1024;
        unit += 1;
      }
      return `${value.toFixed(value >= 100 ? 0 : 1)} ${units[unit]}`;
    }

    .player-bar {
      position: relative;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(120px, .9fr) minmax(230px, 1.2fr) minmax(270px, 1.2fr);
      align-items: center;
      gap: 20px;
      min-height: 92px;
      padding: 12px 24px;
      color: var(--text);
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    import { listMediaFiles, listPlaylists, listRecentlyPlayed } from "./library.js";
    
    export function initializeListen({ onPlay }) {
      const featured = document.querySelector("#listen-featured");
      const recent = document.querySelector("#listen-recent");
      const recentEmpty = document.querySelector("#listen-recent-empty");
      const library = document.querySelector("#listen-library");
      const empty = document.querySelector("#listen-empty");
      const search = document.querySelector("#listen-search");
      const playlistSelect = document.querySelector("#listen-playlist");
      let songs = [];
      let recentSongs = [];
      let playlists = [];
    
      const titleOf = (song) => song.title || song.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, "");
      const artworkFor = (song, className) => {
        const img = document.createElement("img");
        img.className = className;
        img.src = song.artwork || "/favicon.svg";
        img.alt = "";
        img.loading = "lazy";
        img.addEventListener("error", () => { if (!img.src.endsWith("/favicon.svg")) img.src = "/favicon.svg"; }, { once: true });
        return img;
      };
      const makeRow = (song, compact = false) => {
        const card = document.createElement("article");
        card.className = compact ? "watch-video-card watch-video-card-compact" : "watch-video-card";
        card.setAttribute("role", "listitem");
        const button = document.createElement("button");
        button.type = "button";
        button.className = "watch-thumbnail-button listen-art-button";
        button.setAttribute("aria-label", `Play ${titleOf(song)}`);
        const art = artworkFor(song, "listen-artwork");
        const play = document.createElement("span");
        play.className = "watch-thumbnail-mark";
        play.textContent = "▶";
        button.append(art, play);
        button.addEventListener("click", () => onPlay(song));
        const title = document.createElement("button");
        title.type = "button";
        title.className = "watch-video-title-button";
        const heading = document.createElement("h3");
        heading.textContent = titleOf(song);
        title.append(heading);
        title.addEventListener("click", () => onPlay(song));
        const metadata = document.createElement("p");
        metadata.className = "watch-video-metadata";
        metadata.textContent = [song.artist, song.album].filter(Boolean).join(" · ") || "Puffin Library";
        card.append(button, title, metadata);
        return card;
      };
    
      function render() {
        recent.replaceChildren(...recentSongs.slice(0, 12).map((song) => makeRow(song, true)));
        recentEmpty.hidden = recentSongs.length > 0;
        const latest = recentSongs[0] || songs[0];
        featured.replaceChildren();
        if (latest) {
          const hero = document.createElement("article");
          hero.className = "watch-featured-card listen-featured-card";
          const art = artworkFor(latest, "watch-featured-art");
          const copy = document.createElement("div");
          copy.className = "watch-featured-copy";
          const eyebrow = document.createElement("p");
          eyebrow.className = "watch-eyebrow";
          eyebrow.textContent = recentSongs.length ? "PICK UP THE MUSIC" : "YOUR MUSIC LIBRARY";
          const heading = document.createElement("h2");
          heading.textContent = titleOf(latest);
          const byline = document.createElement("p");
          byline.className = "watch-featured-metadata";
          byline.textContent = [latest.artist, latest.album].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
          const play = document.createElement("button");
          play.type = "button";
          play.className = "primary-button watch-featured-play";
          play.textContent = "Play";
          play.addEventListener("click", () => onPlay(latest));
          copy.append(eyebrow, heading, byline, play);
          hero.append(art, copy);
          featured.append(hero);
        }
        const query = search.value.toLocaleLowerCase().trim();
        const selected = playlists.find((item) => item.id === playlistSelect.value);
        const selectedIds = selected ? new Set(selected.mediaIds) : null;
        const filtered = songs.filter((song) => {
          if (selectedIds && !selectedIds.has(song.id)) return false;
          return !query || [titleOf(song), song.artist, song.album, song.genre].join(" ").toLocaleLowerCase().includes(query);
        });
        library.replaceChildren(...filtered.map((song) => makeRow(song)));
        empty.hidden = filtered.length > 0;
      }
    
      async function load() {
        const [records, playlistsNext, recentNext] = await Promise.all([listMediaFiles(), listPlaylists(), listRecentlyPlayed()]);
        songs = records.filter((record) => record.kind === "audio");
        playlists = playlistsNext.filter((playlist) => playlist.mediaIds.some((id) => songs.some((song) => song.id === id)));
        recentSongs = recentNext.filter((record) => record.kind === "audio");
        const oldValue = playlistSelect.value;
        playlistSelect.replaceChildren(new Option("All playlists", "all"));
        playlists.forEach((playlist) => playlistSelect.add(new Option(playlist.name, playlist.id)));
        playlistSelect.value = playlists.some((playlist) => playlist.id === oldValue) ? oldValue : "all";
        render();
      }
      search.addEventListener("input", render);
      playlistSelect.addEventListener("change", render);
      window.addEventListener("puffin:library-updated", load);
      window.addEventListener("puffin:metadata-updated", load);
      window.addEventListener("puffin:recently-played-updated", load);
      window.addEventListener("puffin:tab-changed", (event) => { if (event.detail === "listen") load(); });
      load();
    }

    .player-dock {

      transform: translateY(100%);
      transition: left 220ms ease, transform 220ms ease;

        do { next = Math.floor(Math.random() * queueRecords.length); } while (next === current);
      } else if (next >= queueRecords.length) {
        if (repeatMode !== 1) return;
        next = 0;
      }
      if (queueRecords[next]) startPlayback(queueRecords[next]);
    }

      const to = target ? queueRecords.findIndex((record) => record.id === target.dataset.queueId) : -1;
      if (from < 0 || to < 0 || from === to) return;
      const [record] = queueRecords.splice(from, 1);
      queueRecords.splice(to, 0, record);

## Assistant

I found and fixed two concrete behavior issues while checking the new UI: selecting a playlist previously only opened the playlist view, so the first click didn’t load its songs; and the equalizer moved its form before looking up the band sliders, leaving its controls uninitialized. I’m checking the full-player navigation and responsive layout now.

    function sampleListeningTime(player, allowStopped = false) {
      if (player !== activePlayer || player !== audioPlayer || (!allowStopped && (player.paused || player.ended))) {
        playbackSample = null;
        return;
      }
      const now = performance.now();
      const position = player.currentTime;
      if (playbackSample) {
        const elapsed = now - playbackSample.wallTime;
        const mediaElapsed = position - playbackSample.position;
        if (elapsed > 0 && elapsed <= 7000 && mediaElapsed > 0 && mediaElapsed <= (elapsed / 1000) * 2.5 + 0.75) {
          pendingListeningMs += elapsed;
        }
      }
      playbackSample = { wallTime: now, position };
      if (pendingListeningMs >= 15000) flushListeningTime();
    }
    
    async function flushListeningTime() {
      const milliseconds = pendingListeningMs;
      pendingListeningMs = 0;
      if (milliseconds > 0) {
        try { await recordListeningTime(milliseconds); }
        catch (error) { console.warn("Could not save listening time:", error); }
      }
    }

    function formatTime(seconds) {
      if (!Number.isFinite(seconds) || seconds < 0) return "0:00";
      const total = Math.floor(seconds);
      const hours = Math.floor(total / 3600);
      const minutes = Math.floor((total % 3600) / 60);
      const remainder = String(total % 60).padStart(2, "0");
      return hours ? `${hours}:${String(minutes).padStart(2, "0")}:${remainder}` : `${minutes}:${remainder}`;

       199      const total = Math.floor(seconds);

       202      const remainder = String(total % 60).padStart(2, "0");
       203      return hours ? `${hours}:${String(minutes).padStart(2, "0")}:${remainder}` : `${minutes}:${remainder}`;

## Assistant

Implemented the requested player and playlist changes.

- Added an online/offline Wi‑Fi indicator that follows the browser’s network status.
- The player notch opens a smoothly animated full-player view, with the sidebar left visible on desktop. Lyrics are a placeholder; the queue and equalizer replace that pane.
- Added shuffle, repeat, visualizer, and queue controls to the dock. Queue items support touch and mouse dragging, plus arrow-key reordering.
- Removed the equalizer’s separate dialog. Reduced the visualizer to 12 lightweight animated bars, with reduced-motion support.
- Playlists now open without showing tracks; selecting a playlist displays its songs. Pinned playlists also open the selected playlist.
- Updated the Edit page’s empty-state copy to remove its stale import instruction.

Changed [index.html](/Users/admin/Desktop/Puffin/web/index.html), [main.js](/Users/admin/Desktop/Puffin/web/src/main.js), [styles.css](/Users/admin/Desktop/Puffin/web/src/styles.css), [equalizer.js](/Users/admin/Desktop/Puffin/web/src/equalizer.js), [playlist-library.js](/Users/admin/Desktop/Puffin/web/src/playlist-library.js), [edit.js](/Users/admin/Desktop/Puffin/web/src/edit.js), and the service-worker cache version in [sw.js](/Users/admin/Desktop/Puffin/web/public/sw.js).

JavaScript syntax checks, the production build, and all 6 existing tests pass. I didn’t test the interface on a physical phone; the status icon uses the browser’s online/offline signal.

I’ll inspect how Puffin stores media, renders the player, and builds Edit rows, then verify a free synced-lyrics source and its usage rules. I’ll wire lyrics into local storage so they remain available offline, and keep playback analysis entirely in the frontend.

      const videoExtensions = new Set(["mp4", "m4v", "mov", "webm", "ogv", "mkv", "avi"]);
      const audioExtensions = new Set(["mp3", "m4a", "aac", "wav", "flac", "ogg", "oga", "opus", "aiff"]);
    
      if (videoExtensions.has(extension)) return "video";
      if (audioExtensions.has(extension)) return "audio";
      return null;
    }

      if (mimeType && mimeType !== "application/octet-stream") return mimeType;

    function formatTime(seconds) {
      if (!Number.isFinite(seconds) || seconds < 0) return "0:00";
      const total = Math.floor(seconds);
      const hours = Math.floor(total / 3600);
      const minutes = Math.floor((total % 3600) / 60);
      const remainder = String(total % 60).padStart(2, "0");
      return hours ? `${hours}:${String(minutes).padStart(2, "0")}:${remainder}` : `${minutes}:${remainder}`;
    }

    export async function updateMediaMetadata(id, updates) {
      const database = await openDatabase();
      const transaction = database.transaction(TRACKS_STORE, "readwrite");
      const completion = transactionComplete(transaction);
      const store = transaction.objectStore(TRACKS_STORE);
      const request = store.get(id);
      let updatedRecord;
      request.onsuccess = () => {
        if (!request.result) {
          transaction.abort();
          return;
        }
        updatedRecord = { ...request.result, ...updates, updatedAt: Date.now() };
        store.put(updatedRecord);
      };
      await completion;
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent("puffin:metadata-updated", { detail: updatedRecord }));
      return updatedRecord;
    }
    
    export async function getMediaBlob(id) {
      const database = await openDatabase();
      const request = database.transaction(FILES_STORE, "readonly").objectStore(FILES_STORE).get(id);
    
      return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
        request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
      });
    }
    
    export async function deleteMediaFile(id) {
      const database = await openDatabase();
      const transaction = database.transaction([TRACKS_STORE, FILES_STORE, PLAYLISTS_STORE], "readwrite");
      const completion = transactionComplete(transaction);
      transaction.objectStore(TRACKS_STORE).delete(id);
      transaction.objectStore(FILES_STORE).delete(id);
      const playlists = transaction.objectStore(PLAYLISTS_STORE);
      const request = playlists.getAll();
      request.onsuccess = () => {
        request.result.forEach((playlist) => {
          if (playlist.mediaIds.includes(id)) {
            playlist.mediaIds = playlist.mediaIds.filter((mediaId) => mediaId !== id);
            playlist.updatedAt = Date.now();
            playlists.put(playlist);
          }
        });
      };
      await completion;
      window.dispatchEvent(new Event("puffin:library-updated"));
    }

      const completion = transactionComplete(transaction);

      request.onsuccess = () => {
        const plays = (request.result?.plays || []).filter((play) => play.mediaId !== mediaId);

      });

    const LRCLIB_API = "https://lrclib.net/api";
    const CLIENT_HEADER = "Puffin/1.0 (https://github.com/carsrock60/Puffin)";
    const lyricState = new WeakMap();
    
    let requestQueue = Promise.resolve();
    let lastRequestAt = 0;
    let serviceBlockedUntil = 0;
    
    function delay(milliseconds) {
      return new Promise((resolve) => window.setTimeout(resolve, milliseconds));
    }
    
    function parseRetryAfter(value) {
      if (!value) return 1;
      const seconds = Number(value);
      if (Number.isFinite(seconds)) return Math.max(1, seconds);
      const date = Date.parse(value);
      return Number.isFinite(date) ? Math.max(1, Math.ceil((date - Date.now()) / 1000)) : 1;
    }
    
    function requestLyrics(url) {
      const request = requestQueue.then(async () => {
        const waitFor = Math.max(lastRequestAt + 350, serviceBlockedUntil) - Date.now();
        if (waitFor > 0) await delay(waitFor);
        lastRequestAt = Date.now();
    
        const response = await fetch(url, {
          headers: {
            Accept: "application/json",
            "X-User-Agent": CLIENT_HEADER,
          },
        });
        if (response.status === 404) return null;
        if (response.status === 429 || response.status === 503) {
          const seconds = parseRetryAfter(response.headers.get("Retry-After"));
          serviceBlockedUntil = Date.now() + seconds * 1000;
          throw new Error(`LRCLIB asks clients to wait ${seconds} second${seconds === 1 ? "" : "s"} before trying again.`);
        }
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`LRCLIB request failed (${response.status}).`);
        return response.json();
      });
      requestQueue = request.catch(() => {});
      return request;
    }
    
    function normalizeForMatch(value) {
      return String(value || "")
        .normalize("NFKD")
        .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
        .toLocaleLowerCase()
        .replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/gu, " ")
        .trim();
    }
    
    function matchingSyncedResult(results, { trackName, artistName, albumName, duration }) {
      if (!Array.isArray(results)) return null;
      const title = normalizeForMatch(trackName);
      const artist = normalizeForMatch(artistName);
      const album = normalizeForMatch(albumName);
      const durationSeconds = Number(duration);
      const candidates = results.filter((result) => {
        if (!result?.syncedLyrics) return false;
        const candidateTitle = normalizeForMatch(result.trackName || result.name);
        const candidateArtist = normalizeForMatch(result.artistName);
        const titleMatches = candidateTitle === title;
        const artistMatches = candidateArtist === artist
          || (candidateArtist.length > 3 && artist.includes(candidateArtist))
          || (artist.length > 3 && candidateArtist.includes(artist));
        if (!titleMatches || !artistMatches) return false;
        return !Number.isFinite(durationSeconds) || durationSeconds <= 0
          || !Number.isFinite(result.duration) || Math.abs(result.duration - durationSeconds) <= 8;
      });
      candidates.sort((first, second) => {
        const firstDuration = Number.isFinite(durationSeconds) ? Math.abs((first.duration || 0) - durationSeconds) : 0;
        const secondDuration = Number.isFinite(durationSeconds) ? Math.abs((second.duration || 0) - durationSeconds) : 0;
        const firstAlbum = album && normalizeForMatch(first.albumName) === album ? 0 : 1;
        const secondAlbum = album && normalizeForMatch(second.albumName) === album ? 0 : 1;
        return firstAlbum - secondAlbum || firstDuration - secondDuration;
      });
      return candidates[0] || null;
    }
    
    export async function fetchSyncedLyrics({ trackName, artistName, albumName = "", duration }) {
      const cleanTrackName = String(trackName || "").trim();
      const cleanArtistName = String(artistName || "").trim();
      if (!cleanTrackName || !cleanArtistName) {
        throw new Error("Add both a song title and artist before looking up lyrics.");
      }
    
      const params = new URLSearchParams({ track_name: cleanTrackName, artist_name: cleanArtistName });
      if (albumName) params.set("album_name", String(albumName).trim());
      const durationSeconds = Number(duration);
      if (Number.isFinite(durationSeconds) && durationSeconds >= 1 && durationSeconds <= 3600) {
        params.set("duration", String(Math.round(durationSeconds)));
      }
    
      const exactMatch = await requestLyrics(`${LRCLIB_API}/get?${params}`);
      if (exactMatch?.syncedLyrics) return exactMatch;
    
      const searchMatch = await requestLyrics(`${LRCLIB_API}/search?${params}`);
      const result = matchingSyncedResult(Array.isArray(searchMatch) ? searchMatch : [], {
        trackName: cleanTrackName,
        artistName: cleanArtistName,
        albumName,
        duration: durationSeconds,
      });
      if (result) return result;
    
      const instrumental = Array.isArray(searchMatch) && searchMatch.some((item) => item.instrumental
        && normalizeForMatch(item.trackName || item.name) === normalizeForMatch(cleanTrackName));
      throw new Error(instrumental
        ? "LRCLIB marks this track as instrumental; it has no synchronized lyrics."
        : "No matching synchronized lyrics were found. Check the title and artist and try again.");
    }
    
    export function parseSyncedLyrics(lrcText) {
      const text = String(lrcText || "");
      const offset = Number(text.match(/^\[offset:([+-]?\d+)\]\s*$/im)?.[1] || 0);
      const timestampPattern = /\[(\d{1,3}):(\d{2})(?:[.:](\d{1,3}))?\]/g;
      const lines = [];
      for (const rawLine of text.split(/\r?\n/)) {
        const stamps = [...rawLine.matchAll(timestampPattern)];
        const content = rawLine.replace(timestampPattern, "").trim();
        if (!content || stamps.length === 0) continue;
        stamps.forEach((stamp) => {
          const fraction = (stamp[3] || "").padEnd(3, "0").slice(0, 3);
          const timestamp = Math.max(0, Number(stamp[1]) * 60 + Number(stamp[2]) + Number(`0.${fraction || "0"}`) + offset / 1000);
          lines.push({ time: timestamp, text: content });
        });
      }
      return lines.sort((first, second) => first.time - second.time);
    }
    
    export function renderSyncedLyrics(container, lrcText) {
      const lines = parseSyncedLyrics(lrcText);
      const elements = lines.map((line) => {
        const item = document.createElement("li");
        item.dataset.time = String(line.time);
        item.textContent = line.text;
        return item;
      });
      container.replaceChildren(...elements);
      lyricState.set(container, { lines, elements, activeIndex: -1 });
      return lines.length;
    }
    
    export function syncSyncedLyrics(container, currentTime) {
      const state = lyricState.get(container);
      if (!state || state.lines.length === 0 || !Number.isFinite(currentTime)) return;
      let low = 0;
      let high = state.lines.length - 1;
      let active = -1;
      while (low <= high) {
        const middle = (low + high) >> 1;
        if (state.lines[middle].time <= currentTime) {
          active = middle;
          low = middle + 1;
        } else high = middle - 1;
      }
      if (active === state.activeIndex) return;
      state.elements[state.activeIndex]?.removeAttribute("aria-current");
      state.elements[state.activeIndex]?.classList.remove("is-active");
      state.activeIndex = active;
      if (active >= 0) {
        state.elements[active].setAttribute("aria-current", "true");
        state.elements[active].classList.add("is-active");
        state.elements[active].scrollIntoView({ block: "center", behavior: "smooth" });
      }
    }

      function createAudioGraph() {
        if (routes) return;
        const AudioContextClass = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
        if (!AudioContextClass) throw new Error("This browser does not support audio equalizer controls.");
    
        audioContext = new AudioContextClass();
        routes = [audioPlayer, videoPlayer].map((player) => {
          const source = audioContext.createMediaElementSource(player);
          const filters = FREQUENCIES.map((frequency) => {
            const filter = audioContext.createBiquadFilter();
            filter.type = "peaking";
            filter.frequency.value = frequency;
            filter.Q.value = 1;

          preamp.connect(audioContext.destination);
          return { filters, preamp };
        });
        updateAudioGraph();

    function formatTime(seconds) {
      if (!Number.isFinite(seconds) || seconds < 0) return "0:00";
      const total = Math.floor(seconds);
      const hours = Math.floor(total / 3600);
      const minutes = Math.floor((total % 3600) / 60);
      const remainder = String(total % 60).padStart(2, "0");
      return hours ? `${hours}:${String(minutes).padStart(2, "0")}:${remainder}` : `${minutes}:${remainder}`;
    }

      connectionStatus.title = online ? "Online" : "Offline";

          || playerFullscreen.hidden || activePlayer !== audioPlayer || audioPlayer.paused || audioPlayer.ended) return;

    async function prepareQueue(record) {
      if (record.kind !== "audio") return;
      try {
        const allAudio = (await listMediaFiles()).filter((item) => item.kind === "audio");
        const available = new Map(allAudio.map((item) => [item.id, item]));
        const inExistingOrder = queueRecords.map((item) => available.get(item.id)).filter(Boolean);
        const included = new Set(inExistingOrder.map((item) => item.id));
        queueRecords = [...inExistingOrder, ...allAudio.filter((item) => !included.has(item.id))];
        if (!queueRecords.some((item) => item.id === record.id)) queueRecords.unshift(record);
      } catch {
        if (!queueRecords.some((item) => item.id === record.id)) queueRecords = [record];
      }
      renderPlayerQueue();
    }

    function openPlayerMode(pane = "lyrics") {
      if (!activeMediaRecord || activeMediaRecord.kind !== "audio") return;
      window.clearTimeout(playerModeCloseTimer);
      if (playerFullscreen.hidden) playerModeReturnFocus = document.activeElement;

      setPlayerPane(pane);
      updateFullPlayerControls();
      setPlayerRevealState(true);
      document.querySelector("#full-player-back").focus({ preventScroll: true });
    }
    
    function closePlayerMode() {

      playerFullscreen.inert = true;

      const currentTime = activePlayer && Number.isFinite(activePlayer.currentTime) ? activePlayer.currentTime : 0;
      playerSeek.max = String(duration);
      playerSeek.disabled = !activePlayer || duration <= 0;
      if (!isSeeking) playerSeek.value = String(Math.min(currentTime, duration));
      playerCurrentTime.textContent = formatTime(currentTime);
      playerDuration.textContent = formatTime(duration);

    async function toggleVisualizer() {
      if (activeMediaRecord?.kind !== "audio") return;
      if (playerFullscreen.hidden) openPlayerMode("lyrics");
      else if (playerPane !== "lyrics") setPlayerPane("lyrics");
      if (visualizerEnabled) {
        setVisualizerEnabled(false);
        return;
      }
      setVisualizerEnabled(true);
      const status = document.querySelector("#full-player-visualizer-status");
      status.hidden = true;
      try {
        visualizerAnalyser = await equalizerController.getAnalyser(audioPlayer);
        if (!visualizerAnalyser) throw new Error("Audio analysis is unavailable in this browser.");
        visualizerData = new Uint8Array(visualizerAnalyser.frequencyBinCount);
        startVisualizerLoop();
      } catch (error) {
        setVisualizerEnabled(false);
        status.textContent = `Visualizer could not start: ${error.message}`;
        status.hidden = false;
      }
    }
    
    function setPlayerPane(pane) {
      if (activePlayer.paused) { try { await activePlayer.play(); } catch {} }
      else activePlayer.pause();
      updatePlayerControls();
    });

      if (activePlayer && Number.isFinite(activePlayer.duration)) activePlayer.currentTime = Number(fullPlayerSeek.value);

## Assistant

I’ve moved the visualizer into a small bottom strip and connected it to a low-cost Web Audio analyser that runs only while it’s visible and music is playing. I’ve also added LRCLIB lookup from Edit and save the synced LRC text in each IndexedDB track record, so downloaded lyrics can be displayed offline. I’m checking the integration now.

        item.textContent = line.text;

      return lines.length;

    export function syncSyncedLyrics(container, currentTime) {
      const state = lyricState.get(container);
      if (!state || state.lines.length === 0 || !Number.isFinite(currentTime)) return;
      let low = 0;
      let high = state.lines.length - 1;
      let active = -1;
      while (low <= high) {
        const middle = (low + high) >> 1;
        if (state.lines[middle].time <= currentTime) {
          active = middle;
          low = middle + 1;
        } else high = middle - 1;
      }
      if (active === state.activeIndex) return;
      state.elements[state.activeIndex]?.removeAttribute("aria-current");
      state.elements[state.activeIndex]?.classList.remove("is-active");

## Assistant

Implemented the player and lyrics changes. Synced lyrics are looked up from LRCLIB in Edit and saved in the existing IndexedDB media record, so lyrics that have been downloaded remain available offline. LRCLIB provides a free API without an API key and supports browser requests; its catalog may not include every track. [LRCLIB API documentation](https://lrclib.net/docs)

The visualizer is now a compact strip at the bottom of the full player. It uses live audio frequency data in the frontend through the Web Audio API, and runs only while it’s enabled and music is playing. [MDN: `AnalyserNode`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/AnalyserNode/getByteFrequencyData)

Clicking EQ or Queue again returns to lyrics; clicking Visualizer again turns it off while keeping lyrics visible. Playback now starts in Repeat All mode, so it loops to the first queued song even when shuffle is off. I also fixed playlist selection so opening a playlist loads its songs.

**Verification:** JavaScript syntax checks, all 6 existing tests, and the production build passed. I haven’t tested playback or offline behavior on a physical iPhone or Android device; those still need manual verification.

**Main files:** [lyrics.js](/Users/admin/Desktop/Puffin/web/src/lyrics.js), [edit.js](/Users/admin/Desktop/Puffin/web/src/edit.js), [main.js](/Users/admin/Desktop/Puffin/web/src/main.js), [equalizer.js](/Users/admin/Desktop/Puffin/web/src/equalizer.js), [index.html](/Users/admin/Desktop/Puffin/web/index.html), and [styles.css](/Users/admin/Desktop/Puffin/web/src/styles.css). LRCLIB needs an internet connection to download lyrics; saved lyrics are read locally afterward.

    export function syncSyncedLyrics(container, currentTime) {
      const state = lyricState.get(container);
      if (!state || state.lines.length === 0 || !Number.isFinite(currentTime)) return;

        state.elements[active].classList.add("is-active");
        state.elements[active].scrollIntoView({ block: "center", behavior: "smooth" });
      }
    }

    function parseRetryAfter(value) {
      if (!value) return 1;
      const seconds = Number(value);
      if (Number.isFinite(seconds)) return Math.max(1, seconds);
      const date = Date.parse(value);
      return Number.isFinite(date) ? Math.max(1, Math.ceil((date - Date.now()) / 1000)) : 1;

    function requestLyrics(url) {
      const request = requestQueue.then(async () => {
        const waitFor = Math.max(lastRequestAt + 350, serviceBlockedUntil) - Date.now();
        if (waitFor > 0) await delay(waitFor);
        lastRequestAt = Date.now();
    
        const response = await fetch(url, {
          headers: {
            Accept: "application/json",
            "X-User-Agent": CLIENT_HEADER,
          },
        });
        if (response.status === 404) return null;
        if (response.status === 429 || response.status === 503) {
          const seconds = parseRetryAfter(response.headers.get("Retry-After"));
          serviceBlockedUntil = Date.now() + seconds * 1000;
          throw new Error(`LRCLIB asks clients to wait ${seconds} second${seconds === 1 ? "" : "s"} before trying again.`);
        }
        if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`LRCLIB request failed (${response.status}).`);
        return response.json();
      });
      requestQueue = request.catch(() => {});
      return request;
    }

I’ve changed the lyrics pane to follow the audio clock on animation frames while it’s playing and to center new lines immediately, with immediate re-sync after seeking or resuming.

    const CACHE_NAME = "puffin-shell-v21";
    const APP_SHELL = [
      "/",
