       180    def _search_youtube(query: str) -> list[dict]:
       181        command = _yt_dlp_command(
       182            "--dump-single-json",
       183            "--flat-playlist",
       184            "--skip-download",
       185            "--quiet",
       186            "--no-warnings",
       187            f"ytsearch10:{query}",
       188        ]
       189        result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30, check=True)
       190        payload = json.loads(result.stdout)
       191        videos = []
       192        for entry in payload.get("entries") or []:
       193            video_id = entry.get("id")
       194            if not video_id:
       195                continue
       196            thumbnails = entry.get("thumbnails") or []
       197            thumbnail = entry.get("thumbnail") or (thumbnails[-1].get("url") if thumbnails else None)
       198            videos.append({
       199                "id": video_id,
       200                "url": f"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={quote(str(video_id), safe='')}",
       201                "title": entry.get("title") or "Untitled video",
       202                "channel": entry.get("uploader") or entry.get("channel") or "Unknown channel",
       203                "duration": entry.get("duration"),
       204                "thumbnail": thumbnail,
       205            })
       206            if len(videos) == 10:
       207                break
       208        return videos

       374    def _cleanup_expired_jobs() -> None:
       375        while True:
       376            time.sleep(60)
       377            now = time.time()
       378            with JOBS_LOCK:
       379                expired = [
       380                    job_id for job_id, job in JOBS.items()
       381                    if job["status"] in {"ready", "failed", "cancelled"}
       382                    and not job["transfers"]
       383                    and now - (job.get("ready_at") or job["updated_at"]) > JOB_RETENTION_SECONDS
       384                ]
       385                for job_id in expired:
       645                    self._json(409, {"error": "Wait for the file transfer to finish before confirming it."})
       646                    return
       647                _remove_work_directory(job)
       648                del JOBS[job_id]
       649
       650            LOGGER.info("Puffin confirmed and removed download job %s", job_id)
       651            self._no_content()

       653        def do_DELETE(self) -> None:
       654            if self._reject_origin():
       655                return
       656            path_parts = [unquote(part) for part in urlsplit(self.path).path.strip("/").split("/")]
       657            if len(path_parts) != 3 or path_parts[:2] != ["api", "downloads"]:
       658                self._json(404, {"error": "Endpoint not found."})
       659                return
       660
       661            job_id = path_parts[2]
       662            with JOBS_LOCK:
       663                job = JOBS.get(job_id)
       664                if not job:
       665                    self._json(404, {"error": "Download job not found or expired."})
       666                    return
       667                if job["transfers"]:
       668                    self._json(409, {"error": "Wait for the current file transfer to finish before cancelling."})
       669                    return
       670                job["cancel_requested"] = True
       671                process = job.get("process")
       672                if process and process.poll() is None:
       673                    process.terminate()
       674                if job["status"] == "ready":
       675                    _remove_work_directory(job)
       676                    del JOBS[job_id]
       677                elif process and process.poll() is None:
       678                    # Keep the job active until yt-dlp exits so another job cannot overlap it.
       679                    pass
       680                else:
       681                    job["status"] = "cancelled"
       682                    job["updated_at"] = time.time()
       683                    _remove_work_directory(job)
       684
       685            self._no_content(202)

       688    def _remove_stale_files() -> None:
       689        """Clear abandoned Puffin job folders without touching unrelated files."""
       690        DOWNLOAD_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
       691        for path in DOWNLOAD_DIR.iterdir():
       692            if path.is_dir() and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{32}", path.name):
       693                shutil.rmtree(path, ignore_errors=True)

       696    def main() -> None:
       697        DOWNLOAD_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
       698        _remove_stale_files()
       699        threading.Thread(target=_cleanup_expired_jobs, daemon=True).start()
       700
       701        server = ThreadingHTTPServer((HOST, PORT), PuffinHandler)
       702        LOGGER.info("Puffin downloader listening on %s:%s", HOST, PORT)
       703        LOGGER.info("Allowing browser origins: %s", ", ".join(sorted(ALLOWED_ORIGINS)) or "none")
       704        try:
       705            server.serve_forever()
       706        except KeyboardInterrupt:
       707            LOGGER.info("Stopping Puffin downloader")
       708        finally:
       709            server.server_close()

    def _search_youtube(query: str) -> list[dict]:
        command = _yt_dlp_command(
            "--dump-single-json",
            "--flat-playlist",
            "--skip-download",
            "--quiet",
            "--no-warnings",
            f"ytsearch10:{query}",
        )
        result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30, check=True)
        payload = json.loads(result.stdout)
        videos = []
        for entry in payload.get("entries") or []:
            video_id = entry.get("id")
            if not video_id:
                continue
            thumbnails = entry.get("thumbnails") or []
            thumbnail = entry.get("thumbnail") or (thumbnails[-1].get("url") if thumbnails else None)
            videos.append({
                "id": video_id,
                "url": f"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={quote(str(video_id), safe='')}",
                "title": entry.get("title") or "Untitled video",
                "channel": entry.get("uploader") or entry.get("channel") or "Unknown channel",
                "duration": entry.get("duration"),
                "thumbnail": thumbnail,
            })
            if len(videos) == 10:
                break
        return videos
    
    
    def _remove_work_directory(job: dict) -> None:
        work_dir = job.get("work_dir")
        if work_dir:
            shutil.rmtree(work_dir, ignore_errors=True)
    
    
    def _run_download(job_id: str) -> None:
        with JOBS_LOCK:
                job["status"] = "cancelled"

            job["updated_at"] = time.time()
    
        work_dir = Path(job["work_dir"])
        output_template = str(work_dir / "%(title).160s [%(id)s].%(ext)s")

            "--no-playlist",
            "--newline",
            "--progress",
            "--no-write-info-json",
            "--no-write-thumbnail",
            "--no-write-subs",
            "--no-overwrites",
            "--retry-sleep",
            "http:linear=1:5",
            "--retry-sleep",
            "fragment:linear=1:5",
            "--retry-sleep",
            "extractor:linear=1:3",
            "--max-filesize",
            str(MAX_DOWNLOAD_BYTES),
            "--output",
            output_template,
        )
    
        if job["kind"] == "audio":
            command.extend([
                "--format",
                "bestaudio",
            ])
        else:
            command.extend([
                "--format",
                "bv[vcodec~='^(avc|h264)']+ba[acodec~='^(mp4a|aac)']/b[vcodec~='^(avc|h264)'][acodec~='^(mp4a|aac)']",
                "--merge-output-format",
                "mp4",
            ])
        command.append(job["url"])
    
        process = None
        compatible_format_missing = False
        output_tail = []
        try:
            process = subprocess.Popen(
                command,

                stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                text=True,
                errors="replace",
                bufsize=1,
                start_new_session=True,
            )
            with JOBS_LOCK:

                    eta_match = ETA_PATTERN.search(line)

                    if eta_match:
                        current_job["eta"] = eta_match.group(1)
    
            return_code = process.wait()

                current_job = JOBS.get(job_id)
                if not current_job:
                    _remove_work_directory(job)

                current_job["process"] = None

            output_files = [

            output_file = max(output_files, key=lambda path: path.stat().st_mtime)

            with JOBS_LOCK:

                if current_job["cancel_requested"]:

                    "ready_at": time.time(),

        def _create_download(self) -> None:
            try:
                request = self._read_json()
            except ValueError as error:
                self._json(400, {"error": str(error)})
                return
    
            url = request.get("url")
            kind = request.get("kind")
            if not _is_allowed_media_url(url):
                self._json(400, {"error": "Enter an HTTPS YouTube video URL or a valid YouTube search query."})
                return
            if not isinstance(kind, str) or kind not in {"audio", "video"}:
                self._json(400, {"error": "Choose audio (M4A) or video (MP4)."})
                return
            requested_audio_formats = request.get("supported_audio_formats", [])
            if not isinstance(requested_audio_formats, list):
                requested_audio_formats = []
            supported_audio_formats = [
                extension.lower()
                for extension in requested_audio_formats
                if isinstance(extension, str) and extension.lower() in SUPPORTED_AUDIO_EXTENSIONS
            ]
    
            DOWNLOAD_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            with JOBS_LOCK:
                existing_job = next((
                    job for job in JOBS.values()
                    if job["status"] in {"queued", "downloading", "converting"}
                    or (job["status"] == "ready" and job["transfers"])
                ), None)
                if existing_job:
                    self._json(409, {"error": "Finish or cancel the current Pi download before starting another."})
                    return
    
                # A completed but unconfirmed file is replaceable when another
                # download is requested; the original client's local save failed
                # or it never returned to confirm receipt.
                for old_job_id, old_job in list(JOBS.items()):
                    if old_job["status"] == "ready" and not old_job["transfers"]:
                        _remove_work_directory(old_job)
                        del JOBS[old_job_id]
    
                free_bytes = shutil.disk_usage(DOWNLOAD_DIR).free
                if free_bytes < MIN_FREE_BYTES:
                    self._json(507, {"error": "The Pi is low on free storage. Clear space before downloading."})
                    return
    
                job_id = uuid.uuid4().hex
                work_dir = DOWNLOAD_DIR / job_id
                work_dir.mkdir(mode=0o700)
                job = {
                    "id": job_id,
                    "url": url,
                    "kind": kind,
                    "supported_audio_formats": supported_audio_formats,
                    "status": "queued",
                    "progress": 0,
                    "speed": None,
                    "eta": None,
                    "error": None,
                    "filename": None,
                    "file_path": None,
                    "size": None,
                    "mime_type": None,
                    "work_dir": str(work_dir),
                    "created_at": time.time(),
                    "updated_at": time.time(),
                    "ready_at": None,
                    "process": None,
                    "cancel_requested": False,
                    "transfers": 0,
                }
                JOBS[job_id] = job
    
            threading.Thread(target=_run_download, args=(job_id,), daemon=True).start()
            self._json(202, _public_job(job))
    
        def _complete_download(self, job_id: str) -> None:
            with JOBS_LOCK:
                job = JOBS.get(job_id)
                if not job:
                    self._json(404, {"error": "Download job not found or expired."})
                    return
                if job["status"] != "ready":
                    self._json(409, {"error": "Only a ready download can be confirmed."})
                    return
                if job["transfers"]:
                    self._json(409, {"error": "Wait for the file transfer to finish before confirming it."})
                    return
                _remove_work_directory(job)
                del JOBS[job_id]
    
            LOGGER.info("Puffin confirmed and removed download job %s", job_id)
            self._no_content()
    
        def do_DELETE(self) -> None:
            if self._reject_origin():
                return
            path_parts = [unquote(part) for part in urlsplit(self.path).path.strip("/").split("/")]
            if len(path_parts) != 3 or path_parts[:2] != ["api", "downloads"]:
                self._json(404, {"error": "Endpoint not found."})
                return
    
            job_id = path_parts[2]
            with JOBS_LOCK:
                job = JOBS.get(job_id)
                if not job:
                    self._json(404, {"error": "Download job not found or expired."})
                    return
                if job["transfers"]:
                    self._json(409, {"error": "Wait for the current file transfer to finish before cancelling."})
                    return

    # Raspberry Pi downloader setup
    
    The Pi service runs `yt-dlp` as a private, job-based API. Puffin requests an audio or video download, polls for progress, receives the result, saves it in the device's IndexedDB library, and then confirms the save so the Pi can delete its temporary file.
    
    The service accepts HTTPS YouTube URLs and `ytsearch:` search queries. Audio downloads preserve yt-dlp's audio-only source format when the requesting browser supports it; Puffin sends its supported audio formats with the request. If necessary, the Pi remuxes AAC into M4A without re-encoding, or converts incompatible audio to AAC/M4A at 192 kb/s. Puffin can search YouTube through the Pi's `GET /api/search?q=...` endpoint; this uses yt-dlp's flat search to return up to 10 video titles, channels, durations, URLs, and thumbnails without downloading media. CSV batches can submit a `ytsearch:` query for each `Track Name`, `Artist Name`, and `Album` row. Video downloads require the source to offer H.264 and AAC streams; the service reports an error when those formats are unavailable rather than returning a less-compatible codec. It permits one active download or file transfer at a time. A new request replaces an older completed file that Puffin did not confirm. The default temporary file limit is 2 GiB, and the default free-space reserve is 1 GiB. An unconfirmed file is removed after one hour. Job state is held in memory, so a Pi restart cancels active jobs and clears abandoned Puffin job folders.
    
    ## Install on Raspberry Pi OS
    
    Clone the repository onto the Pi, then install the system dependencies and Python environment. These commands assume Raspberry Pi OS and that you will clone the repo into `~/Puffin`:
    
    ```sh
    git clone https://github.com/carsrock60/Puffin.git ~/Puffin
    sudo apt update
    sudo apt install -y python3-venv ffmpeg
    cd ~/Puffin/pi-service
    python3 -m venv .venv
    .venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip
    .venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
    ```
    
    Set the allowed browser origins. Include the Vercel site origin and the local Vite origin used during development. Origins have no trailing slash. For example, if your deployed app is `https://puffin.vercel.app`, include that exact origin:
    
    ```sh
    export PUFFIN_ALLOWED_ORIGINS="https://your-puffin-site.vercel.app,http://localhost:5173"

       739        DOWNLOAD_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        61    def _yt_dlp_command(*arguments: str) -> list[str]:
        62        # Use the exact interpreter running this service. systemd does not
        63        # activate the virtual environment's bin directory in PATH.
        64        return [sys.executable, "-m", "yt_dlp", *arguments]

        67    def _signal_process_group(process: subprocess.Popen, force: bool = False) -> None:
        68        if process.poll() is not None:
        69            return
        70        try:
        71            os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL if force else signal.SIGTERM)
        72        except (ProcessLookupError, PermissionError):
        73            try:
        74                process.kill() if force else process.terminate()
        75            except ProcessLookupError:
        76                pass
        77
        78
        79    def _terminate_process_group(process: subprocess.Popen) -> None:
        80        _signal_process_group(process)
        81        try:
        82            process.wait(timeout=5)
        83        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        84            _signal_process_group(process, force=True)
        85            process.wait()
        86

        94        output = "\n".join(lines)

       104        if "sign in to confirm" in lowered or "private video" in lowered or "requires authentication" in lowered:
       105            return "This video requires sign-in or is not publicly available."
       106
       107        for line in reversed(lines):
       108            if "error:" in line.lower():
       109                return f"yt-dlp failed: {_safe_diagnostic(line)}"
       110        return f"yt-dlp exited with code {return_code}. Check the Pi service logs for details."

       113    def _is_allowed_media_url(value: object) -> bool:
       114        if not isinstance(value, str) or len(value) > 4096:
       115            return False
       116        if value.startswith(("ytsearch:", "ytsearch1:")):
       117            query = value.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
       118            return bool(query) and len(query) <= 1000 and not any(ord(character) < 32 for character in query)
       119        try:
       120            parsed = urlsplit(value)
       121            hostname = (parsed.hostname or "").lower().rstrip(".")
       122            port = parsed.port
       123        except ValueError:
       124            return False
       125
       126        youtube_host = hostname == "youtu.be" or hostname == "youtube.com" or hostname.endswith(".youtube.com")
       127        return parsed.scheme == "https" and port in {None, 443} and not parsed.username and not parsed.password and youtube_host

       135    def _ensure_supported_audio(path: Path, supported_formats: list[str], job: dict) -> Path:
       136        extension = path.suffix.lower().lstrip(".")
       137        if extension in supported_formats and extension in SUPPORTED_AUDIO_EXTENSIONS:
       138            return path
       139
       140        output_path = path.with_suffix(".m4a")
       141        with JOBS_LOCK:
       142            job["status"] = "converting"
       143            job["progress"] = 99
       144            job["updated_at"] = time.time()
       145
       146        common_args = ["ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-y", "-i", str(path), "-vn"]
       147        copied = subprocess.run(
       148            [*common_args, "-c:a", "copy", "-movflags", "+faststart", str(output_path)],
       149            capture_output=True,
       150            text=True,
       151        )
       152        if copied.returncode != 0:
       153            encoded = subprocess.run(
       154                [*common_args, "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "192k", "-movflags", "+faststart", str(output_path)],
       155                capture_output=True,
       156                text=True,
       157            )
       158            if encoded.returncode != 0:
       159                detail = (encoded.stderr or copied.stderr or "").strip().splitlines()
       160                summary = _safe_diagnostic(detail[-1]) if detail else "ffmpeg returned an error"
       161                raise DownloadFailure(f"Could not convert this audio to a Puffin-compatible M4A file: {summary}")
       162
       163        path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
       164        return output_path

       183        command = _yt_dlp_command(
       184            "--dump-single-json",
       185            "--flat-playlist",
       186            "--skip-download",
       187            "--quiet",
       188            "--no-warnings",
       189            f"ytsearch10:{query}",
       190        )
       191        result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30, check=True)
       192        payload = json.loads(result.stdout)
       193        videos = []
       194        for entry in payload.get("entries") or []:
       195            video_id = entry.get("id")
       196            if not video_id:
       197                continue
       198            thumbnails = entry.get("thumbnails") or []
       199            thumbnail = entry.get("thumbnail") or (thumbnails[-1].get("url") if thumbnails else None)
       200            videos.append({
       201                "id": video_id,
       202                "url": f"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={quote(str(video_id), safe='')}",
       203                "title": entry.get("title") or "Untitled video",
       204                "channel": entry.get("uploader") or entry.get("channel") or "Unknown channel",
       205                "duration": entry.get("duration"),
       206                "thumbnail": thumbnail,
       207            })
       208            if len(videos) == 10:
       209                break
       210        return videos

         1    # Raspberry Pi downloader setup
         2
         3    The Pi service runs `yt-dlp` as a private, job-based API. Puffin requests an audio or video download, polls for progress, receives the result, saves it in the device's IndexedDB library, and then confirms the save so the Pi can delete its temporary file.
         4
         5    The service accepts HTTPS YouTube URLs and `ytsearch:` search queries. Audio downloads preserve yt-dlp's audio-only source format when the requesting browser supports it; Puffin sends its supported audio formats with the request. If necessary, the Pi remuxes AAC into M4A without re-encoding, or converts incompatible audio to AAC/M4A at 192 kb/s. Puffin can search YouTube through the Pi's `GET /api/search?q=...` endpoint; this uses yt-dlp's flat search to return up to 10 video titles, channels, durations, URLs, and thumbnails without downloading media. CSV batches can submit a `ytsearch:` query for each `Track Name`, `Artist Name`, and `Album` row. Video downloads require the source to offer H.264 and AAC streams; the service reports an error when those formats are unavailable rather than returning a less-compatible codec. It permits one active download or file transfer at a time. A new request replaces an older completed file that Puffin did not confirm. The default temporary file limit is 2 GiB, and the default free-space reserve is 1 GiB. An unconfirmed file is removed after one hour. Job state is held in memory, so a Pi restart cancels active jobs and clears abandoned Puffin job folders.
         6
         7    YouTube now requires yt-dlp's JavaScript challenge solver and an external JavaScript runtime for full extraction support. The setup below installs the matching `yt-dlp-ejs` dependency and Deno. Puffin invokes yt-dlp through the service's own virtual-environment Python interpreter, so it does not depend on shell activation or systemd finding yt-dlp through `PATH`. [yt-dlp EJS setup](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/EJS)
         8
         9    ## Install on Raspberry Pi OS
        10
        11    Clone the repository onto the Pi, then install the system dependencies and Python environment. These commands assume Raspberry Pi OS and that you will clone the repo into `~/Puffin`:
        12
        13    ```sh
        14    git clone https://github.com/carsrock60/Puffin.git ~/Puffin
        15    sudo apt update
        16    sudo apt install -y python3-venv ffmpeg curl
        17    curl -fsSL https://deno.land/install.sh | sh
        18    export PATH="$HOME/.deno/bin:$PATH"
        19    cd ~/Puffin/pi-service
        20    python3 -m venv .venv
        21    .venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        22    .venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade -r requirements.txt
        23    deno --version
        24    .venv/bin/python -m yt_dlp --version
        25    ```
        26
        27    Set the allowed browser origins. Include the Vercel site origin and the local Vite origin used during development. Origins have no trailing slash. For example, if your deployed app is `https://puffin.vercel.app`, include that exact origin:
        28
        29    ```sh
        30    export PUFFIN_ALLOWED_ORIGINS="https://your-puffin-site.vercel.app,http://localhost:5173"
        31    export PUFFIN_DOWNLOAD_DIR="$HOME/puffin-downloads"
        32    ```
        33
        34    Start the service for an initial check:
        35
        36    ```sh
        37    .venv/bin/python app.py
        38    ```
        39
        40    It listens on `127.0.0.1:8765`, so it is not directly exposed to the local network. Leave this process running while testing. Stop it with Ctrl+C.
        41
        42    ## Make the service privately reachable
        43
        44    Install and sign in to Tailscale on the Pi, Mac, and iPhone. With the Pi service running, publish it only inside your tailnet:
        45
        46    ```sh
        47    tailscale serve --bg 8765
        48    ```
        49
        50    Tailscale Serve will show an HTTPS URL such as `https://pi-name.example-tailnet.ts.net`. Enter that URL into Puffin's Pi address field. Keep Tailscale connected on devices that need to start downloads. Do not expose this service with port forwarding or Tailscale Funnel. [Tailscale Serve documentation](https://tailscale.com/docs/features/tailscale-serve)
        51
        52    On each Mac or iPhone, install Tailscale and sign in to the same tailnet as the Pi. The device does not join your home Wi-Fi automatically; Tailscale creates the private connection over whatever internet connection the device is using. The Vercel-hosted Puffin page can then reach the Pi while Tailscale is connected.
        53
        54    ## Keep it running after reboot
        55
        56    Copy `puffin-downloader.service.example` to `/etc/systemd/system/puffin-downloader.service`. Replace `/home/REPLACE_ME` in the unit with the Pi user's home directory, and replace `REPLACE_ME` with that user's account name. Create `/etc/puffin-downloader.env` with:
        57
        58    ```ini
        59    PUFFIN_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=https://your-puffin-site.vercel.app,http://localhost:5173
        60    PUFFIN_DOWNLOAD_DIR=/home/REPLACE_ME/puffin-downloads
        61    PUFFIN_MAX_DOWNLOAD_BYTES=2147483648
        62    PUFFIN_MIN_FREE_BYTES=1073741824
        63    ```
        64
        65    Replace the placeholder values. The systemd example includes Deno's install directory in `PATH`; update that line if Deno is installed elsewhere. Then enable the service:
        66
        67    ```sh
        68    sudo chmod 600 /etc/puffin-downloader.env
        69    sudo systemctl daemon-reload
        70    sudo systemctl enable --now puffin-downloader
        71    sudo systemctl status puffin-downloader
        72    ```
        73
        74    Run `tailscale serve --bg 8765` once for the Pi's Tailscale service. To inspect downloader logs later, use:
        75
        76    ```sh
        77    sudo journalctl -u puffin-downloader -f
        78    ```
        79
        80    The origin allowlist is a browser CORS rule, not authentication. Keep access private with Tailscale Serve and only add origins you control.

## Assistant

The Pi service was hiding the useful error. Whenever yt-dlp exited unsuccessfully—or produced no media—the job raised a generic `RuntimeError`, and the handler reported only that it failed. That concealed causes such as YouTube’s JavaScript challenge support being unavailable. Current yt-dlp needs `yt-dlp-ejs` and a JavaScript runtime for full YouTube support; `yt-dlp[default]` installs the EJS package, and the setup now adds Deno. [yt-dlp EJS setup](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/EJS) · [yt-dlp dependencies](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#dependencies)

I also found a cancellation race: the API could delete a job’s temporary directory while its worker was still checking or converting the download.

I updated the Pi service to invoke yt-dlp through its own Python environment, show a useful sanitized error, retry transient download failures, and let workers clean up their files after cancellation. It also catches a failure to start the worker thread and returns a clear response. The changes are in [app.py](/Users/admin/Desktop/Puffin/pi-service/app.py), [requirements.txt](/Users/admin/Desktop/Puffin/pi-service/requirements.txt), [puffin-downloader.service.example](/Users/admin/Desktop/Puffin/pi-service/puffin-downloader.service.example), and [README.md](/Users/admin/Desktop/Puffin/pi-service/README.md).

**Verification:** Python syntax compilation and `git diff --check` passed. I haven’t run a download on the physical Pi. To use the fix there, pull the code, update the service’s virtualenv requirements, make sure Deno is installed and on the systemd service’s `PATH`, then restart the service; the README has the upgrade steps.

The unit file is now in place and correctly points to `/home/carsrock60/Puffin/pi-service`. The missing environment file needs to be created before the service can start.

First, confirm the dependencies are available:

```sh

```

If the Deno command fails, install it with:

```sh

```

Create the environment file:

```sh
sudo nano /etc/puffin-downloader.env
```

Add these lines, replacing `YOUR-PUFFIN-VERCEL-DOMAIN` with the site origin you use in your browser—just the `https://…` part, without a trailing slash:

```ini

PUFFIN_MIN_FREE_BYTES=1073741824
```

Save with **Ctrl+O**, Enter, then **Ctrl+X**. The localhost origin is optional; keep it only if you use Puffin from a local development server.

Next, check whether the Deno path is already in the service file:

```sh
sudo grep -n 'PATH=' /etc/systemd/system/puffin-downloader.service
```

If it prints nothing, edit the unit with `sudo nano /etc/systemd/system/puffin-downloader.service` and add this line under `[Service]`:

```ini
Environment=PATH=/home/carsrock60/.deno/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin
```

Once those are set, start the service:

```sh
sudo chmod 600 /etc/puffin-downloader.env
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable --now puffin-downloader
sudo systemctl status puffin-downloader --no-pager
```

If the status isn’t `active (running)`, run `sudo journalctl -u puffin-downloader -n 40 --no-pager` and send me the output.

## User

remind me agian what this is for?

## Assistant

This setup makes Puffin’s Raspberry Pi downloader run automatically as a managed service. It lets Puffin send download jobs to the Pi, and keeps the downloader running after reboots.

- The **virtual environment** holds yt-dlp and its dependencies.
- **Deno and yt-dlp-ejs** help yt-dlp handle YouTube’s JavaScript checks.
- The **systemd unit** starts and monitors the downloader.
- The **environment file** sets which Puffin website may connect and where temporary downloads go.

## Assistant

That means something is already listening on Puffin’s port `8765`—most likely the systemd service you just enabled. You generally shouldn’t start `app.py` manually while that service is running.

Check it with:

```sh
sudo systemctl status puffin-downloader --no-pager
```

If it says **active (running)**, the downloader is already running. To restart it after a code change, use:

```sh
sudo systemctl restart puffin-downloader
```

If the service isn’t running, check what owns the port:

```sh
sudo ss -ltnp 'sport = :8765'
```

Share that output if you’re unsure what process it shows.

## Assistant

You were right to push for a fix. The direct yt-dlp search succeeds, but Puffin’s search command added `--quiet` while expecting JSON on stdout. I changed that option to `--no-progress` in [app.py](/Users/admin/Desktop/Puffin/pi-service/app.py), so progress output stays suppressed without suppressing the search result.

To apply the same one-line fix on the Pi now, run:

```sh
cd ~/Puffin/pi-service
sed -i 's/"--quiet",/"--no-progress",/' app.py
sudo systemctl restart puffin-downloader
```

Then try Puffin search again. I didn’t run more tests.

## Assistant

The log gives us the failing point: the Pi service raises `FileNotFoundError` while starting the search command. The manual command works because you explicitly used the virtualenv’s Python. The systemd unit’s `PATH` doesn’t include the virtualenv’s `bin` directory, so the service can’t find `yt-dlp` when it launches it by name.

On the Pi, edit the service unit:

```sh
sudo nano /etc/systemd/system/puffin-downloader.service
```

Under `[Service]`, add or replace its `Environment=PATH=...` line with:

```ini
Environment=PATH=/home/carsrock60/Puffin/pi-service/.venv/bin:/home/carsrock60/.deno/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin
```

Save with **Ctrl+O**, Enter, then **Ctrl+X**. Apply the unit change:

```sh
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl restart puffin-downloader
```

Then try the YouTube search in Puffin again. I also updated the project’s service example so it includes the virtualenv path.

       359        const minutes = Math.floor((total % 3600) / 60);
       360        const remainder = total % 60;
       361        return hours
       362          ? `${hours}:${String(minutes).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(remainder).padStart(2, "0")}`

## User

how do i start the pi again? i had to delete and re-clone Puffin into it.

## Assistant

Re-cloning removed the Pi’s `.venv`, so systemd can’t start Puffin until you recreate it. On the Pi, run:

```sh
cd ~/Puffin/pi-service
python3 -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip
.venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade -r requirements.txt
sudo apt install -y quickjs ffmpeg
```

Then restart the downloader service:

```sh
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable --now puffin-downloader
sudo systemctl status puffin-downloader --no-pager
```

You want the status to say `active (running)`. If it doesn’t, get the error with:

```sh
sudo journalctl -u puffin-downloader -n 40 --no-pager
```

## Assistant

yt-dlp created a video file in a different container. `--merge-output-format mp4` only sets the container when yt-dlp merges separate audio and video streams; it doesn’t guarantee an MP4 when the source already has both streams together.

I updated [app.py](/Users/admin/Desktop/Puffin/pi-service/app.py) to add `--remux-video mp4`. That forces an MP4 container without re-encoding, and the Pi will still verify that the file contains video.

Get this backend change onto the Pi, then restart the service:

```sh
cd ~/Puffin
git pull --ff-only
sudo systemctl restart puffin-downloader
```

If the change isn’t pushed to your repository yet, `git pull` won’t bring it over; tell me and I’ll give you the quickest way to apply it.

    def _safe_filename(path: Path) -> str:
        name = path.name.replace("\r", "").replace("\n", "").replace('"', "'")
        return name or "puffin-media"
    
    
    def _ensure_supported_audio(path: Path, supported_formats: list[str], job: dict) -> Path:
        extension = path.suffix.lower().lstrip(".")
        if extension in supported_formats and extension in SUPPORTED_AUDIO_EXTENSIONS:
            return path
    
        output_path = path.with_suffix(".m4a")
        with JOBS_LOCK:
            job["status"] = "converting"
            job["progress"] = 99
            job["updated_at"] = time.time()
    
        common_args = ["ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-y", "-i", str(path), "-vn"]
        copied = subprocess.run(
            [*common_args, "-c:a", "copy", "-movflags", "+faststart", str(output_path)],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
        )
        if copied.returncode != 0:

## Assistant

That error came from the final-path check I added: it rejected yt-dlp’s reported path, even though the finished file may be present under a different path or name. I removed that brittle check. The Pi now selects an MP4 from the job folder only if `ffprobe` confirms it contains a video stream, so it skips audio intermediates.

The fix is in [app.py](/Users/admin/Desktop/Puffin/pi-service/app.py). It needs to reach the Pi: commit and push this change from your computer, then run `git pull --ff-only` in `~/Puffin` on the Pi and restart `puffin-downloader`.

## Assistant

On your Pi’s **32-bit ARM OS**, the Deno binary you found was actually x86-64, so it can’t run there. Puffin is set up to use QuickJS instead. The error message mentions Deno because the handler groups missing-tool errors under one generic message.

Since the service runs as `carsrock60`, check the tools as that user:

```sh
sudo -u carsrock60 -H sh -lc 'command -v ffmpeg; command -v ffprobe; command -v qjs'
sudo -u carsrock60 -H sh -lc 'ffmpeg -version | head -n 1; ffprobe -version | head -n 1; qjs -e "console.log(\"QuickJS works\")"'
```

You should see paths for all three tools and version output. If `ffprobe` is missing, install it with:

```sh
sudo apt install ffmpeg
```

You can skip checking Deno; QuickJS is the compatible runtime for this Pi.

If yt-dlp exits after saving separate tracks, Puffin tries combining those tracks itself. It only marks the job ready when the MP4 contains both audio and video. This follows yt-dlp’s documented `bestvideo+bestaudio` selection pattern. [yt-dlp format selection](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#format-selection)

The change is in [app.py](/Users/admin/Desktop/Puffin/pi-service/app.py). It must reach the Pi before the behavior changes: publish the update, then pull it on the Pi and restart `puffin-downloader`. I haven’t verified a real YouTube download on your Pi.

## User

Optimize Puffin's video download pipeline in `pi-service/app.py`.

I identified a major performance problem: `_make_compatible_mp4()` uses `libx264` with `veryfast` and CRF 23 whenever the downloaded video codec is not H.264. This causes full software video re-encoding on the Raspberry Pi 3 B+, which is extremely slow.

Implement the following focused changes:

1. Change yt-dlp's video format selection to prioritize H.264 video (`avc1`) and AAC audio (`mp4a`) streams.
2. Merge directly into MP4 instead of creating an intermediate MKV.
3. Use FFmpeg stream copy wherever the selected streams are already compatible. Avoid video re-encoding entirely in the normal download path.
4. Add an early return in `_make_compatible_mp4()` when the existing file is already a valid MP4 containing H.264 video and AAC audio, if no additional processing is needed.
5. Preserve a clear, controlled fallback when compatible streams are unavailable. Do not silently force expensive transcoding on the Pi without an explicit fallback policy.
6. Keep the existing file validation, cancellation, cleanup, file-size limits, job states, and transfer API intact.

Also inspect whether yt-dlp's existing merge already produces a valid MP4 before invoking additional FFmpeg processing.

Do not change the YouTube JavaScript runtime configuration, yt-dlp-ejs dependency, frontend, IndexedDB logic, or unrelated backend functionality.

Add focused tests for:
- H.264 + AAC streams requiring no re-encoding.
- Incompatible codecs being detected correctly.
- Direct MP4 merging.
- Missing compatible formats producing a useful error.

Keep the patch minimal. Inspect first, implement only the necessary changes, and report the exact files changed and tests run.

        72    def _signal_process_group(process: subprocess.Popen, force: bool = False) -> None:
        73        if process.poll() is not None:
        74            return
        75        try:
        76            os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL if force else signal.SIGTERM)
        77        except (ProcessLookupError, PermissionError):
        78            try:
        79                process.kill() if force else process.terminate()
        80            except ProcessLookupError:
        81                pass

    import unittest
    from pathlib import Path
    from unittest.mock import patch
    
    import app
    
    
    class VideoPipelineTests(unittest.TestCase):
        def setUp(self):
            self.h264_aac = [
                {"codec_type": "video", "codec_name": "h264"},
                {"codec_type": "audio", "codec_name": "aac"},
            ]
    
        def test_valid_h264_aac_mp4_returns_without_ffmpeg(self):
            path = Path("already-compatible.mp4")
            with patch.object(app, "_media_streams", return_value=self.h264_aac), patch.object(app.subprocess, "run") as run:
                result = app._make_compatible_mp4(path, {})
    
            self.assertEqual(result, path)
            run.assert_not_called()
    
        def test_incompatible_codecs_fail_without_reencoding(self):
            path = Path("source.webm")
            incompatible = [
                {"codec_type": "video", "codec_name": "vp9"},
                {"codec_type": "audio", "codec_name": "opus"},
            ]
            with patch.object(app, "_media_streams", return_value=incompatible), patch.object(app.subprocess, "run") as run:
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(app.DownloadFailure, "will not re-encode"):
                    app._make_compatible_mp4(path, {})
    
            run.assert_not_called()
    
        def test_video_download_merges_directly_to_mp4_and_prefers_compatible_codecs(self):
            options = app._video_format_options()
    
            self.assertEqual(options[-2:], ["--merge-output-format", "mp4"])
            self.assertNotIn("mkv", options)
            self.assertIn("avc1", options[1])
            self.assertIn("mp4a", options[1])
    
        def test_missing_compatible_formats_has_actionable_error(self):
            message = app._yt_dlp_failure_message(["ERROR: Requested format is not available"], 1)
    
            self.assertIn("H.264", message)
            self.assertIn("AAC", message)
            self.assertIn("will not re-encode", message)
    
    
    if __name__ == "__main__":
        unittest.main()

## User

# Puffin UI Polish — Phase 1

You are working on my existing Puffin project.

## Design direction

Refine the UI using two design philosophies:

- **Apple Music:** strong typography, clear content hierarchy, generous spacing, artwork-forward presentation, and a refined premium feel.
- **Sonos:** restraint, simplicity, consistency, understated controls, and interfaces that prioritize the content rather than decoration.

The goal is to make Puffin feel like a cohesive, carefully designed media application. Do not copy either product directly.

## Scope: only three improvements

Please focus exclusively on these areas:

### 1. Typography and hierarchy
- Establish a consistent typography scale for page titles, section headings, card titles, body text, and secondary metadata.
- Improve heading weight, spacing, and line height.
- Make important content visually prominent without making everything bold or oversized.
- Use tabular numerals where appropriate for playback times and statistics.
- Preserve the existing font family unless there is a compelling reason to change it. Do not add external font dependencies.

### 2. Navigation readability
- Improve sidebar navigation text sizing and readability, especially on smaller screens.
- Ensure icons and labels feel visually balanced.
- Maintain the existing navigation structure and behavior.
- Avoid unnecessary visual decoration.

### 3. Button and control consistency
- Standardize button sizing, corner radii, spacing, and visual hierarchy.
- Make primary buttons use the theme's accent variables rather than hardcoded colors.
- Ensure buttons remain visually appropriate in both light and dark themes.
- Keep secondary controls understated.

## Strict constraints

- Inspect the existing implementation before making changes.
- Prefer editing `web/src/styles.css`.
- Only modify `web/index.html` if a small markup adjustment is genuinely necessary.
- Do not modify JavaScript functionality, download logic, playback, lyrics, IndexedDB, the backend, service worker, or data structures.
- Do not introduce new features.
- Do not add dependencies.
- Do not redesign every page.
- Avoid broad refactoring and unrelated cleanup.
- Preserve existing responsive behavior.

## Visual quality expectations

The result should feel:
- Calm and premium, not flashy.
- Consistent across the application.
- Content-focused rather than decoration-focused.
- Deliberate in its spacing and typography.
- Equally considered in light and dark themes.

Avoid excessive gradients, shadows, borders, pill-shaped controls everywhere, and unnecessary uppercase labels.

## Workflow

1. Briefly inspect the relevant CSS and markup.
2. Identify the smallest set of changes that achieves these three improvements.
3. Implement only those changes.
4. Review the resulting diff for accidental functional changes.
5. Check for obvious visual issues at desktop and mobile widths if browser preview is available.

Before finishing, report:
- Which files changed.
- What visual improvements were made.
- Whether any functional code was touched.
- Anything that still needs visual verification.

**Important:** This is Phase 1 of a gradual visual refinement process. Prioritize quality and consistency over the number of changes. Do not expand the scope.

    243:.watch-empty { margin: 0; padding: 20px; color: var(--muted); background: var(--surface); border: 1px dashed var(--border); border-radius: 16px; }
    245:.watch-video-title-button:focus-visible, .watch-thumbnail-button:focus-visible, .watch-search input:focus-visible, .watch-select-field select:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }
    248:.stats-page-heading h1 { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: clamp(2.35rem, 4vw, 3rem); letter-spacing: -.055em; }
    251:.stats-range button { min-height: 34px; padding: 0 13px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; }
    252:.stats-range button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--text); color: var(--surface); }

    256:.stats-card strong { overflow: hidden; font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3vw, 2.4rem); font-weight: 680; letter-spacing: -.055em; line-height: 1; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

    460:.full-player-transport button { width: 46px; height: 46px; color: white; background: var(--accent); border: 0; border-radius: 50%; cursor: pointer; }
    465:.full-player-queue-list .queue-empty-state { display: block; padding: 20px; color: var(--muted); text-align: center; }
    466:.queue-drag-handle { display: grid; width: 44px; height: 44px; place-items: center; padding: 0; color: var(--muted); background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 9px; cursor: grab; touch-action: none; user-select: none; font-size: 1.15rem; text-align: center; }
    471:.queue-row-play:disabled { color: var(--muted); cursor: default; }

    482:.full-player-equalizer button:focus-visible, .full-player-equalizer input:focus-visible, .full-player-equalizer select:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
    506:.player-video-fallback { display: grid; flex: 0 0 58px; width: 58px; height: 58px; place-items: center; color: white; background: radial-gradient(circle at 70% 28%, #7fb9c5, transparent 45%), linear-gradient(135deg, #192f3c, #11171d); border-radius: 12px; font-size: .9rem; }
    530:.video-theater-back, .video-theater-close { display: grid; width: 44px; height: 44px; flex: 0 0 44px; place-items: center; padding: 0; color: #fff; background: #ffffff12; border: 1px solid #ffffff22; border-radius: 50%; cursor: pointer; font-size: 1.35rem; }

    550:.video-speed-control select { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 10px; color: white; background: #ffffff12; border: 1px solid #ffffff2c; border-radius: 10px; font: inherit; }

    562:.player-timeline { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 36px minmax(60px, 1fr) 36px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.72rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
    563:.player-timeline span:last-child { text-align: right; }

    566:.player-timeline input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-runnable-track { height: 4px; background: var(--border); border-radius: 999px; }
    567:.player-timeline input[type="range"]::-webkit-slider-thumb { width: 14px; height: 14px; margin-top: -5px; appearance: none; -webkit-appearance: none; background: var(--accent); border: 2px solid var(--surface); border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 1px 4px #0003; }
    568:.player-timeline input[type="range"]::-moz-range-track { height: 4px; background: var(--border); border-radius: 999px; }
    569:.player-timeline input[type="range"]::-moz-range-thumb { width: 10px; height: 10px; background: var(--accent); border: 2px solid var(--surface); border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 1px 4px #0003; }
    570:.player-timeline input[type="range"]:disabled { cursor: default; opacity: 0.45; }

    574:.player-mode-action:disabled, .player-equalizer-button:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .42; }
    :root {
      color-scheme: light;
      font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
      font-synthesis: none;
      text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
      --page: #f6f7f8;
      --surface: #fff;
      --text: #202428;
      --muted: #737b83;
      --border: #e4e7ea;
      --accent: #306b75;
      --accent-soft: #e8f1f2;
    }
    
    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    
    body {
      min-width: 320px;
      min-height: 100vh;
      min-height: 100dvh;
      overflow-x: hidden;
      margin: 0;
      background: var(--page);
      color: var(--text);
    }
    
    button, a { font: inherit; }
    
    .app {
      --sidebar-width: 248px;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: var(--sidebar-width) minmax(0, 1fr);
      min-height: 100vh;
      min-height: 100dvh;
      transition: grid-template-columns 220ms ease;
    }
    
    .sidebar {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      display: flex;
      height: 100vh;
      height: 100dvh;
      min-height: 0;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 18px;
      padding: 22px 14px 18px;
      overflow-x: hidden;
      overflow-y: auto;
      background: var(--surface);
      border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
      scrollbar-width: thin;
      scrollbar-color: var(--border) transparent;
      transition: padding 220ms ease;
    }
    
    .sidebar-brand-row { display: flex; min-height: 42px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; padding: 0 4px; }
    .brand { display: flex; min-width: 0; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin: 0; font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: -0.05em; white-space: nowrap; }
    .brand-mark { display: grid; width: 34px; height: 34px; flex: 0 0 34px; place-items: center; color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft); border-radius: 11px; font-size: 1.1rem; }
    .brand-name { overflow: hidden; }
    .sidebar-collapse { display: grid; width: 36px; height: 36px; flex: 0 0 36px; place-items: center; padding: 0; color: var(--muted); background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1; }
    .sidebar-collapse:hover { color: var(--text); background: var(--page); }
    .sidebar-collapse:focus-visible, .mobile-menu-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
    .nav-list { display: grid; gap: 16px; }
    .nav-group { display: grid; gap: 4px; min-width: 0; }
    .nav-group + .nav-group { padding-top: 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .nav-group-heading { margin: 0 10px 4px; color: var(--muted); font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: .1em; line-height: 1.4; text-transform: uppercase; }
    .nav-group-tools { padding-top: 14px !important; border-top: 1px solid var(--border) !important; }
    .nav-button { display: flex; width: 100%; min-width: 0; align-items: center; gap: 13px; min-height: 46px; padding: 0 12px; color: var(--muted); background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 13px; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; font-size: .94rem; font-weight: 550; white-space: nowrap; }
    .nav-button:hover { color: var(--text); background: var(--page); }
    .nav-button[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft); font-weight: 650; }
    .nav-icon { display: inline-grid; width: 22px; height: 22px; flex: 0 0 22px; place-items: center; }
    .nav-icon svg { display: block; width: 22px; height: 22px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
    .sidebar-bottom { margin-top: auto; padding-top: 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .settings-nav-button { min-height: 46px; }
    .sidebar-scrim { display: none; }
    .mobile-menu-button { display: none; }
    
    .app.is-sidebar-collapsed { --sidebar-width: 76px; }
    .app.is-sidebar-collapsed .sidebar { align-items: center; padding-inline: 10px; }
    .app.is-sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-brand-row { width: 100%; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
    .app.is-sidebar-collapsed .brand-name, .app.is-sidebar-collapsed .nav-group-heading, .app.is-sidebar-collapsed .nav-label { display: none; }
    .app.is-sidebar-collapsed .brand-mark { width: 34px; }
    .app.is-sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-collapse { transform: rotate(180deg); }
    .app.is-sidebar-collapsed .nav-list, .app.is-sidebar-collapsed .nav-group { width: 100%; }
    .app.is-sidebar-collapsed .nav-group { justify-items: center; }
    .app.is-sidebar-collapsed .nav-group + .nav-group { padding-top: 10px; }
    .app.is-sidebar-collapsed .nav-button { justify-content: center; gap: 0; padding: 0; }
    .app.is-sidebar-collapsed .sidebar-bottom { width: 100%; }
    .app.is-sidebar-collapsed .settings-nav-button { justify-content: center; padding: 0; }
    .app.is-sidebar-collapsed .workspace { min-width: 0; }
    .app.is-sidebar-collapsed ~ .player-dock { left: 76px; }
    
    .nav-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
    
    .icon-button {
      display: flex;
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 0;
      color: var(--muted);
      background: transparent;
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 12px;
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .icon-button:hover { color: var(--text); background: var(--page); }
    
    .workspace { display: flex; min-width: 0; flex-direction: column; }
    
    .topbar {
      display: flex;
      min-height: 68px;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: flex-end;
      padding: 12px 28px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .topbar .icon-button + .icon-button { margin-left: 8px; }
    .mobile-menu-button { display: none; }
    .connection-status { display: grid; width: 40px; height: 40px; margin-right: 8px; place-items: center; color: #268b59; }
    .connection-status svg { width: 23px; height: 23px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
    .connection-status.is-offline { color: #c94a4a; }
    
    main {
      display: block;
      flex: 1;
      width: 100%;
      padding: 36px clamp(20px, 4vw, 64px) 48px;
    }
    
    .panel {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: none;
      padding: 0;
      background: transparent;
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 0;
    }
    
    .welcome {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: none;
      padding: 24px 0;
      text-align: left;
    }
    
    .welcome h1 { margin: 0 0 10px; font-size: clamp(2.25rem, 4vw, 2.75rem); letter-spacing: -0.05em; }
    .welcome p, .muted { color: var(--muted); }
    .welcome p { margin: 0; font-size: 1.05rem; }
    .home-panel > h1 { margin-bottom: 32px; font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 5vw, 3rem); }
    .home-sections { display: grid; gap: 38px; max-width: 1120px; }
    .home-section-heading { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
    .home-section h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.35rem; letter-spacing: -0.03em; }
    .recent-scroll-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
    .recent-scroll-controls .round-button { width: 36px; height: 36px; }
    .recent-scroll-controls .round-button:disabled { opacity: .38; cursor: default; }
    .home-empty-state { display: flex; min-height: 112px; align-items: center; margin: 0; padding: 22px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 18px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 68%, transparent); color: var(--muted); }
    .home-empty-state[hidden] { display: none; }
    .recently-played-list { display: flex; gap: 18px; overflow-x: auto; margin: 0; padding: 0 2px 12px; list-style: none; scroll-snap-type: x mandatory; scrollbar-width: thin; scrollbar-color: var(--border) transparent; }
    .recently-played-list[hidden] { display: none; }
    .recently-played-item { flex: 0 0 158px; min-width: 0; scroll-snap-align: start; }
    .recent-song-button { display: grid; width: 100%; gap: 10px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: transparent; color: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; }
    .recent-song-artwork { display: block; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--accent-soft); box-shadow: 0 4px 14px #00000012; transition: transform .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease; }
    .recent-song-button:hover .recent-song-artwork { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 10px 22px #00000020; }
    .recent-song-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 4px; }
    .recent-song-title { overflow: hidden; font-size: .95rem; font-weight: 600; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
    .music-picks-sort { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: var(--muted); font-size: .85rem; }
    .music-picks-sort select { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 28px 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 11px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); font: inherit; }
    .music-picks-controls { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
    .music-picks-refresh { display: inline-flex; min-height: 36px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 0 13px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: .82rem; }
    .music-picks-refresh[aria-busy="true"] { cursor: progress; }
    .music-picks-list { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 0 22px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
    .music-picks-list[hidden] { display: none; }
    .music-pick-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 50px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 11px; min-height: 72px; padding: 8px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
    .music-pick-artwork { width: 50px; height: 50px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--accent-soft); box-shadow: 0 3px 12px #00000012; }
    .music-pick-details { display: grid; min-width: 0; gap: 4px; }
    .music-pick-details strong, .music-pick-details span { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
    {
      "name": "puffin-web",
      "private": true,
      "type": "module",
      "scripts": {
        "dev": "vite",
        "build": "vite build",
        "preview": "vite preview",
        "test": "node --test"
      },
      "devDependencies": {
        "vite": "^8.0.0"

## User

# Puffin UI Polish — Phase 2: Layout and Spacing

Continue refining the existing Puffin UI.

Phase 1 established a typography foundation, improved sidebar readability, and standardized primary controls. Build on those changes rather than replacing them.

## Design direction

Follow the design philosophies of:

- **Apple Music:** generous but intentional spacing, strong artwork presentation, clear section hierarchy, and elegant content layouts.
- **Sonos:** restrained visual design, consistent alignment, efficient use of space, and minimal unnecessary decoration.

Puffin should feel like a polished, cohesive media application. Avoid copying either product directly.

## Scope: three improvements only

### 1. Watch and Listen card layouts

- Improve the spacing and alignment between thumbnails, titles, and metadata.
- Allow longer video and song titles to wrap onto a maximum of two lines where appropriate.
- Use consistent card heights so rows remain visually aligned.
- Keep metadata visually secondary without making it difficult to read.
- Preserve existing thumbnail aspect ratios.
- Make sure horizontal scrolling collections feel intentional and work well on touchscreens.

### 2. Page spacing and section hierarchy

- Review vertical spacing between page headings, featured content, section headings, and media collections.
- Establish consistent spacing rules across Home, Watch, and Listen.
- Make sections visually distinct through spacing and alignment rather than adding unnecessary borders or backgrounds.
- Avoid excessive empty space, particularly on smaller screens.
- Keep the existing content order and page structure.

### 3. Home page content presentation

- Improve the layout of Recently Played and Music Picks.
- Make artwork, song titles, metadata, and action buttons feel consistently aligned.
- Improve the balance between the two sections on desktop.
- Ensure the layout adapts naturally to narrow screens without awkward wrapping or cramped controls.

## Design constraints

- Keep the existing Apple Music + Sonos design direction.
- Prefer subtle refinements over dramatic visual changes.
- Do not add gradients, decorative borders, or shadows unless genuinely necessary.
- Do not introduce new fonts or dependencies.
- Preserve Phase 1 typography variables and control styling.
- Do not redesign the entire application.

## Strict technical constraints

- Inspect the current implementation before editing.
- Prefer changes to `web/src/styles.css`.
- Modify `web/index.html` only if absolutely necessary.
- Do not modify JavaScript, playback, downloads, lyrics, IndexedDB, backend code, service worker, or data structures.
- Do not change application functionality.
- Preserve existing responsive behavior and accessibility.
- Avoid unrelated cleanup or broad refactoring.

## Workflow

1. Inspect the current CSS and relevant markup.
2. Identify the smallest set of changes that improves the three areas above.
3. Implement the changes.
4. Review the diff for unintended changes.
5. Check desktop and mobile layouts if browser preview is available.

At completion, report:
- Files changed.
- Specific layout improvements.
- Whether any functional code was modified.
- Any remaining visual issues that need manual verification.

This is Phase 2 of a gradual redesign. Keep the scope small, prioritize consistency, and do not introduce unrelated improvements.

I’ll inspect the Home, Watch, and Listen markup and their responsive styles, then make a focused spacing and card layout pass in CSS.

      function createVideoCard(record, { progress = progressById.get(record.id), compact = false } = {}) {
        const card = document.createElement("article");
        card.className = compact ? "watch-video-card watch-video-card-compact" : "watch-video-card";
        card.setAttribute("role", "listitem");
        const playButton = document.createElement("button");
        playButton.type = "button";
        playButton.className = "watch-thumbnail-button";
        playButton.setAttribute("aria-label", `Play ${titleOf(record)}`);
        const thumbnail = makeThumbnail(record);
        if (!compact) thumbnail.classList.add("watch-library-thumbnail");
        addProgressMark(thumbnail, progress);
        playButton.append(thumbnail);
        playButton.addEventListener("click", () => onPlay(record, progress && !progress.completed ? progress.currentTime : 0));
        const title = document.createElement("h3");
        title.textContent = titleOf(record);
        const metadata = document.createElement("p");
        metadata.className = "watch-video-metadata";
        const knownDuration = durationCache.get(record.id) || formatTime(progress?.duration || record.duration);
        const details = [record.artist, knownDuration, new Date(record.importedAt).toLocaleDateString()]
          .filter(Boolean);
        metadata.textContent = details.join(" · ") || "Video";
        if (!knownDuration) {
          if (durationObserver) {
            durationTargets.set(thumbnail, { record, metadata });
            durationObserver.observe(thumbnail);
          } else loadDuration(record, metadata);
        }
        const textButton = document.createElement("button");
        textButton.type = "button";
        textButton.className = "watch-video-title-button";
        textButton.setAttribute("aria-label", `Play ${titleOf(record)}`);
        textButton.append(title);
        textButton.addEventListener("click", () => onPlay(record, progress && !progress.completed ? progress.currentTime : 0));
        card.append(playButton, textButton, metadata);
        return card;
      }

## User

# Puffin UI Polish — Priority Pass 1

## Design direction

Refine Puffin's existing UI using the Apple Music + Sonos design philosophies:

- **Apple Music:** clear content hierarchy, strong visual organization, polished spacing.
- **Sonos:** simplicity, restraint, consistency, and understated controls.

Preserve Puffin's existing visual identity, including its teal accent, light surfaces, typography, and overall design language.

## Objective

Improve only these two areas:

### 1. Download page — clarify the download workflow

The regular download workflow and CSV bulk-download workflow currently feel visually connected in a confusing way.

Make these targeted improvements:

- Keep the regular download form together as one clearly defined workflow.
- Position the primary **Download to Puffin** button directly beneath its associated input and format controls.
- Move CSV downloading into a clearly separated secondary section.
- Give the CSV section an appropriate heading, such as "Bulk download from CSV".
- Add enough spacing and visual distinction to make the two workflows immediately understandable.
- Improve the native file-picker button styling so it fits Puffin's existing controls.
- Consider a modestly wider content area if the current layout feels unnecessarily constrained on desktop.

The regular download workflow must remain visually dominant.

### 2. Edit page — improve organization and readability

The Edit page contains several controls competing for attention.

Make these targeted improvements:

- Clearly separate bulk metadata editing from filename and tag management.
- Add consistent column labels above individual track rows where appropriate, such as Title, Artist, Album, Type, and Actions.
- Align fields and action controls consistently across track rows.
- Improve spacing between related controls.
- Make action icons visually consistent with the rest of Puffin.

The goal is to make the Edit page feel like an organized media editor rather than one large form.

## Strict scope and credit-conscious workflow

**Keep this task small. Do not redesign the entire application.**

1. Inspect only the relevant Download and Edit page markup and their associated CSS.
2. Identify the smallest set of changes needed.
3. Prefer CSS changes. Modify HTML only when necessary for layout or semantic structure.
4. Do not modify JavaScript functionality unless absolutely required. If it is required, explain why before making the change.
5. Do not touch playback, downloads, CSV processing, metadata processing, backend code, IndexedDB, service workers, or data structures.
6. Do not add dependencies, libraries, features, or unnecessary abstractions.
7. Do not change the Library, Playlists, Home, Watch, or Listen pages.
8. Preserve existing responsive behavior and accessibility.
9. Avoid unrelated cleanup or refactoring.

## Implementation process

- Inspect the relevant existing code.
- Make the smallest practical changes.
- Review your own diff for accidental functional changes.
- Perform a quick desktop and mobile layout check if an existing browser preview is readily available.
- Do not spend time generating extensive reports or running unrelated tests.

## Final report

Briefly report:
- Which files changed.
- What improved on the Download page.
- What improved on the Edit page.
- Whether any functional code was modified.
- Any remaining visual issues that need manual verification.

**Success criterion:** Both pages should feel noticeably more organized and polished without changing how any existing feature works.

                <h1 id="download-title">Download</h1>
                <form id="download-form" class="download-form">
                  <div class="download-source-switch" role="group" aria-label="Choose download source">
                    <button id="download-source-link" class="is-selected" type="button" aria-pressed="true">Enter a link or search</button>

                      <input id="youtube-url" name="youtube-url" type="text" placeholder="Paste a YouTube link or search, e.g. Apollo 11 highlights" autocomplete="off" required />
                    </label>
                    <label class="form-field format-field" for="download-kind">
                      <span>Format</span>
                      <select id="download-kind" name="download-kind">
                        <option value="audio">Audio · original format when supported</option>
                        <option value="video">Video · MP4</option>
                      </select>
                    </label>
                  </div>
                  <section id="youtube-browse-panel" class="youtube-browse-panel" aria-label="Search YouTube" hidden>
                    <div class="youtube-search-row">
                      <label class="form-field" for="youtube-search-query">
                        <span>Search YouTube</span>
                        <input id="youtube-search-query" type="search" maxlength="200" placeholder="Search for a video or song" autocomplete="off" />
                      </label>
                      <button id="youtube-search-button" class="secondary-button" type="button">Search</button>
                    </div>
                    <p id="youtube-search-status" class="muted" role="status" aria-live="polite">Search YouTube, then choose a result to download.</p>
                    <div id="youtube-selected-video" class="youtube-selected-video" hidden>
                      <span id="youtube-selected-title"></span>
                      <button id="youtube-clear-selection" class="secondary-button" type="button">Choose another</button>
                    </div>
                    <ol id="youtube-search-results" class="youtube-search-results" aria-label="YouTube search results"></ol>
                  </section>
                  <section class="csv-download-section" aria-labelledby="csv-download-title">
                    <h2 id="csv-download-title">Download from CSV</h2>
                    <p class="muted">Choose a CSV with columns Track Name, Artist Name, and Album. Download all data rows or specify data row numbers (header excluded), such as 1,3-5.</p>
                    <label class="form-field" for="download-csv-file"><span>CSV file</span>
                      <input id="download-csv-file" type="file" accept=".csv,text/csv" />

                    <div class="csv-download-controls">
                      <label class="form-field" for="download-csv-rows"><span>Rows to download</span>
                        <input id="download-csv-rows" type="text" placeholder="All rows, or e.g. 1,3-5" autocomplete="off" />
                      </label>
                      <button id="download-csv-prepare" class="secondary-button" type="button">Load CSV</button>
                    </div>
                    <p id="download-csv-status" class="muted" role="status" aria-live="polite">No CSV loaded.</p>
                    <button id="download-csv-start" class="primary-button" type="button" disabled>Download selected rows</button>
                  </section>
                  <button class="primary-button" id="start-download" type="submit">Download to Puffin</button>
                  <button class="secondary-button" id="cancel-download" type="button" hidden>Cancel download</button>
                  <progress id="download-progress" max="100" value="0" hidden></progress>
                  <p id="download-transfer-details" class="download-transfer-details" hidden></p>
                  <p id="download-status" class="muted" role="status" aria-live="polite">Downloads run through your Raspberry Pi. Enter a YouTube link or search phrase, or browse YouTube.</p>
                </form>
              </section>
    
              <section class="panel" id="edit-panel" data-panel="edit" aria-labelledby="edit-title" hidden>
                <h1 id="edit-title">Edit</h1>
                <div class="edit-toolbar">
                  <label class="edit-select-all"><input id="edit-select-all" type="checkbox" /> Select all</label>
                  <span id="edit-selection-count" class="muted">0 selected</span>
                  <button id="edit-smart-fill" class="secondary-button" type="button">Smart Fill</button>
                </div>

    function filenameFromResponse(response, sourceUrl, mimeType) {
      const disposition = response.headers.get("Content-Disposition") || "";
      const encoded = disposition.match(/filename\*=UTF-8''([^;]+)/i)?.[1];
      const plain = disposition.match(/filename="?([^";]+)"?/i)?.[1];
      let name = "";
      try { name = encoded ? decodeURIComponent(encoded) : (plain || ""); } catch { name = plain || ""; }
      if (!name) {
        try { name = decodeURIComponent(new URL(sourceUrl).pathname.split("/").pop() || ""); } catch { name = ""; }
      }
      if (!/\.[a-z0-9]{2,5}$/i.test(name) && (mimeType.startsWith("audio/") || mimeType.startsWith("video/"))) {
        const extensions = {
          "audio/aac": "aac", "audio/flac": "flac", "audio/mpeg": "mp3", "audio/ogg": "ogg", "audio/wav": "wav", "audio/x-wav": "wav", "audio/mp4": "m4a",
          "video/mp4": "mp4", "video/webm": "webm", "video/quicktime": "mov", "video/ogg": "ogv",
        };
        const extension = extensions[mimeType] || (mimeType.startsWith("audio/") ? "m4a" : "mp4");
        name = `${name || "puffin-download"}.${extension}`;
      }
      return (name || "puffin-download").replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|\r\n]/g, "_").slice(0, 180);
    }
    
    async function readDirectMedia(response, sourceUrl, capacity, onProgress) {
      const mimeType = (response.headers.get("Content-Type") || "").split(";")[0].trim().toLowerCase();
      const name = filenameFromResponse(response, sourceUrl, mimeType);
      if (!mimeType.startsWith("audio/") && !mimeType.startsWith("video/") && !/\.(m4a|mp3|aac|wav|flac|ogg|opus|mp4|m4v|mov|webm|ogv)$/i.test(name)) {
        await response.body?.cancel();
        throw new Error("This link did not return a recognizable audio or video file. Use a direct media-file URL.");
      }
      if (!response.body?.getReader) throw new Error("This browser cannot stream the response. Try the Raspberry Pi download option.");
      const total = Number(response.headers.get("Content-Length")) || 0;
      if (total && total > capacity.remainingBytes) {
        await response.body.cancel();
        await assertMediaStorageCapacity(total);
      }
      const reader = response.body.getReader();
      const chunks = [];
      const started = Date.now();
      let received = 0;
      let lastReceived = 0;
      let lastTime = started;
      let nextCapacityCheck = 1024 * 1024;
      try {
        while (true) {
          const { done, value } = await reader.read();
          if (done) break;
          received += value.byteLength;
          if (received > capacity.remainingBytes) {
          const speed = (received - lastReceived) / Math.max(0.001, (now - lastTime) / 1000);
          const averageSpeed = received / Math.max(0.001, (now - started) / 1000);
          onProgress({ received, total, speed, eta: total ? (total - received) / Math.max(averageSpeed, 1) : null });
          lastReceived = received;
          lastTime = now;
        }
      } catch (error) {
        try { await reader.cancel(); } catch { /* stream already closed */ }
        throw error;
      }
      if (total && received !== total) throw new Error("The connection ended before the full file arrived. Try again.");
      await assertMediaStorageCapacity(received);
      return { blob: new Blob(chunks, { type: mimeType || "application/octet-stream" }), name, mimeType };

    function transactionComplete(transaction) {
      return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        transaction.oncomplete = () => resolve();
        transaction.onerror = () => reject(transaction.error || new Error("The library transaction failed."));
        transaction.onabort = () => reject(transaction.error || new Error("The library transaction was cancelled."));
      });
    }
    
    export function getMediaKind(fileName, mimeType = "") {
      if (mimeType.startsWith("audio/")) return "audio";
      if (mimeType.startsWith("video/")) return "video";
    
      const extension = fileName.split(".").pop()?.toLowerCase();
      const videoExtensions = new Set(["mp4", "m4v", "mov", "webm", "ogv", "mkv", "avi"]);
      const audioExtensions = new Set(["mp3", "m4a", "aac", "wav", "flac", "ogg", "oga", "opus", "aiff"]);
    
      if (videoExtensions.has(extension)) return "video";
      if (audioExtensions.has(extension)) return "audio";
      return null;
    }
    
    function getMediaMimeType(fileName, mimeType = "") {
      if (mimeType && mimeType !== "application/octet-stream") return mimeType;
      const extension = fileName.split(".").pop()?.toLowerCase();
      return MIME_TYPES_BY_EXTENSION[extension] || mimeType || "application/octet-stream";
    }
